## Examination Tab (Sept 28, 2026)

A new top-level tab, **📝 Examination**. It is Admin / Headmaster / Super Admin only and purely additive: Code.gs was only appended to (everything before the new module is byte-identical), and Dashboard.html only gained insertions (0 lines removed). It has two sections, **Announcements** (Post / Modify / Delete / Search-View) and **Classwork** (Assignment, Quiz Assignment, Question (short answer / multiple choice), Material). Below them are a shared Publishing Result card and an **Examination History** card.

### Files changed

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `Code.gs` | New block `EXAMINATION MODULE (Sept 28, 2026)` at the end of the file |
| `Dashboard.html` | Insertions only:<br>• scoped CSS (`#examinationView`)<br>• the `tabExamination` button<br>• `#examinationView` markup and `#examConfirmOverlay`<br>• 3 lines in `switchView()`<br>• `updateExaminationTabVisibility()` called next to `updateAttendanceTabVisibility()` (2 places)<br>• the tab click listener<br>• the `EXAMINATION TAB` script block |
| `appsscript.json` | +4 OAuth scopes (see Deployment) |
| `dashboard-architecture-and-config.md` | This section |

### Architecture

- **Server (Code.gs).**
  - Every client-callable function takes the session token first and calls `examRequireAccess_()`. That runs `requireValidSession_`, then `isAdminOrHm_` (Admin / HM / Super Admin); writes also run `requireDashboardMutationPermission_` (the role's *buttons* permission).
  - Client-callable endpoints:
    - `getExaminationCourseOptions`
    - `previewExaminationAnnouncement`, `generateAnnouncementId`, `postExaminationAnnouncement`, `searchExaminationAnnouncement`, `modifyExaminationAnnouncement`, `deleteExaminationAnnouncement`
    - `previewExaminationClasswork`, `publishExaminationToCourses`, `retryFailedExaminationPublish`
    - `getExaminationHistory`
  - All helpers end in `_`, so `google.script.run` cannot call them.
- **Reused (not duplicated):**
  - `callWithBackoff_` (reads/updates)
  - `easternWallTimeToDate_` (DST-aware EST → UTC)
  - `APS_TZ`
  - `extractNilaiFromCourseName_` / `NILAI_FILTER_OPTIONS` (grade groups, quiz sheet lookup)
  - `getWorkbook_`, `ensureSheetHeader_`, `openSpreadsheetByIdWithRetry_`, `getConfigString_`, `getAPSIdFromEmail`
  - Client side: `apsScriptRun`, `showToast`, `escapeHtml`, `attDebounce_`, and the `.gtr-*` / `.report-*` / `.modal-overlay` styles
- **No Classroom wrapper existed before.** Production only used `Courses.list` / `Students` / `Teachers`, so thin wrappers were added:
  - `examListTopics_`, `getOrCreateExaminationTopic_`
  - `checkExistingExaminationClasswork_`
  - `createExaminationAssignment_`, `createExaminationMaterial_`, `createExaminationClasswork_`
  - `examListAnnouncementsWithId_`
- **Central configuration:**
  - `EXAMINATION_CONFIG`: suffix, TZ, topics, aliases, names, types, presets, ID prefix/label/header, lead minutes, limits, cache, sheet names
  - `EXAMINATION_TOPICS`, `EXAMINATION_ASSIGNMENT_NAMES`, `EXAMINATION_CLASSWORK_TYPES`, `EXAMINATION_PRESETS`
  - `EXAMINATION_ACTIONS`, `EXAMINATION_STATUS`
- **Type mapping lives on the server.** The HTML only sends the type key:
  - ASSIGNMENT / QUIZ_ASSIGNMENT / SHORT_ANSWER_QUESTION / MULTIPLE_CHOICE_QUESTION → `CourseWork.create`
  - MATERIAL → `CourseWorkMaterials.create`
  - Classwork is created as `state:'DRAFT'` + `scheduledTime`, which is Classroom's "Scheduled" state.
  - Ungraded = `maxPoints` omitted.
  - Optional due date/time (default 11:59 PM EST) is sent as UTC `dueDate` / `dueTime`.
- **Attachments.** `examMaterialFromLink_()` turns a Drive/Docs link into a view-only `driveFile`; any other URL becomes a `link`. Published Forms (`/forms/d/e/…`) stay links. New sources plug in there without touching the publishing engine.

### Topic presets (from the school's manual weekly scripts)

| Topic | Default type | Grading | Instructions |
|---|---|---|---|
| ATTENDANCE | Question (multiple choice) YES / NO | GRADED 100 | Bilingual attendance text from `1_Attendance` |
| HOMEWORK | Assignment | GRADED 100 | Homework text from `3_HW` |
| QUIZ | Quiz Assignment | UNGRADED | Quiz text from `2_Quiz`, plus a per-class Drive file from the `KAHOOT_LINK_ALL_NILAI_ASSIGNMENT_POST` sheet |
| PROJECT WORK | Assignment | GRADED 100 | Project-work text from `5_PROJECTWORK` |
| EXAMINATION | Assignment | GRADED 100 | Short bilingual default |

- **Presets only pre-fill the form.** Every field stays editable, and text the user has typed is never overwritten ("Load topic default" restores it).
- **Placeholders** are replaced per classroom on the server: `{TITLE}` → the assignment name, `{MATERIAL_LINK}` → that class's quiz file link.
- **The quiz sheet id** comes from Script Property `EXAM_QUIZ_MATERIAL_SHEET_ID`, falling back to the id used by the manual script. The sheet is matched on NILAI + TITLE (case- and space-insensitive). A class with no row is **SKIPPED**; the manual script posted "PDF not available." instead.
- **Fixed from the manual scripts:**
  - `homeworkDescription_` was defined in both the HW and PROJECT WORK files, so the last one loaded silently won.
  - PROJECT WORK hard-coded `titleip="TRMST01PRO01"`, which also doesn't match the valid `TRMST01_PRO01` names.

### AY26-27 filtering

- `examIsAllowedCourseName_()` is an **exact, case-sensitive** `trim().endsWith('AY26-27')`. It is deliberately not `COURSE_NAME_SUFFIX`, which is case-insensitive and can be blanked.
- `getExaminationCourses_()` pages through `Classroom.Courses.list({courseStates:['ACTIVE'], pageSize:100, fields})` via `nextPageToken` until the end, then filters and sorts. The result is cached 10 minutes (the "Refresh classrooms" button forces a re-read).
- The same list validates **every** courseId on **every** write call. Unknown or old-year ids are SKIPPED with no API call.

### Announcement ID

- **Format:** `ANNYYYYMMDD_NNNN` (EST date).
- **Generation:** `generateAnnouncementId_()` increments a per-day counter in Script Property `examAnnouncementSeq_v1` under `LockService.getScriptLock()`.
- **Recovery:** on the first ID of a day the counter is reconciled with the audit log's highest `ANN<today>_NNNN`, so a lost property can't reissue an ID.
- **When it is issued:** the browser asks for the ID once, at Confirm (preview consumes nothing). It then passes the ID with every chunk and with Retry Failed.
- **Placement:** always the **last line** (`\n\nANNOUNCEMENT_ID: ANN…`). Any `ANNOUNCEMENT_ID:` line the user pastes is stripped first.
- **Matching:** only the full ID on the last line matches (`examExtractAnnouncementId_`), so `ANN20260928` never matches.
- **Modify** re-composes the text with the **same** ID. **Search / Modify / Delete** re-read and verify the exact ID before changing anything.

### Duplicate protection / idempotency

- **Classwork.** Before any create, the server re-checks Classroom for **Course + Topic + Name**:
  - Name comparison is trimmed and case-insensitive.
  - It covers assignments/questions **and** materials, PUBLISHED and DRAFT/scheduled.
  - The topic includes a case-insensitive existing topic and the legacy `EXAMNIATION` alias.
  - A match returns **ALREADY_EXISTS** and nothing is created.
  - If the topic doesn't exist in that class yet, the list calls are skipped (nothing can be filed under it).
- **Topics.** `getOrCreateExaminationTopic_` lists all topic pages and reuses exact, then case-insensitive, matches. Only if none exists does it create exactly one. `EXAMNIATION` is never created.
- **Announcements.** Every classroom is checked for the exact ID before posting:
  - full scan where the audit log shows a prior attempt;
  - otherwise the newest page.

  So a double click, a timed-out chunk, a lost audit write or a retry never double-posts.
- **In-flight guard.** A 2-minute CacheService marker per classroom + topic (and per classroom + announcement ID), set under a brief script lock, stops two admins or two tabs racing. If the guard is busy the result is a retryable FAILED ("in progress").
- **Create calls retry only on quota / rate-limit errors** (`examCallCreate_`). `callWithBackoff_` also retries 500/503, which for a create could duplicate an item, so it is not used for creates.
- **Browser guards.** Confirm buttons disable on the first click, and a stale preview is discarded on any field change.

### Scheduling validation

`validateExaminationSchedule_()` builds the instant from date + time in America/New_York via `easternWallTimeToDate_()`.

- It requires the time to be at least `MIN_SCHEDULE_LEAD_MINUTES` (2) ahead. Otherwise it shows "Scheduled time must be in the future. Please select a future date/time."
- It runs:
  - at Preview (no API call if it fails);
  - again on **every** publish chunk. If the time passed during a long batch, those classrooms are FAILED with no Classroom call.
- The due date must be after the scheduled time.
- DST is handled (e.g. 7:30 PM on Nov 6 → 00:30Z).

### Batch processing, progress and Retry Failed

- **Chunking.** The browser sends `COURSES_PER_CALL` (6) classrooms per server call; the server caps a call at 12. It shows "Processed x / N · Success · Failed · Skipped · Already Exists", and no call gets near the 6-minute limit.
- **Independence.** Each classroom is processed on its own and returns SUCCESS / FAILED / SKIPPED / ALREADY_EXISTS:
  - the browser gets a friendly reason ("Unable to complete. Reason: …");
  - the raw API error is kept only in the audit log.
- **Failed requests.** A chunk whose whole request fails (network) marks only those classrooms FAILED. A run that gets no answer for 2 minutes (e.g. the session expired mid-batch) is closed out as "Not confirmed" instead of leaving the tab stuck.
- **Retry Failed** re-sends only FAILED classrooms, through `retryFailedExaminationPublish` for classwork and the same ID for announcements. The duplicate checks guarantee a success is never re-created.

### Audit / history

- **Storage.** Sheet `Examination_Audit_Log` in the main workbook: text-formatted, append-only, one row per classroom per action, written in one batch under the script lock (falls back to `appendRow`).
- **Columns:** Timestamp (EST), User, User Role, Action, Operation Type, Batch ID, Announcement ID, Course ID, Course Name, Topic, Topic ID, Classwork Type, Assignment Name, Grading, Points, Scheduled Time, Due, Status, Google Classroom ID, Message, Error Message, Content Preview, APSID.
- **Record of created items.** Rows with CLASSWORK_CREATE + SUCCESS form the registry for later Edit / Reschedule / Cancel. They carry the course, classroom item id, topic id, name, type, schedule and batch. `CLASSWORK_UPDATE` / `CLASSWORK_DELETE` actions are reserved for that.
- **Failure-safe.** An audit write failure is logged and never turns finished Classroom work into FAILED.
- **Reading history.** `getExaminationHistory` scans the last 3000 rows and returns up to 500, newest first.
  - Filters: search (Announcement ID / assignment / course / batch), Action, Status, Topic, Date.
  - Dropdowns auto-refresh; search is debounced.
  - The raw error text is not returned; the user is shown by APSID when present.

### Deployment steps

1. **Paste** `Code.gs`, `Dashboard.html` and `appsscript.json` into the Apps Script project.
2. **New scopes** (already in `appsscript.json`):
   - `classroom.announcements`
   - `classroom.coursework.students`
   - `classroom.courseworkmaterials`
   - `classroom.topics`

   Run any function once in the editor (e.g. `getExaminationCourses_`) and approve the new permissions as the **deploying (owner) account**.
3. **Owner account permissions.** The Web App runs "Execute as: Me", so the owner must be a Workspace admin or a teacher/co-teacher in every AY26-27 class. Otherwise those classrooms return "The dashboard account does not have permission…".
4. **Quiz sheet (optional).** Set Script Property `EXAM_QUIZ_MATERIAL_SHEET_ID` if the quiz sheet moves. The owner needs view access to that sheet and to the Drive files it links.
5. **Deploy** a new Web App version. Nothing else is needed: no new triggers, and the audit sheet is created on first use.

### Assumptions

- **Deployment model.** The current production manifest is "Execute as: Me" (`USER_DEPLOYING`, access `ANYONE_ANONYMOUS`, sign-in enforced by the dashboard session), so every Classroom call runs as the owner account.
- **Access.** Examination is Admin / HM / Super Admin only; BOD, Teacher and Student don't see the tab. A role whose *buttons* permission is off can view history but not publish.
- **Announcements are posted immediately** (the spec's Post screen has no schedule) to all students of each class.
- **Times** are shown with an "EST" label (school convention), even during EDT; the actual conversion is America/New_York and DST-aware.
- **Quiz Assignment.** The Classroom API cannot create a Google Forms *quiz* with grade import. "Quiz Assignment" is therefore an Assignment with the class's quiz file attached, as the school's manual script does.

### Validation

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|

## Examination Update (Sept 28, 2026): Access Policy, Signature, and the Exam Question Paper Sub-Tab

### 1. Access policy (supersedes the earlier "Admin/HM" rule)

| Role | Examination tab | Rights |
|---|---|---|
| Admin, Super Admin | Visible | Read-write: Announcements, Classwork, History, Exam Question Paper management |
| VCFO_AMCHATS_BOD | Visible | Read-only: view and search announcements, classwork history, question-paper monitoring and audit. Every change, preview and export is refused. |
| HM, Teacher, Student, everyone else | Hidden | Every endpoint refuses |

- **Single source of truth.** `examinationAccessForRole_(role)` in Code.gs returns one of these values:
  - `READ_WRITE`
  - `READ_ONLY`
  - `QUESTION_PAPER`
  - `''` (no access)
- **Browser.** The value is sent as `currentUser.examinationAccess`, added to both `getDashboardData()` and `buildAuthenticatedUserPayload_()`, and is used only to show or hide the tab.
- **Server.** Every Examination endpoint checks the value again.
- **Optional student/teacher access.** The Exam Question Paper student and teacher flows are built but **off by default**. Setting Script Property `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_STUDENT_TEACHER_ACCESS=true` makes the tab (Exam Question Paper sub-tab only) visible to:
  - HM: monitors all classes
  - Class Teacher: own classes only
  - Student: downloads own class's paper

  Nothing else changes when the flag is flipped: no code change and no redeploy.

### 2. Signature on every announcement and classwork

`EXAMINATION_CONFIG.SIGNATURE`:

```
Thanks
APS Tech Team - Admin
Sugadev Velayutham
Director of Technology and Public Relations
```

- **Announcements:** body, then the signature, then `ANNOUNCEMENT_ID: ANN…`. The ID is still the last line.
- **Classwork:** the signature is appended to every description (Assignment, Quiz Assignment, Question, Material).
- **Never doubled:** `examStripSignature_()` removes an existing signature before it is added again, and the Modify screen edits only the body.
- **Header text:** the announcement header now matches the Dashboard checkbox label: `*** 📢 APS ADMIN Team - ANNOUNCEMENT 📢 ***`.

### 3. Exam Question Paper sub-tab

**Files**

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `Code.gs` | New block `EXAM QUESTION PAPER MODULE`. Additive; the only other edits are the access policy and signature above. |
| `PdfLib.gs` (**new file**) | pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT) wrapped in `examQpLoadPdfLib_()`. It is compiled only when a paper is stamped. Only the UMD header was changed. |
| `Dashboard.html` | The sub-tab button, `#examQpSection`, `#examQpModalOverlay`, scoped CSS, and the `EXAM QUESTION PAPER` script block |
| `ENV_VARIABLE_LIVE.gs` / `ENV_VARIABLE_TEST.gs` | New Script Properties (see Configuration below) |

**Storage.** One spreadsheet: Script Property `LIVE_QUESTION_PAPER_SPREADSHEET_ID`, or `TEST_QUESTION_PAPER_SPREADSHEET_ID` when `APS_ENVIRONMENT=TESTING`. A TESTING deployment refuses to run if that id is missing or equals the LIVE id. Sheets are auto-created; existing sheets, headers and rows are always preserved, and missing columns are appended.

| Sheet | Contents |
|---|---|
| `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPERS` | One record per class. `Question_Paper_ID` = `EQP-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXXXX` (random, opaque); `Exam_ID` = `EXM-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX` groups classes. Also holds Version and Version_History, and Row_Version for optimistic locking. |
| `LIVE_QUESTION_PAPER_DOWNLOAD_LINK` | Every download attempt, with the spec's columns plus Download_Attempt_Count, Last_Download_Date_Time, Reason, Entered_APSID and Question_Paper_Version. Written with atomic `appendRow`. |
| `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_DOWNLOAD_SUMMARY` | One row per student per paper: first and last download, count, failed attempts. Admin can use "Rebuild download summary". |
| `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_AUDIT` | General audit events, see below. |

- **General audit events:**
  - EXAM_CREATED, EXAM_UPDATED
  - QUESTION_PAPER_UPLOADED, QUESTION_PAPER_REPLACED, QUESTION_PAPER_PUBLISHED, QUESTION_PAPER_UNPUBLISHED, QUESTION_PAPER_CANCELLED, QUESTION_PAPER_LOCKED, QUESTION_PAPER_UNLOCKED
  - STUDENT_VIEWED_EXAM, DOWNLOAD_WINDOW_OPENED
  - DOWNLOAD_ATTEMPTED, DOWNLOAD_COMPLETED, DOWNLOAD_FAILED
  - INVALID_APSID, UNAUTHORIZED_DOWNLOAD_ATTEMPT, LATE_DOWNLOAD_ATTEMPT
  - ADMIN_OVERRIDE (preview), SETTINGS_UPDATED, AUDIT_EXPORTED, SUMMARY_REBUILT
- **Timestamps** are `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` America/New_York and are shown as `MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm a EST`.
- **Files** live in a private Drive folder owned by the deploying account and never shared: `APS Exam Question Papers - PRIVATE (<ENV>)` with subfolders `Originals` and `Personalized`.
  - Originals are never modified.
  - Every personalized copy is archived; its id is recorded in `Personalized_File_ID`.
  - The folder is created automatically the first time an Admin opens the sub-tab. You can also point Script Property `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_FOLDER_ID` at an existing folder.

**Schedule logic**

- `examQpParseClassName_()` reuses `parseCourseSchedule_` and `extractNilaiFromCourseName_`. It returns grade, section, day, start, end, time zone and academic year; no class names are hard-coded.
- The class date is the first date on or after the Admin's Exam Date that falls on the class's day. So the Friday of exam week also resolves SAT and SUN classes in that week.
- `Release = Class Start − Release_Window_Minutes`. The default of 15 comes from `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_RELEASE_MINUTES`.
- `Close = class start` (`EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_CLOSE_AT_CLASS_START=true`), or class end when `false`.
- Both values are stored per paper and can be edited per paper. The defaults can be changed in the UI ("Release window settings", Admin only).
- A 0-minute window that closes at class start is rejected, because it would never open.
- All maths is DST-aware (`easternWallTimeToDate_`) and is decided on the **server clock**.

Examples (exam date 2026-10-16):

| Class | Release |
|---|---|
| MAZHALAI - CB (FRI 7:30 PM) | FRI 7:15 PM EST |
| NILAI 2 - ED (FRI 6:30 PM) | FRI 6:15 PM EST |
| NILAI 3 - PA (FRI 9:00 PM) | FRI 8:45 PM EST |
| NILAI 7 - SA (SUN 7:30 PM) | SUN 10/18 7:15 PM EST |

**Statuses**

- **Question paper:** NOT_UPLOADED, UPLOADED, READY, PUBLISHED, CANCELLED, plus a Locked flag. Lock suspends downloads and edits immediately.
- **Exam** (derived): DRAFT, UPLOADED, SCHEDULED, AVAILABLE, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED.
- **Student:** NOT_ELIGIBLE, WAITING, ELIGIBLE, VERIFICATION_PENDING, DOWNLOADED, FAILED, NOT_DOWNLOADED.

**Admin workflow**

1. **+ Add Exam Question Paper.** Enter:
   - Title
   - Academic Year (AY26-27 only)
   - Grade and one or more classes
   - Exam Date
   - Start and End time (from the class name; editable when one class is selected)
   - Release window and close policy
   - PDF

   Then **Save Draft**. This is idempotent: the client request id is claimed first, and duplicate class + date + title records are refused inside the lock.
2. **Upload.** Checks the PDF header, rejects encrypted files, and does a **real pdf-lib load and stamping dry run**, so a PDF that cannot be personalized is rejected at upload, not at exam time. The file is stored once and shared by all selected classes.
3. **Publish** (row or bulk). The confirmation shows Exam, Class, Class Start, Release, Question Paper, and Students Eligible. Publishing requires all fields, a PDF, and a release time still in the future.
4. **Other actions:**
   - Replace PDF: before release only; reason required; the version is incremented and history kept.
   - Unpublish.
   - Lock / Unlock: reason required to lock.
   - Cancel: reason required.
   - Re-publish: reason required.
   - Preview: a watermarked "PREVIEW – admin" copy, audited as ADMIN_OVERRIDE; Admin only.
   - Export CSV: Admin (and HM when the student/teacher flag is on).
   - Rebuild download summary.
5. **Concurrency.** Every change re-reads the record and is refused if another admin changed it meanwhile (`Row_Version`).

**Student download** (only when the flag is on)

1. The student sees only published papers of their own AY26-27 class, with a countdown driven by the server clock offset. The download button appears only inside the window; at zero the browser asks the server again, with a 0–4 s random spread.
2. The verification form shows the name (from the roster, read-only), grade, class, teacher and exam. The student **types the APSID** and must tick the bilingual non-sharing confirmation. A second "Please verify your information" screen follows, then **Confirm & Download**.
3. The server re-validates everything and trusts nothing from the browser:
   - session and role
   - paper exists, is published, and is not cancelled or locked
   - class is AY26-27 and the student is enrolled in **that** class (per the synced roster)
   - any exam, grade, class or email sent by the browser must match, otherwise it is logged as tampering
   - server time is inside [release, close)
   - confirmation is ticked
   - APSID equals the APSID in the account email. If the email has none, the entry is accepted and recorded as `APSID_NOT_VERIFIABLE_FROM_EMAIL`.
4. **Watermark.** pdf-lib stamps **every page**:
   - header and footer lines: Student, APSID, Class, Exam, Downloaded (EST), Account email, Paper ID
   - two light diagonal lines
   - PDF title and keywords

   The original is untouched.
5. **File name:** `Mid-Term-Examination_NILAI-2-ED_Raja-Kumar_APS1234_20260928-1817-EST.pdf` (sanitized).
6. **Delivery** is streamed back through `google.script.run` as base64; there is no URL.
   - The browser sends a random ticket, and the outcome is always stored under it.
   - If the runtime does not return the Promise value, the browser polls `fetchExamQuestionPaperDownload`. That call is bound to the same account, single-use, and re-checks role and paper state.
7. **Every attempt is recorded** in the download sheet and in the general audit: success, each failure code, before release, after close, other class, unknown id, ticket reuse, and the flag off.

**Monitoring**

- **Scope:**
  - HM and BOD: all classes.
  - Class Teacher: only classes they teach. Other classes' students are never returned, not even ones who tried their paper.
- **Tiles:** Total Exams, Today's Exams, Total Classes, Total Students, Published, Pending, Eligible, Downloaded, Not Downloaded, Download Rate, Failed Downloads, Unauthorized Attempts, Repeated Downloads. Each tile opens the filtered detail.
- **Filters** (server-side):
  - Academic Year, Exam, Grade, Class, Teacher
  - Download status
  - Date range
  - Search: student, APSID, email, exam, paper id, class, teacher; case-insensitive
- **Views:** Question Papers, Students, Download Activity, Suspicious Activity, Audit Log. Selecting a paper shows a summary: Exam, Class, Release, Class Start, Students, Downloaded, Not Downloaded, Rate, Last Download.
- **Suspicious activity** is flagged only; nothing blocks a student automatically:
  - repeated invalid APSID
  - another class's or unknown paper
  - tampered or mismatched data
  - attempts before release
  - attempts after close
  - repeated downloads (within 10 minutes = medium)
- All counts are derived from the download events, which are the source of truth.

### 4. Configuration (Script Properties)

| Property | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `LIVE_QUESTION_PAPER_SPREADSHEET_ID` | `1hxcZ4I9OyR-YVN1qysdUCL36q0b3HfFpaqH6qgprkHY` | LIVE project; added to ENV_VARIABLE_LIVE.gs |
| `TEST_QUESTION_PAPER_SPREADSHEET_ID` | a TEST copy | TESTING project only; commented placeholder in ENV_VARIABLE_TEST.gs |

| `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_FOLDER_ID` | optional | existing private Drive folder |

No new OAuth scopes are needed: Drive, Sheets and the Classroom roster cache are already authorized.

### 5. Deployment

1. Add **PdfLib.gs** as a new script file in the Apps Script project.
2. Paste the new `Code.gs` and `Dashboard.html`.
3. Set the Script Properties above; `ENV_VARIABLE_LIVE.gs` seeds them. The deploying account needs Editor access to spreadsheet `1hxcZ4I9…`.
4. Deploy a new version.
5. An Admin opens **Examination → Exam Question Paper** once. This creates the sheets and private folders.
6. **Before any real exam:** upload a real paper, use **Preview**, and run one student download with a test student (with the flag on in the TEST deployment).

| New `test/qp.js` (real pdf-lib in a timer-less sandbox, like Apps Script) | 24 / 24 |
| New `test/ui_qp.js` (Chromium) | 10 / 10 |
| Examination `exam.js` | 34 / 34 |
| Examination `ui_exam.js` | 20 / 20 |
| Attendance `e2e.js` | 36 / 36 |

| `ui_e2e` | Pass |

- **`test/qp.js` covers:**
  - the 4 release examples
  - idempotent saves
  - role gates, including the default-off policy and BOD read-only
  - upload validation, including an unstampable PDF
  - publish confirmation

  - 375 px mobile layout

### 7. Known limits

- **Throughput.** "Execute as: Me" allows about 30 simultaneous executions for the owner, and each download runs pdf-lib and Drive I/O (roughly 1–3 s for a 1–2 MB paper). Very large classes downloading in the same seconds may see retries. The client spreads its re-checks, and failures are audited and can be retried. Load-test with a full class in TEST before the first exam.
- **Roster freshness.** Enrollment comes from the synced course cache (15-minute sync). A student added minutes before the exam needs a Force Sync.
- **APSID check.** APSID can only be verified when the account email contains it (`name_aps1234@…`). Otherwise the entry is recorded as unverifiable; the account email is always stamped on the copy.
- **Client IP.** Apps Script does not expose it; recorded as "Not available". The session is recorded as a SHA-256 hash, never the token.
- **Font.** The watermark uses the standard PDF font, so non-Latin characters in a name print as `?`. The APSID and email still identify the student.
- **Rotated pages.** On pages with a `/Rotate` entry, the stamp is drawn in the unrotated page space. It is present but may appear rotated.

## Update — Sept 28, 2026: Question paper from a Google Drive link, and the global tooltip / help system

### 1. Question paper PDF now comes from Google Drive (no local upload)

The local file upload is gone. A question paper PDF is attached from a Google Drive link in one of two ways:

- **Typed link.** Paste one Drive link in the form, or in *Attach / replace PDF (Drive link)*. That file is used for every selected record.
- **Blank link.** The server looks up each record's link in the school's sheet **`LIVE_QUESTION_PAPER_DOWNLOAD_LINK`**. This is how one click covers every grade.
  - The sheet lives in spreadsheet `LIVE_QUESTION_PAPER_SPREADSHEET_ID` and has the columns `NILAI | TITLE | QUESTION PAPER DOWNLOAD LINK`.
  - Rows are matched on NILAI + TITLE, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation. `NILAI 2`, `Nilai-2` and `2` are the same grade; `MODELEXAM 1` and `Model Exam 1` are the same title.
  - A record with no matching row is reported as **SKIPPED**, with the reason.

Server entry point: `attachExamQuestionPaperLink(sessionToken, { questionPaperIds, driveLink, reason })`. It returns `{ results: [{ questionPaperId, className, status: SUCCESS|SKIPPED|FAILED, message }], updated }`. Other rules:

- Only Admin can attach, or HM when `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_HM_CAN_MANAGE=true`. BOD is read-only.
- A replacement needs a reason, and is refused once the paper has been released.
- Accepted files: a PDF, or a Google Doc / Slides / Sheet, which is exported to PDF.
- Each Drive file is read once, checked (not encrypted, has pages) and stamped once with pdf-lib as a test.
- The file is then **copied into the private Originals folder**. Later edits or sharing changes on the linked file never change a published paper. The source link and file id are kept in the record (`Source_Drive_Link`, `Source_Drive_File_ID`) and in the version history.
- **Sharing requirement.** The Web App runs as the owner ("Execute as: Me"), so every linked file must be shared with the owner account (Viewer is enough). If it isn't, the result says so and names that account.
- The link sheet is **read-only**. The dashboard never writes to it.
- The download audit moved to its own sheet, **`EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_DOWNLOAD_AUDIT`** (`EXAM_QP_CONFIG.SHEET_DOWNLOADS`). It is created automatically. The other sheets are unchanged: `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPERS`, `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_DOWNLOAD_SUMMARY`, `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_AUDIT`.

### 2. `ReferenceError: examQpLoadPdfLib_ is not defined`: add PdfLib.gs

pdf-lib is bundled in the project file **`PdfLib.gs`**. No code is ever downloaded at run time. That file must exist in the Apps Script project. To add it:

1. In the Apps Script editor, click **+ → Script** and name it `PdfLib`.
2. Paste the contents of `PdfLib.gs` and save.
3. Deploy a new version.

`examQpPdfLib_()` now shows this setup message instead of the raw ReferenceError.

### 3. Global tooltip, help text and user guidance (whole application)

There is one reusable system at the end of `Dashboard.html`. There is no per-button tooltip code anywhere.

| Part | What it does |
|---|---|
| `APS_HELP_TEXT` | **The only place wording lives.** `generic` (by button label), `byId`, `selectors` (dynamic rows, cards, links, QP actions; values may be functions for dynamic text), `tiles`, `status` (every badge value), `headers` (table columns), `info` (ⓘ next to fields), `screens` (role-aware Help per screen: `common` + `admin` / `hm` / `bod` / `teacher` / `student`). |
| `ApsTooltip` | Adds `data-tooltip` and an accessible name to every button, link, field, tab, badge and column header, including content rendered later (MutationObserver, debounced 120 ms). |
| `ApsHelp` | Adds an **ⓘ Help** button to every major screen. It opens a role-aware panel (`#apsHelpOverlay`). |

**How a tooltip is chosen:** explicit `data-tooltip` (with `data-aps-own-tip`), then `byId`, then `selectors`, then status badge, then column header, then the page's own `title`, then the generic button label.

**Behaviour:**

- One consistent bubble (`.aps-tip`, max 320 px, `role="tooltip"`, `aria-describedby`).
- It appears on hover, on keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`) and on long-press (500 ms) on touch screens. Tapping an ⓘ icon or a status badge toggles it. Escape and scrolling hide it.
- Icon-only buttons and unlabeled fields get an `aria-label`.
- Badges become keyboard-focusable.
- Disabled controls keep a native `title` explaining why they are unavailable. BOD users see "read-only"; other roles see "complete the required fields or earlier steps first". The attribute writes are idempotent, so the observer settles after one pass.
- Bare "Loading…" placeholders become "Loading the latest information — please wait…" with `role="status"`.

**Other guidance improvements:**

- **Errors.** `apsFriendlyError_()` is used by `showToast(…, true)` and `examErrMsg_`. It turns technical runtime errors (ReferenceError/TypeError, quota, timeout, network, server 5xx) into plain language: what happened, what to do, and the time to quote to APS Tech Support. The raw text goes to the browser console. Messages written for people pass through unchanged.
- **Toast.** Now `role="status"`; long messages stay on screen longer.
- **Empty states and confirmations.** Clearer empty states (with next steps) in Question Paper, Examination history, Assign Classroom and Classes. Consequence text added to the Reference Letter approve/reject and Remove Role confirmations. Question Paper confirmations already explained consequences.
- **Dynamic tooltip.** The Release cell says, for example, "Students can download from 10/16/2026 06:15 PM EST, which is 15 minutes before the 06:30 PM EST class start. Based on server time…".
- **QP help block.** The "How Exam Question Papers work" block is role-aware: staff and students see different text.

**Adding a future module:**

1. Add its wording to `APS_HELP_TEXT`: a `byId` entry per static control, a `selectors` entry for rendered rows, `status` entries for new badge values, and a `screens.<viewId>` entry with per-role text so the Help button appears.
2. Use `data-tooltip` + `data-aps-own-tip="1"` only for values computed at render time.

Nothing else is needed. `test/ui_help.js` fails if any visible control on any screen, for any role, has no guidance or no accessible name.

**Tests:** `test/qp.js` (26: Drive-link attach, link sheet lookup, SKIPPED rows, link sheet never written, PdfLib setup message) and `test/ui_help.js` (11: every tab and control for Admin/HM/BOD/Teacher/Student, keyboard, hover, disabled reason, late content, badges, role-aware Help, student never sees admin text, mobile long-press at 375 px). The full regression passes (11 suites).

**Known limits:**

- Wording for rarely shown admin screens (Class Change approvals, User Roles tables) comes from the generic label rules unless a specific entry exists.
- Charts: the dashboard has no chart components today.
- Server error texts written before this change are shown as written, unless they are technical.


### Update — PdfLib.gs setup troubleshooting (Sept 28, 2026)

- **PdfLib.gs is now line-wrapped** (about 1,466 lines instead of one 524 KB line). The code is the same, re-emitted by terser without compression or renaming. The Apps Script editor handles it far better when pasting. The old single-line file could fail to paste or save completely.
- **Clearer setup error.** `examQpPdfLib_()` now reports the real cause:
  - "PdfLib" was added as an **HTML** file instead of a Script file; or
  - the **running web-app version** does not contain PdfLib.gs. A deployment keeps serving the version it was created with, so after adding the file choose Deploy > Manage deployments > Edit (pencil) > Version: **New version** > Deploy.
- **New editor check: `checkExamQuestionPaperSetup()`.** Select it and click Run, then open Logs. If it says OK in the editor but the web app still says "Setup needed", the deployment is an old version. It returns only a status line.


### Update — Exam Schedule: default class day & time, or a custom date & time (Sept 28, 2026)

The Add / Edit Exam Question Paper form has a new **Exam Schedule** choice:

- **Class day & time (default, unchanged logic).** Pick any date in the exam week. Each class uses its own class day in that week (FRI/SAT/SUN) and its start/end time from the class name. With exactly one class selected, its times can be adjusted.
- **Custom date & time.** The Admin picks the **exact exam date** and a **Start Time (EST)**, used for **every selected class**.
  - End Time is optional. The default is the class's usual length, or 90 minutes if the class name has no times.
  - Release = custom start − release-window minutes. Close = custom start, or end if "allow until class end" is set.
  - Refused if End ≤ Start, if Start Time is missing, or if the resulting release time has already passed.

**Data:**

- New column **`Schedule_Mode`** (`CLASS` / `CUSTOM`) in `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPERS`. It is appended automatically to existing sheets.
- `Day` holds the actual weekday of the exam date.
- Records without `Schedule_Mode` are shown as CLASS if their date/time match the class schedule, otherwise CUSTOM (`examQpScheduleModeOf_`).
- Edit can switch modes:
  - CLASS moves the paper back to the class's day in the chosen week, with the class times.
  - CUSTOM uses the given date/time.
  - The "already released" and "would release immediately" guards still apply.
- `saveExamQuestionPaper` payload gains `scheduleMode`. Audit metadata records it.

**Tests:** `qp.js` (27) covers custom create, validation, past-release refusal, editing between modes and inference for old records. `ui_qp.js` (11) covers the form in Custom mode with 2 classes.


### Update — Per-student DOWNLOAD KEY for plain-paper answer sheets (Sept 28, 2026)

Many students have no printer, so they write the exam on plain paper and upload a photo or screenshot to Google Classroom. Each student's copy now carries a unique **DOWNLOAD KEY** (the answer-sheet key) that ties the uploaded answer sheet to that student's download record.

**Key design:**

- **Format:** `XXX-XXX-XXX`. It only uses characters that are hard to confuse when handwritten (no 0/O, 1/I/L).
- **Unique per student + question paper.** It is derived with HMAC-SHA256 from `Question_Paper_ID|student email` and a private Script Property **`EXAM_QP_DOWNLOAD_KEY_SECRET`**. The secret is created automatically once, under the script lock. **Do not change or delete it**, or existing keys stop matching.
- **Same key on every re-download**, so a key already written on the answer sheet stays valid.
- **Cannot be guessed** from a student's name or APSID.

**On the paper:**

- Printed in **red, 14 pt bold**, inside a thin red frame (no fill, so no exam content is hidden).
- Centred at the **top and bottom of every page**, with "Write this key at the top of your answer sheet". Works on portrait and landscape pages.

**Recorded:**

- New column **`Download_Key`** in `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_DOWNLOAD_AUDIT` (on DOWNLOAD_COMPLETED rows) and in `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_DOWNLOAD_SUMMARY`. Both columns are appended automatically.
- Also in the audit metadata, the monitoring Students and Download Activity views (new **Download Key** column), and the CSV export (last column).

**Students are told:**

- **Before downloading:** the confirmation dialog explains the key and the plain-paper instruction.
- **After downloading:** the success box shows the key large, in red, with the instruction.
- **Later:** the paper card shows "Your download key: …" after the first download.
- Help texts and tooltips cover the key for students, teachers and admins.

**Verifying an uploaded answer sheet:** type the key written on it into the Question Paper **Search**, in any case, with or without dashes. The matching student, class and download time appear. Teachers only ever see their own classes.

**Tests:** `qp.js` (28) checks key format, top + bottom on every page, audit + summary columns, same key on re-download, different key per student and per paper, the student view, search without dashes, CSV and the secret. `ui_qp.js` (11) checks the dialog note, the red and large key in the success box, the PDF key matching the displayed key, the student card, and a teacher search by key.

## Update — Examination > Grading: Google Classroom Grades (Oct 1, 2026)

The **Grading** sub-tab under **Examination** shows the data of the Google Classroom **Grades** tab for every ACTIVE classroom whose name ends with `AY26-27`. Attendance items (titles starting with `ATT_LSN`, e.g. `ATT_LSN_1`) are excluded.

**Every role sees only the classrooms it is assigned to:**

- Admin, HM, BOD and Teacher see classrooms where they are an ACTIVE teacher.
- Students see classrooms where they are an ACTIVE student, and only their own rows.
- No teacher names or emails are shown or sent to the browser.

The Classroom roster is still captured behind the scenes (`Roster_*` sheets). It supplies student names, emails and APSIDs, and it decides who is assigned to which classroom. The earlier roster views (Overview / Classrooms / Students / Teachers) were replaced by the grade views.

### 1. What the user sees

**Grades** (Admin / HM / BOD / Teacher) — like the Classroom Grades tab.
- One row per student per classroom: Student Name, Student Email Address (+ APSID), Google Classroom Name (+ schedule), Overall %.
- For every assignment (HW_LSN_n, QUZ_LSN_n and any other non-attendance assignment) there are two columns:
  - **Graded Mark**: mark / max points, plus the status chip underneath. **The mark is shown only when GRADED.** UNGRADED cells show no mark (no draft mark, no "— / max"). Draft marks are never sent to the browser.
  - **Graded Type**: **GRADED** (the teacher entered a mark) or **UNGRADED** (no mark yet).
- Columns are in lesson order (HW_LSN_1, QUZ_LSN_1, HW_LSN_2 …), then other assignments by assigned date.
- Each column header shows the points ("Out of 10") and the class average.

**Assignment Report** (all roles).
- One row per student × assignment: Student Name, Student Email Address, Google Classroom Name, Assignment, Assigned Date, Due Date, Turned In Date, Graded Mark, Graded Type, Graded Date, Status.
- **Assigned Date, Due Date and Turned In Date are shown as MM/DD** (EST); hover shows the full date and time. The CSV keeps the full date and time.
- Status values:
  - **Assigned** — not turned in, not yet due.
  - **Turned in** — submitted, waiting for the teacher.
  - **Turned in · Late** — submitted after the due date.
  - **COMPLETED** — the teacher returned it (Classroom state RETURNED is displayed as COMPLETED, on screen and in the CSV).
  - **Missing** — past due and not turned in.
  - **Reclaimed by student** — the student un-submitted it.

**Student** — "My Grades" and "My Assignments", own rows only, mobile friendly.

**Shared by all views:**
- Summary cards: Students in view, Assignments, Graded, Turned in not graded yet, Missing, Average mark.
- Filters: search, Nilai, Classroom, Assignment, Status, Graded type, Assigned from/to, Active/Inactive students. Every change refreshes the results immediately, with no Google API call.
- Export CSV: Admin, HM and Teacher, own scope only. Generated on the server, so it matches the screen.
- **Sync Now** (Admin / Super Admin only, always visible to them) with statistics and per-classroom errors.

**Note shown to everyone:**

> **Note:** If you want to make a change to any grade value, contact your Class Teacher / Head Master to update it in Google Classroom (the respective classroom, under the **Grades** tab). Updated records appear here after the next data refresh — **next data refresh planned: <date/time EST> (every N hours)**.

The planned date is the next daily automatic sync (5:00 PM EST by default). When automatic sync is switched off, the note says the refresh happens when an Admin runs Sync Now.

### 2. Minimal Google API usage

A sync makes, per classroom:

1. `CourseWork.list` — PUBLISHED only, with a `fields` mask. Usually 1 call.
2. **One** `StudentSubmissions.list(courseId, '-')` stream for the whole classroom, never one call per assignment, with a `fields` mask. It is skipped when the classroom has no non-attendance assignment.

Typical cost is **2 calls per classroom**. Other savings:
- Students are matched by Google user id against the roster, so there are no profile lookups.
- The classroom list comes from the roster.
- The roster itself (Courses / Teachers / Students lists) is refreshed only when it is older than `APS_GRADING_ROSTER_REFRESH_HOURS` (default 12), when the last roster sync failed or was partial, or when the "Also refresh class rosters" box is ticked.
- If the service rejects the `fields` mask, the sync retries once without it.
- Views, search, filters and export never call Google.

### 3. Sync behaviour

- **Upsert:** keys are `Course_ID|CourseWork_ID` (assignments) and `Course_ID|CourseWork_ID|User_ID` (submissions). There are no duplicates, and each sheet is written with one bulk `setValues`.
- **Removed assignments:** an assignment deleted or unpublished in Classroom becomes Status `REMOVED` and is hidden.
- **Students who leave:** they become INACTIVE in the roster. Their grades are kept and shown with the "Inactive students" filter.
- **Errors** are isolated per classroom (Classroom, Course ID, Operation, Error, Timestamp). That classroom keeps its previous grades.
- **Time budget:** 3.5 minutes in total. The roster gets up to 60 % of it. Classrooms that don't fit are deferred and processed first next time (result PARTIAL).
- **One sync at a time:** a second Sync Now is refused while one is running.
- **Safety:** if Classroom suddenly returns no matching classrooms, or fewer than half the previously active ones, the roster does not mark anything INACTIVE.
- **Reads:** per-classroom CacheService entries keyed by a data generation that every sync bumps. A request reads only the classrooms it may see.

### 4. Script Properties

| Property | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `APS_CLASSROOM_ROSTER_ENABLED` | `true` | `false` hides Grading and the server refuses every call. Cached, so it applies within 5 min. |
| `APS_DAILY_SYNC_ENABLED` | `true` | Daily automatic run of every Sync Now / Force Sync (see the update below). |
| `APS_DAILY_SYNC_HOUR` | `17` | Hour (America/New_York) of the daily run; also used for the "next data refresh" note. |
| `APS_CLASSROOM_ROSTER_ACADEMIC_YEAR` | from `COURSE_NAME_SUFFIX` | `2026-2027` → courses ending with `AY26-27`. |
| `APS_GRADING_EXCLUDE_PREFIXES` | `ATT_LSN` | Comma list of title prefixes never captured. Spacing, case and punctuation are ignored. |
| `APS_GRADING_ROSTER_REFRESH_HOURS` | `12` | Re-read the class rosters at most this often. |
| `APS_GRADING_ALL_CLASSES_ROLES` | *(empty)* | e.g. `ADMIN,HM` lets those roles see every classroom instead of only assigned ones. Teacher and Student are never widened. |
| `APS_CLASSROOM_ROSTER_INCLUDE_INVITATIONS` | `false` | Roster: also store pending invitations (extra API calls). |

The dashboard manages these internal properties itself. Do not edit them: `GRADES_LAST_SYNC_JSON`, `GRADES_DATA_GEN`, `GRADES_DEFERRED`, `ROSTER_LAST_SYNC_JSON`, `ROSTER_SYNC_RUNNING`, `ROSTER_DEFERRED`, `ROSTER_DATA_GEN`, `ROSTER_TRIGGER_SPEC`.

### 5. Sheets (created automatically in the dashboard workbook)

- **`Grading_CourseWork`** (key `Work_Key`): Course_ID, CourseWork_ID, Title, Work_Type, Max_Points, Assigned_Date, Due_Date (EST), Lesson_No, State, Status (ACTIVE / REMOVED), First_Seen, Last_Synced.
- **`Grading_Submissions`** (key `Submission_Key`): Course_ID, CourseWork_ID, Student_User_ID, Student_Email, Student_Name, APSID, State, Late, Assigned_Grade, Draft_Grade, Turn_In_Date, Graded_Date, Returned_Date, Update_Time, Last_Synced.
- **`Roster_Classrooms`**, **`Roster_Teachers`**, **`Roster_Students`**: the roster behind the grades (classroom details and Nilai parsing, teachers, students, ACTIVE / INVITED / INACTIVE, First / Last seen).
- **`Roster_Sync_Log`**: one row per roster run.
- **`Roster_Audit_Log`**: security audit (Timestamp, User, APSID, Role, Action, Course_ID, Result, Detail). It records every DENIED request, sync and export; views are logged at most once per 30 min. No tokens or credentials are logged.

### 6. Endpoints and authorization (server-side)

| Endpoint | Who | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `getGradingData()` | every role with Grading access | Only assigned classrooms (`gradingScope_`). Teachers of a classroom get all its students; students get only their own rows. No teacher data. |
| `exportGrading(filters)` | Admin, HM, Teacher | Same scope. A `courseId` outside the scope is refused and audited. |
| `syncGrading({refreshRoster})` | Admin / Super Admin only | Anyone else: "Access denied. You do not have permission to synchronize Google Classroom grades." |
| `classroomRosterAutoSync(e)` | installed trigger only | Refuses any call without the id of an installed trigger. |
| `parseAPSClassroomName(name)` | pure parser | No data access. |

The earlier roster endpoints (`getClassroomRoster`, `getClassroomRosterDetail`, `getClassroomRosterStudent`, `exportClassroomRoster`, `syncClassroomRoster`, `getClassroomRosterSyncStatus`) were removed as unused.

### 7. Setup

1. Paste the new `Code.gs` and `Dashboard.html`, save, and deploy a new version.
2. As Admin, open Examination → Grading → **Sync Now**. Tick "Also refresh class rosters" for the first run.
3. Automatic refresh runs every day at 5:00 PM EST by default (see the daily-sync update below). It is installed on the first Admin visit; the note shows the next planned refresh.
4. Sync Now is Admin-only. Admin and HM see only classrooms they are a teacher of. To give them every classroom, set `APS_GRADING_ALL_CLASSES_ROLES=ADMIN,HM`.

### 8. Tests

- **`test/grading.js` (17 tests):**
  - parser, role gate, kill switch;
  - more than 100 classrooms through pagination; a 150-submission class (2 pages);
  - ATT_LSN and draft assignments excluded;
  - exactly 2 API calls per classroom, with fields masks;
  - status mapping (Returned / Turned in · Late / Assigned / draft / Reclaimed / Missing / no-submission rows);
  - upsert with no duplicates; roster not re-read while fresh;
  - removed assignment hidden; fields fallback;
  - per-classroom errors; deferral;
  - assigned-only access for Admin / HM / BOD / Teacher / Student;
  - no teacher data in any response;
  - export scope; next-refresh note; trigger;
  - roster inactive handling and safety; single-run guard; cache.
- **`test/ui_grading.js` (7 browser tests):**
  - Admin matrix (headers, marks, chips, no ATT, no teacher details, note);
  - automatic filter refresh; Assignment Report columns; filtered CSV;
  - Sync Now dialog and statistics;
  - HM; BOD empty state;
  - Teacher (own classes, export, server refuses another class);
  - Student at 375 px (own rows only, no horizontal scroll).
- The full existing regression passes.

### 9. Rollback

- **Fast:** `APS_CLASSROOM_ROSTER_ENABLED=false`.
- **Stop automatic sync:** `APS_DAILY_SYNC_ENABLED=false`.
- **Full:** redeploy `CURRENT_PROD_CODE`. The `Grading_*` and `Roster_*` sheets can stay; nothing else reads them.

### 10. Known limits

- Grades come only from Google Classroom. A change must be made by the Class Teacher / Head Master in Classroom; it appears here after the next sync.
- The Classroom API exposes only the overall mark per submission, not rubric details or private comments.
- APSID comes from the email (`APSXXX` when absent). There is no Zoho data source in this codebase.
- Export is CSV (opens in Excel). There is no native .xlsx.
- Tooltip system fixes found while testing:
  - if focusing a control scrolled the page, that scroll closed a keyboard user's tooltip; scrolls within 400 ms of showing a tooltip are now ignored;
  - grade status chips stay out of the Tab order so a large matrix is not thousands of Tab stops.

### Update — Buttons that use Google API quota are Admin-only (Oct 1, 2026)

Every button that spends Google API quota is shown to **Admin / Super Admin only**, and the server enforces the same rule:

| Button | Where | Before | Now (UI + server) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sync Now** | Examination → Grading | Admin, HM | Admin only; **always visible** to Admin, even if the grades fail to load |
| **Sync Attendance Now** | Attendance | Admin, HM | Admin only (`forceSyncAttendanceNow`) |
| **DONOTUSE($$) / Force Sync** | Classes toolbar | Admin (UI), Admin + HM (server) | Admin only (`forceSyncClassroomData`) |
| **Refresh classrooms** | Examination | Admin, BOD | Admin only. For anyone else, `getExaminationCourseOptions({forceRefresh})` ignores the force flag and returns the cached list. |

Not changed:
- Announcements, Classwork and Exam Question Paper actions were already Admin-only. The one exception is the existing `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_HM_CAN_MANAGE` option.
- Scheduled (trigger) syncs are unaffected.
- HM keeps view, filter and export.

### Update — Every Sync Now / Force Sync also runs automatically every day at 5:00 PM EST (Oct 1, 2026)

Each Admin sync button now also runs by itself **every day at 5:00 PM America/New_York**. There is one time-driven trigger per job, so each job gets its own 6-minute run:

| Trigger handler | Runs | Same as the button |
|---|---|---|
| `apsDailyForceSync` | `syncClassroomData()` | Classes → Force Sync (DONOTUSE($$)) |
| `apsDailyAttendanceSync` | `syncAttendanceForAllCourses({ full: true })` | Attendance → Sync Attendance Now (full refresh from Week 1; updates rows, never duplicates) |
| `classroomRosterAutoSync` | `gradingRunSync_()` (roster when stale + grades) | Examination → Grading → Sync Now |

How it is set up and controlled:

- **Installed automatically.** The first time an Admin opens the dashboard after deployment, the triggers are created, and the dashboard re-checks them at most every 6 hours (one CacheService read otherwise). No editor step is needed. The installer is `rosterEnsureTrigger_`, which also removes duplicate triggers.
- **Change the time:** `APS_DAILY_SYNC_HOUR` (0–23, default `17`). Apps Script runs an `atHour(17).nearMinute(0)` trigger within about ±15 minutes of 5:00 PM.
- **Switch off:** `APS_DAILY_SYNC_ENABLED=false` (default `true`). The triggers are removed at the next Admin visit, and the handlers skip work in the meantime.
- **Existing schedules are unchanged:** the 15-minute Classroom sync (`createSyncTrigger`) and the Monday 5 AM attendance sync plus 7 AM report (`createAttendanceSyncTrigger`).
- **This replaces the earlier interval properties:** `APS_CLASSROOM_ROSTER_SYNC_ENABLED` and `APS_CLASSROOM_ROSTER_SYNC_HOURS` are no longer used.
- **Grading note:** shows "next data refresh planned: <next 5:00 PM EST> (automatic, every day at 5:00 PM EST)".
- **Security:** the handlers are public only because triggers require public functions. Each one refuses any call that does not carry the id of its own installed trigger.
- **API cost:** the daily full attendance sync re-reads every week since Week 1 (like the button) and is the heaviest of the three. If quota becomes a concern, set `APS_DAILY_SYNC_ENABLED=false`.

## Weekly Class Teacher Availability Email Report (Oct 2026)

**What it does.** Teachers record each school week which Nilai they can teach and at which class times. Admin, Super Admin and HM see the weekly report on the dashboard; BOD sees it read-only. One consolidated email (HTML with a plain-text fallback) goes out automatically **Tuesday to Friday at 6:00 PM America/New_York**. Nothing is sent on Monday, Saturday or Sunday.

**Week.** The week key is `getCurrentWeekId_()`, the same Friday-anchored `WK-YYYY-MM-DD` key the class-card "This Week" availability uses. From Monday to Thursday it points to the coming Fri–Sun class block.

**Data sources.** All are read fresh on every run; no data is duplicated.

| Source | Use |
|---|---|
| `Teacher_Availability_Selection` (new sheet) | One row per Week ID + teacher email. Columns: Week ID, Academic Year, Teacher Email, Teacher Name, APSID, Nilai, Available Time, Status, Submitted At, Updated At, Updated By Email. Status uses the existing `AVAILABILITY_STATUS` codes (`confirmed` / `not_available` / `pending`). |
| `Teacher_Weekly_Availability` (existing) | Fallback for a teacher who has not filled in the form: any class confirmed → AVAILABLE (Nilai/time taken from those class names); otherwise any not_available → NOT AVAILABLE. |
| Courses cache (existing) | AY classrooms (name ends with the academic year) and their teachers, **matched by email only**. "Not Assigned" when a teacher has none. Support accounts, hidden staff and HM/Admin co-teachers are skipped. |
| `Dashboard_User_Roles` (existing) | Active `teacher` users, so a teacher without a classroom and without a submission still appears as NOT SUBMITTED. |

**Options.**
- Nilai options come from `NILAI_FILTER_OPTIONS`.
- Time options come from `CLASS_TIME_FILTER_OPTIONS`, the existing class schedule list.
- Neither list is hard-coded a second time.

**Statuses.**
- Row statuses: AVAILABLE, NOT AVAILABLE, PENDING and NOT SUBMITTED.
- SUBMITTED is used for a stored answer that has no recognised status. It also appears in the summary as the count of submissions.
- Missing values show as "Not Assigned" or "Not Selected".

**Email.**
- Subject: `APS Weekly Class Teacher Availability Report – <Day>, MM/DD/YYYY`.
- Sections:
  1. "Vanakkam" opening.
  2. Summary: total, submitted, not submitted, available, not available, with and without Google Classroom, and available grade/time combinations out of the possible ones.
  3. Grade-wise view.
  4. Time-wise view.
  5. **Teacher Availability Status – Complete List**, with columns # | Teacher Name | APS Email | Google Classroom | Nilai | Available Time | Status. It includes non-submitters.
  6. Closing: "Regards, APS Tech Support Team / Avvaiyar Padasalai / World's First Online Tamil School".
- Sent with the existing `sendApsHtmlEmail_` (MailApp, as the script owner). No credentials are stored or logged.

**Server functions.**

| Function | Who | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `getClassTeacherAvailabilityView(token)` | Teacher, Admin, Super Admin, HM, BOD | Teacher: own form and own AY classrooms. Staff/BOD: full report model. Recipients are shown to staff only. |
| `submitClassTeacherAvailability(token, {status, nilai[], times[]})` | Teacher only (own email) | Unknown values are dropped; the configured order is kept. AVAILABLE needs at least one Nilai and one time; NOT AVAILABLE clears both. Saved under a script lock (upsert). |
| `sendWeeklyClassTeacherAvailabilityReport(e)` | Time-driven trigger only | Refused unless `e.triggerUid` is its own installed trigger (`apsRequireTriggerCall_`). |
| `sendWeeklyClassTeacherAvailabilityTestEmail(token)` | Admin / Super Admin | See the test email details below. |
| `ctaRunScheduled_(now, runBy)` | internal | Checks, in order: enabled; Tue–Fri; send window (configured hour −20 min to +2 h, because triggers can fire up to 15 min early); recipients; script lock; once per calendar day (`CTA_EMAIL_LAST_SENT_DATE`). A failed send is not marked as sent. |
| `ctaEnsureTrigger_()` | internal | One daily trigger at the configured hour and time zone; Mon/Sat/Sun runs exit at once. Kept in line with the Script Properties from `rosterEnsureTrigger_` (Admin visits, at most every 6 h), so no editor step is needed. |

**Test email (`sendWeeklyClassTeacherAvailabilityTestEmail`).**
- Subject `[TEST] APS Weekly Class Teacher Availability Report – MM/DD/YYYY`, with a TEST banner.
- Recipients: `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_TEST_EMAIL_TO`, or else the Admin who clicked.
- Run from the editor with no session, it goes only to the script owner.
- Limited to one per minute.
- It ignores the day/time window and never marks the day as sent.

**Script Properties** (all optional).

| Property | Default |
|---|---|
| `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_EMAIL_ENABLED` | `true` (`false` also removes the trigger) |
| `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_EMAIL_TO` | `teachers@avvaiyarpadasalai.org,admin@avvaiyarpadasalai.org` |
| `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_TIMEZONE` | `America/New_York` |
| `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_HOUR` | `18` |
| `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_ACADEMIC_YEAR` | `AY26-27` (`COURSE_NAME_SUFFIX`) |
| `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_TEST_EMAIL_TO` | the Admin's own address |

Internal keys: `CTA_EMAIL_LAST_SENT_DATE` and `CTA_EMAIL_TRIGGER_SPEC`.

**Logging.**
- Sheet `Teacher_Availability_Email_Log`. Columns: Run At (EST), Type (SCHEDULED/TEST), Result (SENT/SKIPPED/FAILED), Report Date, Week ID, Recipients, Subject, counts, Message, Run By.
- Console lines are prefixed `[TeacherAvailabilityEmail]`.
- Routine skips (wrong day or hour) are only returned, not written to the sheet.

**Dashboard.**
- New tab **🧑‍🏫 Teacher Availability** (`#ctaView`). Shown to Teacher, Admin, Super Admin, HM and BOD; hidden for Student.
- Teacher view: Academic Year, name (APSID) and email, own AY classrooms, then Status radios, Nilai checkboxes and time checkboxes. Selecting NOT AVAILABLE greys out the Nilai and time choices. Submit saves the answer and shows a "Last updated" line.
- Staff view: summary tiles (Not Submitted / Available / Not Available tiles filter the list) and a schedule note.
- Views: Complete List, Grade-wise and Time-wise. Search and the Nilai / time / status dropdowns refresh the view automatically on the client.
- **Send Test Email** is Admin only.
- Uses one server call per visit. Tooltips and the role-aware ⓘ Help panel are included.

**Tests.**
- `test/cta.js`: 7 server tests covering validation and roles, the report model, HTML/text and size, day gating and duplicate guard, trigger install and uid guard, the test email, and the view payload by role.
- `test/ui_cta.js`: 6 Chromium tests covering Teacher, Admin, HM, BOD, Student and mobile.

### Fine-tune / bug-fix round (Oct 1, 2026)

**Production error: "You do not have permission to call classroom.courses.courseWork.list. Required permissions: …/classroom.coursework.students".**
- Cause: the Apps Script project that runs in production is not authorized for the `classroom.coursework.students` scope. Grading (Examination › Grading › Sync Now and the 5 PM daily sync) needs this scope to *list* assignments and student submissions; it only reads them.
- The project's `appsscript.json` already declares the scope. The error therefore means one of two things:
  - (a) The production project's manifest was never updated. Pasting Code.gs does not change the manifest.
  - (b) The owner account has not re-consented since the scope was added. Declaring a scope does not grant it; only clicking Allow does.
- Fix (once, as the account the Web App runs as):
  1. Apps Script editor › Project Settings › tick "Show "appsscript.json" manifest file in editor".
  2. Open `appsscript.json` and make sure `oauthScopes` contains `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/classroom.coursework.students`. Easiest: paste the project's appsscript.json. Save.
  3. Select `apsOwnerReauthorizeAllScopes` in the function dropdown › Run › Review permissions › Allow.
  4. Check the execution log: every line should be PASS, including the two new "Classroom coursework list" / "Classroom student submissions list" lines.
  5. Deploy › Manage deployments › Edit › Version: New version › Deploy.
  6. Run Sync Now again.
- Code changes:
  - `rosterPermissionHint_(msg)` now reads the scope named in "Required permissions: …" and shows that exact scope plus the fix above. Before, it always blamed `classroom.courses.readonly` / `classroom.rosters`, which was misleading for this error.
  - `gradesSyncCore_` stops at the first classroom when the error is a missing scope. It throws one clear error and writes nothing, so stored grades are kept. Before, it repeated the failing call for every classroom (about 116 wasted API calls and 116 identical errors).
  - `apsOwnerReauthorizeAllScopes` (existing editor tool) has two new read-only probes: CourseWork.list and StudentSubmissions.list on the first ACTIVE classroom. Re-consent therefore covers, and verifies, the Grading scope.
- Other fixes:
  - **Trigger check after deploy.** The trigger-check cache key is now versioned (`APS_TRIGGER_CHECK_KEY_ = 'apsTriggersChecked_v2'`, which replaces `apsDailySyncChecked`). A newly deployed version that adds a trigger (the Teacher Availability email) installs it on the first Admin visit. Before, it could wait up to 6 hours for the old cache key to expire, which could miss a 6 PM send on deployment day.
  - **Test email retry.** If a Teacher Availability test email fails to send, the one-per-minute limit is cleared, so the Admin can retry at once. A double click still cannot send twice.
- Static checks (whole project, not only the changes):
  - No undefined `*_` helper calls; the only hits were in comments.
  - No duplicate function names across Code.gs and PdfLib.gs (one Apps Script global namespace).
  - No duplicate top-level variables.
  - Every `google.script.run` call made from Dashboard.html has a matching public function.
  - Every public function added since production checks the session/role, or is a trigger handler guarded by `apsRequireTriggerCall_`.

### Weekly Class Teacher Availability Report — upcoming-week grade-level report (Oct 1, 2026)

**Purpose.** Lets Admin/HM see, for the **upcoming class week only**:
- how many classes need coverage;
- how many teachers confirmed;
- how many said Not Available;
- how many have not answered;
- who needs follow-up.

The report and the email show the same data.

**Business rules** (`ctaBuildReport_`). Both the dashboard and the email use the same rules.
- **Week:** `getCurrentWeekId_()`, the Friday-anchored Fri–Sun block. From Monday to Thursday it points to the coming weekend. Only rows of that Week ID in `Teacher_Weekly_Availability` are read, so past weeks are never mixed in. Shown as "Upcoming Week: Oct 2 - Oct 4, 2026".
- **Classes:** the courses cache (already ACTIVE-only), filtered to names ending with `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_ACADEMIC_YEAR` (default AY26-27). `courseState` is also checked when present. Nilai comes from `extractNilaiFromCourseName_`.
- **Status per class:** the existing class-card answer, nothing new is stored.
  - `confirmed` = Available.
  - `not_available` = Not Available, with who set it, when, and the arrangement, shown with the class-card wording via `ctaAvailText_`.
  - no row, or `pending` (reset) = Not Set.
  - Not Available and Not Set are never combined.
- **Teacher of a class:** the first class teacher on the course who is neither a support account nor excluded.
- **Exclusions** (`ctaExcludeRule_` / `ctaExcluded_`). The same rule applies to the Complete List, the counts, the follow-up lists and the email:
  - `isRosterHiddenStaffEmail_`: HEADMASTER_EMAILS + ADMIN_EMAILS + ROSTER_HIDDEN_STAFF_ADDITIONAL_EMAILS.
  - SUPERADMIN_EMAILS.
  - Dashboard_User_Roles users whose role is admin, headmaster, superadmin or vcfo_amchsts_bod.
  - Emails starting with `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_EXCLUDE_PREFIXES` (default `tts_`, not case-sensitive).
  - `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_EXCLUDE_EMAILS` (default `vsugadev@avvaiyarpadasalai.org`).
- **Counts** are per class: each class is in exactly one of Available, Not Available or Not Set, so they always add up to Total Classes. The summary also gives the number of distinct teachers. A class whose only teachers are excluded is counted and shows the teacher as "Not Assigned".

**New model fields.** `classSummary`, `gradeLevel[]`, `attention[]`.
- `classSummary`: `{classes, available, notAvailable, notSet, teachers, tAvailable, tNotAvailable, tNotSet}`.
- `gradeLevel[]`: `{nilai, classes, available, notAvailable, notSet}`, in `NILAI_FILTER_OPTIONS` order.
- `attention[]`: `{nilai, name, email, classroom, classStatus, status}` for every Not Available / Not Set class, sorted by Nilai then classroom.
- The existing `rows`, `byNilai` and `byTime` are unchanged; the dashboard's other views use them.

**Dashboard** (Classes › Teacher Availability Report, Admin/Super Admin/HM; BOD read-only):
- Header "Weekly Class Teacher Availability", "Upcoming Week: … · AY26-27".
- Four summary cards: Total Classes, Available to Take Class, Not Available to Take Class, Availability Not Set. The red and grey cards open their follow-up list. All cards have tooltips and keyboard support.
- The form-response tiles moved into a collapsed "Teacher form responses" section.
- New default view **Grade-level Status (This Week)**:
  - the grade table (rows with a gap are shaded; ⚠️ = no class of that Nilai has a confirmed teacher), plus a Total row;
  - **Teachers Requiring Follow-Up**, with separate tabs **🔴 Not Available to Take Class (n)** and **⚪ Availability Not Set (n)**, grouped by Nilai.
- The Nilai, status and search filters update the view immediately on the client; no server call.
- Complete List, Grade-wise and Time-wise views are unchanged.
- Mobile: cards in two columns, tables scroll inside their box, no page-level horizontal scroll.

**Email** (`ctaRenderHtml_` / `ctaRenderText_`). Subject unchanged. Sections, in order:
1. Title and "Upcoming Week".
2. Short intro.
3. The four summary cards.
4. Grade-Level Availability Summary, with a Total row.
5. Teachers Requiring Follow-Up — Not Available to Take Class (n).
6. Teachers Requiring Follow-Up — Availability Not Set (n).
7. Action reminder (open the dashboard, Classes › Teacher Availability Report or the class-card box, select, submit) with an **Open APS Dashboard** button. The button link is Script Property `APS_DASHBOARD_PUBLIC_URL`, default https://www.namaps.org/dashboard.
8. Closing.

The **Grade-wise (Nilai)**, **Time-wise** and **Complete List** sections were removed from the email; they remain on the dashboard. A 116-class week is about 56 KB, under Gmail's ~102 KB clipping limit. The `Teacher_Availability_Email_Log` Message column now records the class counts (no new columns).

**Weekly history.** No change is needed: every week already has its own rows (Week ID) in `Teacher_Weekly_Availability`. A read-only history view is a possible future step and is not built.

**Performance.**
- No new Google Classroom API calls.
- One read each of the courses cache, the selection sheet and the weekly availability sheet per request.
- The user-roles cache is reused.
- No sheet, column or trigger changes. `CTA_STATUS_COLOR_` was removed (no longer used).

**New Script Properties** (optional): `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_EXCLUDE_PREFIXES`, `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_EXCLUDE_EMAILS`, `APS_DASHBOARD_PUBLIC_URL`.

**Tests.**
- `test/cta.js`: 10 tests. New: upcoming week only; ACTIVE AY26-27 classes only; every exclusion type; grade-level counts; Not Available vs Not Set kept apart; configurable prefixes and button URL; email sections present and removed sections absent.
- `test/ui_cta.js`: 8 tests. New: summary cards add up; grade table; follow-up tabs; the Nilai filter refreshes the view; admin mobile view.

**Known limitations.**
- A class whose name has no recognisable Nilai is not counted in the grade table.
- A class created after the last course sync appears after the next sync (every 15 minutes, plus 5 PM daily).
- The name shown in a Not Available badge is the person who set the status (for example HM), as on the class card.
