## Role-based class access — Teacher / VP / HM from the Google Classroom Room and Description (Oct 2, 2026)

**Purpose.** A Teacher, Vice Principal or Head Master named in a class's Google Classroom **Room** or **Course Description** gets two things:
- **Google Classroom:** made a co-teacher of that class if not already one.
- **Dashboard:** access to that class only.

VP / HM also get **elevated (HM-level) actions on that class only**. Production Admin / HEADMASTER_EMAILS / Super Admin / BOD accounts and Dashboard_User_Roles keep their existing organisation-wide behaviour, unchanged.

**Authoritative format** (only labels decide the role; a username such as `vp.` / `hm.` never does):
- Room: `Teacher Email: a@… | VP Email: vp1@… ; vp2@… | HM Email: hm1@… ; hm2@…`. Separators are `;`, `,` or space; any number of addresses; `|` ends a label.
- Description: the same labels; an **unlabelled** email (e.g. `info@avvaiyarpadasalai.org`) = **Teacher** of the class. Unlabelled Room text is ignored.
- Only APS sign-in domains (`APS_ALLOWED_DOMAINS`) are used, so a parent's or outside address is ignored.
- Duplicates collapse to one record. An email named with two roles keeps the higher one: HM > VP > Teacher.

**Sync** (`syncClassroomData` → `buildCourseRecord_` → `classSupportForCourse_`). For every ACTIVE AY26-27 course:
1. Parse the Room and Description (`classSupportParse_`).
2. Every named person who is not yet a Classroom TEACHER is added with `Classroom.Courses.Teachers.create`. Each add is attempted once. Already a member → `DASHBOARD_ACCESS_ALREADY_EXISTS`. A failed add is audited and retried only after 6 hours. No add is attempted if the teacher list could not be read.
3. VP / HM are tagged `supportRole` in `course.teachers`. The card shows them as "VP · Class Support" / "HM · Class Support", and they are never the teacher of record (`primaryTeacherOf_`, Teacher Availability report). A named Teacher is shown as a normal teacher.
4. `course.classSupport = [{email, role, source, member, added}]` is stored in the courses cache.
5. `classSupportWriteMapping_` rebuilds **Class_Access_Map** (one row per email + course: Key, Email, APS Role, Course ID, Course Name, Classroom Role, Access Source, Dashboard Permission, Status, First Seen, Last Synced) with one read and one write, and appends changes to **Class_Access_Audit**.

The sync never removes anyone from Google Classroom. Someone taken out of the Room stays a Classroom teacher (plain teacher access) until removed in Classroom. The audit says so.

**Access sources and permissions.**

| Access source | Dashboard permission | APS role |
|---|---|---|
| `ROOM_VP`, `ROOM_HM`, `DESCRIPTION_VP`, `DESCRIPTION_HM` | `CLASS_SUPPORT` | VP / HM |
| `ROOM_TEACHER`, `DESCRIPTION_TEACHER` | `CLASS_TEACHER` | Teacher |
| `CLASSROOM_TEACHER` (from the Classroom roster) | `CLASS_TEACHER` | Teacher |

- Anyone in ADMIN / SUPERADMIN / HEADMASTER_EMAILS gets `ALL_CLASSES` (existing behaviour).
- Anyone not (yet) a Classroom teacher gets `NONE (not a Classroom teacher)`.

**Authorization** (server-side, every teacher-scoped check):
- `userHasCourseAccess_(email, course)` = Classroom TEACHER of the course **or** a VP / HM named in it **who is also a Classroom TEACHER**. Both are required, so a failed Classroom add grants nothing.
- It is used in: `getViewerRoleForEmail_` (sign-in role), `getViewerContext_` (class list), Teacher-not-in-class / Needs-tech-support stages, Teacher availability, attendance view and edit, Exam Question Paper monitoring, and chat class names.
- A Room VP / HM signs in with the class-scoped dashboard role `teacher`. The new `apsRole` (ADMIN > HM > VP > TEACHER, via `apsRoleFor_`) is shown as "Role: VP · Access: Class Support". Sign-in and `getDashboardData` both return `apsRole`, and every course in the viewer's list carries `viewerAccess {apsRole, source, permission, label}`.
- `classSupportElevated_(viewer, course)` gives a VP / HM the HM actions **for that class only**:
  - acknowledge / resolve Needs Tech Support and Teacher NOT in Class;
  - Cancel / Reschedule / Restore Class Status (`setClassStatusManual`);
  - see and edit every attendance row of the class, including teacher rows.

  Any other class is refused. The refusal is logged as `DASHBOARD_ACCESS_DENIED` (de-duplicated for 10 minutes per user / class / action).
- The client mirror `roleCanFor(action, card)` shows those buttons only on supported cards.
- Grading follows Classroom membership through the roster sync (roster refreshed when older than 12 h).

**Audit actions:**
- `CLASSROOM_TEACHER_ADDED` / `CLASSROOM_TEACHER_ADD_FAILED`
- `COURSE_ACCESS_MAPPING_CREATED` / `COURSE_ACCESS_MAPPING_UPDATED`
- `DASHBOARD_ACCESS_GRANTED` / `DASHBOARD_ACCESS_REMOVED` / `DASHBOARD_ACCESS_ALREADY_EXISTS` / `DASHBOARD_ACCESS_DENIED`

Columns: Timestamp, User Email, APS Role, Course ID, Course Name, Classroom Role, Access Source, Dashboard Permission, Action, Result, Error. An unchanged sync writes no audit rows.

**Switches** (Script Properties):
- `APS_CLASS_SUPPORT_ENABLED` (default `true`; `false` ignores Room / Description).
- `APS_CLASS_SUPPORT_ADD_TO_CLASSROOM` (default `true`; `false` never writes to Google Classroom, so only people who are already Classroom teachers get Class Support).

**Performance.** No extra list calls: Room and Description come from the existing `Courses.list`. `Teachers.create` is called only for missing members, once. The mapping is one sheet read and one write per sync. The audit is one batch append.

**Scopes.** `Teachers.create` uses `classroom.rosters` (already in appsscript.json). Adding someone from another domain may need a Classroom invitation; that add fails and is audited.

**Tests.**
- `test/classsupport.js`, 12 tests: parsing, duplicates, HM > VP, unlabelled Description = Teacher, outside domain ignored, no username inference, adds once, idempotent sync, mapping and audit, failed add, roles and priority, existing HM unchanged, visibility, server-side refusal of another courseId, elevated actions on own class only, Teacher Availability report, switches.
- `test/ui_classsupport.js`, 3 tests: VP/HM cards and labels, plain teacher unchanged, mobile.

**Known limitations.**
- The new role takes effect at the user's next sign-in (sessions keep the role they started with).
- A VP / HM added as a co-teacher is recorded in Attendance like any co-teacher, unless excluded (e.g. in HEADMASTER_EMAILS or `ATTENDANCE_EXCLUDED_EMAILS`).
- Removal from the Room does not remove Google Classroom membership.


## Round 25 (2026-10-02) — APS Classroom role model: Description = Primary Teacher, Room = VP / HM

**Source of truth (per ACTIVE AY26-27 course, read once per sync, paginated):**

| Google Classroom field | Rule | APS class role | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Course Description | every valid APS email | PRIMARY_TEACHER | COURSE_DESCRIPTION |
| Room `VP Email: a ; b` | emails up to the next label | VP | ROOM |
| Room `HM Email: c ; d` | emails up to the next label | HM | ROOM |
| Room email without a label | skipped + EMAIL_SKIPPED audit | — | ROOM |

- Separators `;` `,` `|` (a `|` without a new label keeps the previous label). Emails are trimmed, lower-cased, validated, de-duplicated; only APS_ALLOWED_DOMAINS.
- Email prefixes (tts_, tcs_, vp., hm.) never decide a role. A person named in the Description/Room is shown on the card and gets access even if HIDDEN_TEACHER_EMAIL_PREFIXES / the Hide toggle would hide the account.
- One record per user per course; roles merged (e.g. `[PRIMARY_TEACHER, HM]`). Header/primary role priority ADMIN > HM > VP > TEACHER.
- Empty Description → no primary teacher invented (teacher of record falls back to the first Classroom teacher, never a Room-only VP/HM). Empty Room → no VP/HM.
- Everyone named must be a Classroom TEACHER: missing people are added once (`Teachers.create`); failed adds give no access and are retried after 6 h.

**Display (Classes tab):** no Teacher/VP/HM email is shown anywhere. People get `(VP)` / `(HM)` tags; each card shows `Role: Primary Teacher + HM` (etc.) for a class-scoped viewer; header shows `Name · APSID (HM)`. Room text on cards = `roomDisplay` (labels + emails removed). Names of added people come from their Google profile; a profile without a name shows "Name not set in Google".

**Server-side:** `userHasCourseAccess_` = Classroom teacher OR named member; `classSupportElevated_` = VP/HM of THAT class (HM-level actions on that class only). `primaryTeacherOf_` prefers the Description primary. Teacher Availability report: class teacher = Description primary (report exclusion rules still apply); Room-only VP/HM never listed as class teacher.

**Sheets:** `Class_Access_Map` (Key, Email, APS Roles, Primary Role, Course ID, Course Name, Classroom Role, Source, Dashboard Permission, Status, First Seen, Last Synced); `Class_Access_Audit` (Timestamp (EST), Execution ID, Course ID, Course Name, Email, APS Role, Classroom Role, Source, Action, Result, Error Message). A sheet with an older header is renamed `<name>_old_<timestamp>` and a fresh one created. Actions: COURSE_ACCESS_MAPPING_CREATED/UPDATED, CLASS_ACCESS_GRANTED/REMOVED/ALREADY_EXISTS/DENIED, CLASSROOM_TEACHER_ADDED/ADD_FAILED, EMAIL_SKIPPED.

**Switches:** APS_CLASS_SUPPORT_ENABLED (default true), APS_CLASS_SUPPORT_ADD_TO_CLASSROOM (default true).

**Tests:** test/classsupport.js (19, incl. spec tests 1–11), test/ui_classsupport.js (3); full regression green.

## Round 31 (2026-10-05) — Primary Teacher authority, current-week attendance, On-Call capture, Grading filter + frozen Grades

**Primary Teacher (Classes tab, Teacher Availability report, login).** The Google Classroom Course Description is the only source of the Primary Teacher (`classSupportParse_` → `course.teachers[].apsRoles = ['PRIMARY_TEACHER']`), resolved once per course per sync and reused everywhere through `primaryTeacherOf_` (Classes card, teacher of record, availability status, Teacher Availability report). No email-prefix or name rule can hide or reject that person:
- shown on the card with the green "Primary Teacher" tag; the display name drops a trailing on-call tag (`teacherDisplayName_`: "Abitha Sri - TTS" → "Abitha Sri");
- if the Description email is not (yet) a Classroom teacher (add disabled / failed / pending), the card still shows them (`notInClassroom`, name from the email local part, never the email) and they get teacher-level access to THAT class (`classSupportGrantsAccess_`); VP / HM still need Classroom membership; Admin/HM rights are never granted by this;
- Teacher Availability report (`ctaBuildReport_`): the class teacher is the Description Primary Teacher whenever one exists — never "Not Assigned", whatever APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_EXCLUDE_* says; their real selection (Available / Not Available / Not Set) is shown. Classes without a named Primary Teacher keep the previous fallback.

**Attendance — current week only.** `syncAttendanceForAllCourses` (every path: 15-min / Monday 5 AM / daily 5 PM triggers, Admin "Sync Attendance Now", pre-report sync) writes only the current APS week's AWKnnATT sheet (`attCurrentSyncWeek_`, Friday-anchored weeks). Past weeks are skipped before any API call and the upsert step refuses any other sheet (defence in depth). `ATTENDANCE_PREVIOUS_WEEK_GRACE_HOURS` (default 8 = until Monday 8:00 AM ET) keeps the just-ended week writable for the existing Monday 5 AM trigger so Sunday-evening classes are still captured; set `0` for strictly the current week. Manual overrides are preserved by the upsert in every case.

**On-Call Teacher Attendance.** Every `TCS_` / `TTS_` teacher (any case) is captured: `attIsExcludedEmail_` no longer drops on-call accounts because of HIDDEN_TEACHER_EMAIL_PREFIXES (explicit lists such as ATTENDANCE_EXCLUDED_EMAILS still win); rostered on-call teachers kept off the class card come from `course.onCallTeacherCandidates` (`attRosterTeachers_`); `isOnCallTeacherEmail_` recognises TTS_ as well as TCS_. A joined on-call guest gets exactly one row (ON_CALL_GUEST).

**Examination > Grading — approved assignments only.** `gradesCategory_`: ATT_ → ATTENDANCE, HW_ → HOMEWORK, QUZ_ → QUIZ, TRMST → PROJECT WORK, MODEL_EXAM / EXAM → EXAMINATION (deterministic prefix on the trimmed upper-cased title). Applied before the submissions call in `gradesSyncCore_` and again in `getGradingData` (rows stored earlier never reach the browser). ATT_ items are now captured; `APS_GRADING_EXCLUDE_PREFIXES` default changed from `ATT_LSN` to none.

**Grades section UI.** Student Name · Student Email Address · Google Classroom Name · Overall stay frozen while assignments scroll (`grdFreezeCols_`; on narrow screens only the first column). Assignment columns: lesson/sequence number descending (numeric, LSN_10 before LSN_2), then HW, ATT, QUZ, TRMST, MODEL_EXAM, EXAM (`grdColSortDesc_`); category shown under each title.

**Tests:** classsupport 25, rules 39, e2e 41, grading 20, ui_grading 8 (frozen columns + order), all other suites green. Attendance tests now build history with one sync per week (`test/history.js`).

## Round 35 (2026-10-05) — Admin-only "GCM - Preview" tab + live Class Status from Google Meet

### A. Live Class Status (Classes tab) — root cause and fix
- **Root cause.** `applyClassStatus_` derived Class Started from `t.inMeet / s.inMeet`, which are captured only by `syncClassroomData` (now the once-a-day 5 PM sync) from `getMeetPresenceMap_` — a per-*email*, any-Meet signal, not class-specific. The Admin Reports Meet log has **no "joined" event** (only `call_ended`, written when a participant leaves), so during class nothing new appeared and running classes read "Scheduled" (before the scheduled minute, e.g. early starts) or "Yet to Start".
- **New module** `LIVE CLASS MEET STATUS` (end of Code.gs):
  - `classMeetOccurrence_(schedule, now)` — today's occurrence in America/New_York: window = start − 30 min (`ATTENDANCE_CALL_WINDOW_EARLY_MIN`) … end + 60 min (`CLASS_MEET_HARD_STOP_AFTER_END_MIN`).
  - `classMeetLiveSnapshot_(courses, now, force)` — only when ≥1 class is in its window; throttled to `CLASS_MEET_LIVE_REFRESH_SECONDS` (120 s) via CacheService `aps_class_meet_live_v1`, single-flight via `LockService.tryLock(0)`. Sources: (1) Meet REST `spaces/{code}` → `activeConference` + `participants?filter=latest_end_time IS NULL` with `UrlFetchApp.fetchAll` (codes the deploying account can't read are remembered 6 h in `aps_meet_rest_noaccess_v1`); (2) ONE Admin Reports `call_ended` query for the evening, attributed per class with the existing `attAttributeSessionsToClass_` (mapped code > teacher's code > students' code). Diagnostic → Script Property `classMeetLiveDiagnostic`.
  - `recordMeetJoinClick(token, courseId)` — public; session-verified email, must be the class's own teacher/student (`classMeetRoleOf_`: excludes `attIsExcludedEmail_` + roster-hidden staff), only inside the window; stored in CacheService `aps_meet_join_v1_<courseId>` (6 h).
  - `classMeetApplyLive_` — per course, from `applyClassStatus_` for today's occurrence (manual Cancel/Reschedule still checked first and wins). **Started** = ≥1 teacher AND ≥1 student signal (sticky via existing `classStartedMarkMap`). **Ended** = started and (REST says no active conference) or (now ≥ end + `CLASS_MEET_ENDED_GRACE_MIN` (10) and no activity for 10 min) or hard stop; sticky via new Script Property `classMeetEndedMarkMap` (entries > 24 h pruned). Never started and end + 10 min passed → Class Ended with "No Google Meet activity was detected". Sets `p.inMeet/online` for people seen in THIS class's Meet. Adds `c.classMeetDetail {text, teacherJoined, teacherJoinedAt, studentsJoined, liveNow, sources[], checkedAt, endedAt}` (no emails).
  - `refreshClassMeetLiveStatus(token)` — Admin/HM; forces a check; returns the diagnostic.
- `CLASS_STATUS_LABELS.completed` = **"Class Ended"** (code unchanged). Filter option text updated.
- Client: `renderClassStatusBadge` adds `.class-meet-detail` line for Admin/HM/teacher/BOD (students: badge only); tooltip lists sources + "checked h:mm EST". `a.meet-link[data-meet-course]` click → fire-and-forget `recordMeetJoinClick` (teacher/student roles only; never blocks the link).
- Limits (honest): if the deploying account cannot read a class's Meet space, a class joined from a saved link (not the dashboard) turns Started only when Google reports someone leaving (audit-log latency). No service-account / delegated credentials were added (standing rule: no credentials in Script Properties).

### B. GCM - Preview tab (Admin / Super Admin only)
- Server `getMeetPreviewData(token)`: `requireValidSession_` + `isAdminRole_` (HM, VP, teacher, student, BOD → "Access denied…"). Cache-only: `readAllCoursesFromCache_` → AY26-27 + ACTIVE (`courseNameMatches_`) → `applyLivePresence_`, `applyClassStatus_`, `applyMeetLinks_` (reused). No Classroom API calls, no N+1. Status LIVE / UPCOMING / COMPLETED (+CANCELLED/RESCHEDULED) from the schedule in EST, overridden by the live status (Class Started → LIVE, Class Ended → COMPLETED). Sort: status rank, Meet-confirmed started first, day, start, grade, section (`naturalCompareJs_`). Items carry no email addresses; Primary Teacher via `primaryTeacherOf_`, VP/HM via `roleTags`; Meet link validated (standard code or `lookup/`). ## Round 41 (2026-10-06) — Appreciation letters: placeholders inside text boxes were not merged (fix)
- **Symptom:** the emailed PDF still showed `{{STUDENT_FULLNAME}}`, `{{TEACHER_MESSAGE}}`, `{{ISSUE_DATE}}`.
- **Root cause:** in template `1-k45mRP1vb0m8mhurUpHxBjeRI7N4V-Iw_XzQm4GsiE` the placeholders are inside **text boxes / drawings** (the design is a full-page background image with anchored text boxes). Google Docs exposes drawing text to neither DocumentApp nor the Docs API, so `replaceText` found nothing and the body-text check (`appreciationFillDoc_`) also saw nothing to complain about.
- **Fix (Code.gs, `appreciationIssue_`):** after copying the template, `appreciationPlaceholdersInText_` checks whether all three placeholders are ordinary text. If yes → unchanged native path. If not → `appreciationPdfViaDocx_`: read-only Drive v3 export of the **master** as .docx → replace the placeholders in `word/*.xml` (values XML-escaped via `appreciationXmlEscape_`; each placeholder must be found, none may remain, else FAILED and no email) → `Utilities.zip` → multipart upload as a temporary Google Doc (Drive conversion) → `getAs(PDF)` → temporary Doc trashed. The master template is never modified. Uses existing scopes (`drive`, `script.external_request`); no new Script Property.
- **Note:** Google's .docx re-import can shift fonts/spacing slightly. For pixel-exact output, keep the background image "Behind text" and type the three placeholders as normal document text (not in text boxes) — the code then uses the native path automatically.
- **Test:** `appreciation.js` +1 using the real template's .docx export (`test/appreciation_template.docx`, `test/ziputil.js` zip double): every part kept, background image intact, all three values merged + escaped, nothing left, temp files trashed.

## Round 47 (2026-10-07) — On-Call Teacher Attendance: all TCS_ and TTS_ teachers captured
- **Root cause:** `attRosterTeachers_` adds on-call teachers from `course.onCallTeacherCandidates`, but `syncClassroomData` deleted that field from every course record *before* writing the cache, so the Attendance sync (which reads the cache) never saw them. A TCS_/TTS_ teacher was therefore captured only if (a) named Primary Teacher in the Course Description (then kept in `course.teachers` — typical for the TTS_ accounts) or (b) found as a Meet guest in the class's identified Meet code. Guest capture, exclusions and the report are unchanged. Effective after the next `syncClassroomData` and Attendance sync (current week; earlier weeks are final).
- **Still excluded on purpose:** accounts in the explicit lists (`ATTENDANCE_ALWAYS_EXCLUDED_EMAILS_` in code — includes `tcs_asvika_aps8112@…` from an earlier request — and the `ATTENDANCE_EXCLUDED_EMAILS` Script Property, which in LIVE also lists one tcs_ account).
- **Tests:** `oncallaccess.js` +2 (cache keeps the on-call roster; end-to-end Classroom sync → Attendance sync → On-Call report lists TCS_ and TTS_, joined and rostered-not-joined). Full regression green.

## Round 49 (2026-10-07) — Performance (fewer server / API calls), weekly system backup, 3-month audit archive
**Analysis (code review; per open tab):** live-status poll every 2 s (~1,800 calls/h, 8 Script Property reads each — 50 users ≈ 720k property reads/h vs the 500k/day Workspace quota); chat poll every 8 s even when closed/hidden, each re-reading the whole `Courses` sheet + the chat sheet; every dashboard refresh re-read `Courses` and `WhatsApp_Group_Links`; `presenceMap` never pruned (single Script Property, 9 KB/value); a legacy `createSyncTrigger()` 15-minute `syncClassroomData` trigger was never removed by the daily-trigger check (up to 96 Classroom-API syncs/day); no retention on 17 audit/log sheets.

**Changes — Dashboard.html**
- `REALTIME_STATUS_POLL_MS` 2000 → **45000** (user-approved 30–60 s); still skipped while hidden, immediate poll on tab return.
- Chat: `CHAT_POLL_MS` 15 s; skipped while hidden; while the panel is closed only every 4th tick (60 s) for the unread badge; opening the chat still loads at once.
- `loadSyncInfo` no longer calls `getSyncIntervalMinutes()`; label now "syncs automatically daily at 5 PM EST (Admin: Force Sync anytime)".
- New card **🛡️ System Backup & Audit Archive** at the top of the User Roles view (shown for admin/superadmin only; server re-checks): status, per-sheet preview, Back up now, Archive (two-step confirm), Open backup folder. Buttons carry `data-tooltip` (§14).

**Changes — Code.gs**
- `readAllCoursesFromCache_`: chunked CacheService memo (`aps_courses_memo_v1`, 30k-char chunks, 10-min TTL) of the raw Detail JSON; returns freshly parsed objects. `invalidateCoursesMemo_()` called by `writeCache_` and the four per-course setters (`setClassStatusManual`, `setLiveStatus`, `setTeacherNotInClassStage`, `setNeedsTechSupportStage`) right after writing; also clears the WhatsApp map cache.
- `getChatMessages`: dropped the unused `readAllCoursesFromCache_()` call.
- `getWhatsAppLinksMap_`: 10-min cache (`aps_whatsapp_map_v1`); sheet read moved to `getWhatsAppLinksMapFromSheet_`. Direct sheet edits show within 10 min or immediately after Force Sync.
- `recordHeartbeat_`: drops presence entries not seen for 24 h (presence only drives the 3-min "online" dot). `lastLoginMap` unchanged (persistent data).
- `rosterEnsureTrigger_` (check key → `apsTriggersChecked_v4`): deletes any leftover `syncClassroomData` trigger and ensures exactly one `apsWeeklyMaintenance` trigger (Sunday ~2 AM ET). `createSyncTrigger()` no longer installs an interval trigger (only removes). Monday 5 AM attendance sync / 7 AM report triggers unchanged.
- New module **SYSTEM BACKUP + AUDIT ARCHIVE** (end of file): `apsSystemBackup_` (new folder `APS-Dashboard-Backup <ENV> <yyyy-MM-dd HHmm>` in `APS_BACKUP_FOLDER_ID` — default `1B9qATFrfcqbafzqYMBnbshGo0mA4nQTY` = *APS-DASHBOAD-SYSTEM-BACKUP-CLAUDE*: copy of the script project via `DriveApp.getFileById(ScriptApp.getScriptId())`, copies of the Main / Attendance / Exam QP workbooks (deduped by ID), `MANIFEST.txt` with restore steps and non-secret Script Properties — keys matching SECRET/TOKEN/PASSWORD/PRIVATE/CLIENT_ID/API_KEY/_KEY are never copied; keeps newest `APS_BACKUP_KEEP` (8), older folders → Trash); `apsAuditArchive_` (script lock; backup first unless the weekly run already made one; date column = first header like Timestamp/Date/Time/At whose values parse; rows older than `APS_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` (90) appended to tab `<Workbook> · <Sheet>` (+ "Archived At") of `APS Dashboard Audit Archive <yyyy> (<ENV>)` in the backup folder, write verified, then removed — contiguous top block via `deleteRows`, otherwise bottom-up `deleteRow`); `apsWeeklyMaintenance(e)` (trigger-only via `apsRequireTriggerCall_`); endpoints `getMaintenanceStatus`, `runSystemBackupNow`, `runAuditArchiveNow` (Admin/Super Admin via `apsRequireMaintenanceAdmin_`); status in Script Property `APS_MAINTENANCE_LAST_JSON`.
- Archived sheets (default, override with JSON Script Property `APS_AUDIT_ARCHIVE_SHEETS`): Attendance_Audit_Log, Class_Access_Audit, Examination_Audit_Log, Roster_Audit_Log, Roster_Sync_Log, Student_Classroom_Assignment_Audit, Teacher_Availability_Email_Log, EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_AUDIT. Never archived: EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_DOWNLOAD_AUDIT, Appreciation_Certificate_Audit, Teacher_Reference_Letter_Request, Grade_Time_Change_Request, Roster_*/Grading_* data, AWK attendance weeks (the Attendance tab reads old weeks), chat (own 10-day pruning).
- New optional Script Properties (code defaults): `APS_BACKUP_FOLDER_ID`, `APS_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` (90), `APS_BACKUP_KEEP` (8), `APS_MAINTENANCE_ENABLED` (true), `APS_AUDIT_ARCHIVE_SHEETS`.

**Deploy notes:** the dashboard account must be Editor of the backup folder (owner info@ — OK if the script runs as info@). The first Admin page load after deploy installs the weekly trigger and removes the legacy one. Scopes unchanged (drive, script.scriptapp already present).

**Not changed (follow-ups):** `lastLoginMap` is one Script Property and grows with every user — move to a sheet if it nears 9 KB; `getCourseNameSuffix` / `getShowContactPhone` could ride on `getDashboardData`.

**Tests:** new `maintenance.js` (9: course cache + invalidation by setter and sync, no sheet re-read on refresh/chat, legacy trigger removal + idempotent weekly trigger, preview/date-column detection, archive copy→verify→remove incl. non-contiguous rows and second-run no-op, backup files/MANIFEST without secrets/retention 8, role gate + trigger-only handler, weekly run, presence pruning) and `ui_maint.js` (3: 45 s / 15 s polling, admin card + confirm + backup, HM hidden + server refusal). `gasmock` CacheService gains getAll/putAll/removeAll. Tests that edit `WhatsApp_Group_Links` directly now clear its cache (what Force Sync does). Full regression green (12 server + 16 UI suites).

## Round 52 (2026-10-07) — 🎫 Tickets module (helpdesk)
**Files:** Code.gs (new module at end + `doGet` deep link), Dashboard.html (tab, view, CSS, client). No new script file, no new scope, no change to existing tabs.

**Reused (no second directory):** `requireValidSession_` / roles (`isAdminRole_`, `getDashboardRolePermission_().readOnly`), `readAllCoursesFromCache_()` (cached, r49), `courseHasStudentEmail_`, `userHasCourseAccess_`, `course.classSupport` roles PRIMARY_TEACHER / VP / HM (same data as class access) → `tkClassChain_`; names from `course.teachers` / `classPrimaryNameFromEmail_`; `extractAPSID_`; `getWorkbook_`; `LockService`; `htmlEscape_`, `APS_SCHOOL_LOGO_URL`.

**Storage (main workbook, plain-text cells, created on first use, widened past 26 columns):** `APS_TICKETS` (31 cols incl. student chain snapshot, Assigned_To, Assignment_Flags, dates, Request_ID), `APS_TICKET_MESSAGES` (PUBLIC / INTERNAL, attachments JSON), `APS_TICKET_PARTICIPANTS` (Role REQUESTER / PRIMARY_TEACHER / HEADMASTER / VP / DEPARTMENT / ADMIN_ASSIGNED / WATCHER; Participant_Type ASSIGNEE / PARTICIPANT; Active), `APS_TICKET_AUDIT_LOG` (permanent — not in the r49 archive list), `APS_TICKET_CONFIG` (rules, adminCc, notify, enabledTypes, defaultPriority). Attachments: private Drive folder (`APS_TICKET_ATTACH_FOLDER_ID`), served only via `getTicketAttachment` after the access check.

**Assignment engine (`tkAssignmentFor_`, server-only):** defaults `TK_DEFAULT_RULES_` exactly as specified; chain types (ATTENDANCE, LEAVE, EXAMINATION, CLASS ROOM, KAHOOT, EVENTS) require a student and always include Primary Teacher + HM + VP (cannot be switched off in Settings); missing roles → `Assignment_Flags` + ASSIGNMENT_FLAG audit, ticket kept (NEW if nobody). The student chain is re-resolved on create — never taken from the browser. Ticket number `APS-yyyyMMdd-NNNN` (America/New_York day) under the script lock; duplicate guard by `requestId` (cache 10 min) and same requester+type+subject+student within 2 min.

**RBAC (`tkAccess_`, every endpoint):** Admin/Super Admin everything; requester view/reply own; active participants view (staff roles = staff); teacher/VP/HM-of-class via `userHasCourseAccess_`; school Head Master (role headmaster) for class tickets. Staff: internal notes + statuses IN PROGRESS / WAITING FOR USER / RESOLVED. Admin only: All Tickets, assign/reassign/override, participants, type/priority, CLOSE, REOPEN, reports, settings, audit history. BOD (read-only permission) cannot create/reply. Unauthorized attempts are logged server-side.

**Email (`tkNotify_` → `tkSendMail_`):** From `TICKET_MAIL_FROM` (default donotreply@) via Gmail API `users/me/messages/send` with (a) service account JWT (`TICKET_MAIL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON`, `sub` = donotreply@, scope gmail.send — needs domain-wide delegation) or (b) refresh token (`TICKET_MAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REFRESH_TOKEN`); access token kept in memory per execution only; optional `TICKET_MAIL_ALLOW_MAILAPP_FALLBACK`. `tkBuildRecipients_`: validate + de-dup To, admin CC (`adminCc`, default admin@) always, removed from To. Events: CREATED (requester + all), ASSIGNED/REASSIGNED (new), ADMIN_OVERRIDE (new + removed + requester), REPLY (requester + participants − author), INTERNAL_NOTE (assignees − author, never the requester), WAITING FOR USER/RESOLVED/CLOSED (requester + assignees − actor), REOPENED. Each send audited EMAIL_SENT / EMAIL_FAILED; errors sanitized (no tokens/keys).

**Endpoints:** getTicketBootstrap, searchTicketStudents, resolveTicketStudent, createTicket, listTickets (scope mine/assigned/all, server filters + paging), getTicket, replyTicket, updateTicket, assignTicket, addTicketParticipant, removeTicketParticipant, getTicketAttachment, getTicketReports, getTicketSettings, saveTicketSettings.

**Deep link:** emails link `<webapp>?ticket=APS-…`; `doGet` validates the number, stores it under the new OAuth state nonce (10 min) so it survives sign-in, and passes `APS_BOOT_TICKET` to the template; the client opens it after load (still permission-checked).

**UI:** main tab 🎫 Tickets (all signed-in roles) with `.cls-subtabs.tk-subtabs`; panes list / create / detail / reports / settings; confirmation modal for status saves, override, removal, reopen, settings; responsive ≤760 px (cards stack, no horizontal scroll). Nothing loads until the tab opens; lists are paged on the server (25).

**Tests:** `tickets.js` (22: every rule incl. OTHERS manual; student lookup scope; missing-chain flags; numbering + duplicates; sender/CC/de-dup/subject/email body; email failure + not configured + fallback; admin override audit fields; RBAC denials; internal-note secrecy; full workflow incl. reopen; visibility; search/filters/paging 61 tickets; reports; settings validation + audit; attachments) and `ui_tickets.js` (7: student create/LEAVE chain, teacher assigned + note + status limits, student never sees notes, admin six sub-tabs/search/filters/override/close/reopen, reports + settings, deep link incl. denial, 390 px). Full regression green (13 server + 18 UI suites).

## Round 53 (2026-10-08) — Attendance emails From attendance@ (Gmail API), admin@ always CC

**Request:** every weekly student attendance email and every Teacher Availability email goes out from `attendance@avvaiyarpadasalai.org` with `admin@avvaiyarpadasalai.org` in CC. Decisions taken with the user: CC = admin@ only (info3@ removed); if attendance@ cannot sign in → **pause + alert admin** (no fallback sender); Reply-To = class teacher(s) on the class report, attendance@ on the availability report; extra feature chosen: **accurate daily limit** for attendance@.

**Shared mail transport (refactor, no behaviour change for Tickets):** `APS_MAIL_PROFILES_` with profiles `TICKETS` (donotreply@, `TICKET_MAIL_*`, service account / refresh token / optional MailApp fallback) and `ATTENDANCE` (attendance@, `ATTENDANCE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` / `ATTENDANCE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` / `ATTENDANCE_REFRESH_TOKEN`, no fallback). `apsMailMode_(name)`, `apsMailFrom_(name)`, `apsMailAccessToken_(name, mode)` (per-profile in-memory token memo, never cached/logged; auth errors flagged `apsAuth`), `apsGmailSend_(name, m)` (MIME multipart, `From: <displayName> <from>`, `Reply-To` from `m.replyTo`, returns `{ok, mode, error, auth}`; 401/403 → `auth:true`). `tkMailMode_`, `tkMailAccessToken_`, `tkSendMail_`, `tkMailFrom_` are thin wrappers.

**Attendance mail helpers:** `attMailAdminCc_()` (`ATTENDANCE_MAIL_ADMIN_CC`, default admin@), `attMailCc_(cc, to)` (adds admin@, de-dups, never repeats a To address), `attMailBudget_()` / `attMailCount_(n)` (recipients per America/New_York day in `ATT_MAIL_DAILY_COUNT`; limit `ATTENDANCE_MAIL_DAILY_LIMIT`, default 1500 — replaces `MailApp.getRemainingDailyQuota()`), `attMailConfigured_()`, `attMailSend_(m)` (throws `apsQuota` / `apsPaused`), `attMailAlertAdmin_(what, reason)` (one MailApp alert to admin@ at most every 6 h via `ATT_MAIL_ALERT_AT`; secrets scrubbed).

**Weekly class attendance report (`attSendAttendanceReportsForWeek_`):** not configured → returns `paused` before sending anything (preview throws the reason); per class `attMailSend_` with CC `attMailCc_(ATTENDANCE_REPORT_CC)` and Reply-To the class teachers; `apsQuota` → `quotaHit` (resume next run); `apsPaused` → stop batch, `paused`, alert admin; state stays unfinished so Tue/Wed resume. PRIVATE audience: per-student copies carry no CC (admin@ already receives the full table). `ATTENDANCE_REPORT_CC_DEFAULT_` = admin@ only.

**Teacher Availability report:** `CTA_DEFAULT_TO_` = teachers@; `ctaConfig_()` removes admin@ from an older To list and returns `cc` = [admin@]; `ctaSend_(m, to, isTest, cc)` → `attMailSend_` (Reply-To attendance@); scheduled run CCs admin@, test email is not CC'd; failure with `apsPaused` alerts admin and leaves the day unsent. `getClassTeacherAvailabilityView` schedule adds `cc` and `from` (staff only); the schedule note shows "(CC admin@…) from attendance@…".

**ENV_VARIABLE_LIVE / TEST:** `ATTENDANCE_REPORT_CC` = admin@; `APS_CLASS_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY_EMAIL_TO` = teachers@; new `ATTENDANCE_MAIL_FROM`, `ATTENDANCE_MAIL_ADMIN_CC`, `ATTENDANCE_MAIL_DAILY_LIMIT` and blank `ATTENDANCE_OAUTH_*` / `ATTENDANCE_REFRESH_TOKEN` placeholders; the migration now skips blank credential keys (ATTENDANCE_* and TICKET_MAIL_*) so it never wipes values saved in Script Properties.

**Tests:** `gasmock.js` emulates the token endpoint + Gmail API send (decoded into `stats.mails` with `via:'gmail'`, `from`, `replyTo`; `gmailAuthFail` / `gmailSendFail` options) and default attendance credentials; `gradingfixture.js` base64 helper handles byte arrays. `cta.js` +3 (admin@ moved to CC, test email not CC'd; sign-in failure pauses + single throttled alert without secrets; daily limit), updated recipients/From/Reply-To; `e2e.js` +3 (From/Reply-To/CC/budget, auth-failure pause then Tuesday resume, not-configured pause + preview error) and the quota test now uses `ATTENDANCE_MAIL_DAILY_LIMIT`; `ui_cta.js` schedule note. Full regression green.

## Round 55 (2026-10-08) — End-to-end validation + editor-only entry points locked down

**Validation run (per the generic prompt §24):** `.gs` / inline-script syntax; 744 server functions with no duplicate names (the only repeats are minified names inside PdfLib.gs and nested client helpers in separate scopes); all 112 client `google.script.run` targets exist and none is private; every session-taking endpoint validates the session (directly or via `requireSuperAdminViewer_`, `examRequireAccess_`, `rosterUserContext_`, `tkViewer_`, `getAuthenticatedAPSUser`); every trigger handler exists; no credential values in Code.gs / Dashboard.html / PdfLib.gs; ENV migration simulated for LIVE (72 keys) and TEST (70 keys) with attendance + ticket mail credentials present; dead-code diff against CURRENT_PROD_CODE (635 → 744 functions, none removed; one unused wrapper `tkMailAccessToken_` removed); full regression (14 server + 18 UI suites) green.

**Finding fixed (pre-existing in production):** the web app is deployed `ANYONE_ANONYMOUS` and executes as the owner, so every global function is callable through `google.script.run`. Nine editor/maintenance functions without a session parameter could therefore be run by any visitor (e.g. a full Classroom sync, an attendance sync, trigger re-creation, an email to the owner). New `apsRequireOwnerOrTrigger_(e, handler)`: allows a verified own-trigger call (`apsRequireTriggerCall_`) or the script owner in the editor (active user === effective user); everyone else gets "Access denied". `syncClassroomData` / `syncAttendanceForAllCourses` become guarded wrappers around new private `syncClassroomData_` / `syncAttendanceForAllCourses_`, which the session-checked dashboard endpoints (`forceSyncClassroomData`, `forceSyncAttendanceNow`), the daily 5 PM jobs and the weekly report use. `sendWeeklyAttendanceReports(e)`, `sendAttendanceReportPreviewToMe`, `createSyncTrigger`, `createAttendanceSyncTrigger`, `apsOwnerReauthorizeAllScopes`, `checkExamQuestionPaperSetup`, `getUserCountryFlag` are guarded in place.

**Tests:** `gasmock.js` Session.getActiveUser defaults to the owner (editor run) and `stats.activeUser` simulates a web visitor; new `editoronly.js` (5: anonymous and other-account visitors refused for all nine, forged trigger ids refused, owner allowed, Admin Force Sync / Sync Attendance Now still work from a visitor context while a student is refused).

Each cell is `Y` (switchable, on by default), `L` (not available for the role — the feature's own rules never show it; never switchable) or `A` (always on: Classes + Classes list for every role, every cell for Super Admin, Admin Control + Access Control for Admin).

**Storage / cache:** `Dashboard_Access_Control` (Role, Tab_Key, Tab_Label, Visible, Updated_At, Updated_By — upsert, one row per role+key) and `Access_Control_Audit` (Date_Time, Changed_By, Changed_By_Role, Role, Tab_Key, Tab_Label, Old_Value, New_Value). `acOverrides_()` caches the saved map 10 min (`aps_access_ctl_v1`), cleared on every save under a script lock.

**Effective rule:** `acEffectiveForRole_(role)` returns `{ key: false }` only for Y cells an admin turned off, plus their sub-tabs. L cells add nothing, so existing role rules are untouched and nothing changes until an admin saves. Unknown roles get `{}`.

**Server enforcement:** `apsRequireTabForToken_(token, key)` is the first line of 88 tab-specific endpoints (Teacher Availability, Knowledge Base, Class Change, Assign Classroom, Letters (by letter type), Reference Letter Approvals, Attendance, Examination (course options / history; announcements; classwork; question paper; grading), GCM - Preview, Tickets (parent; Create = tickets.self; Reports; Settings; `listTickets` scope all = tickets.all), Backup & Archive) and throws `ACCESS_OFF: …`. Active Directory sub-tabs use data already in getDashboardData, so they are hidden in the browser only. `sendWeeklyClassTeacherAvailabilityTestEmail` skips the guard for editor runs (no token).

**Endpoints:** `getAccessControl`, `saveAccessControl(changes)` (Admin / Super Admin + `requireDashboardMutationPermission_`; L / A / unknown refused; unchanged values neither saved nor audited), `getAccessControlHistory(limit)`. Payloads: `buildAuthenticatedUserPayload_().tabAccess` and `getDashboardData().tabAccess`.

**Client:** `apsTabOk(key)`, `apsApplyTabAccess_()` (adds `.aps-ac-off` to mapped buttons — main tabs, Directory / Ticket / Admin Control sub-tabs, Examination sections, Letter types — on top of each tab's own visibility rule), `acRedirectView_()` (first line of `switchView`: a hidden view falls back to its sibling sub-tab or Classes), `acFixSelectedSubs_()` (opens the first visible Examination section / Ticket sub-tab), `ctaRoleOk_()` honours `classes.teacherAvail`.

**Tests:** new `accesscontrol.js` (6: defaults / no change on day one; Admin-only server checks; hide → audit + login and dashboard payloads + server refusal while other roles unaffected; parent → sub-tabs, Super Admin unaffected; L / A / unknown refused, no-op not audited, upsert, history order; cache cleared on save) and `ui_access.js` (4: table, toggle, parent dimming, Undo, confirm-then-save, search, role filter, history; teacher's hidden tab gone + forced open falls back + server refusal; phone no page scroll; Super Admin sub-tabs, other roles never see Admin Control). `ui_maint.js` now opens Backup & Archive through Admin Control.

## Round 58 (2026-10-09) — Classes → Temporary Class Coverage (One-Time Class Merge)

**Decisions with the user:** sub-tab visible to HM / VP / Admin / Super Admin (class-level VP / HM only for the classes they support — `courseHasSupportEmail_`); all outbound email from **attendance@** (`attMailSend_`); verified Meet = Admin mapping or class Description, class-stream link only after an explicit tick, Meet-log detected links never; extras: attendance credit + class-card banner.

**Server (end of Code.gs, prefix `tcc`):** `tccViewer_` (Access Control key `classes.coverage` + role / VP-HM scope + `requireDashboardMutationPermission_` for writes), `tccSchedule_` (reuses `parseAPSClassroomName`; MUNMAZHALAI, MAZHALAI, NILAI n, THULIR …), `tccSession_` / `tccZoned_` (America/New_York instants with the real EST/EDT offset of that date; weekday, past and 60-day checks), `tccMeetFor_` (`classMeetLinkMaps_` + `meetLinkInClassroom`; never the original's link, never invented), `tccPrimary_` / `tccRecipients_` (Description PRIMARY_TEACHER + Room VP / HM via `tkClassChain_`; case-insensitive de-dup; missing VP/HM → warning, admin@ CC), `tccPlan_` (single validator used by preview **and** apply: same Nilai / day / start / end, AY26-27, not itself, Meet verified, not already merged / hosting), endpoints `getCoverageBootstrap`, `getCoveragePlan`, `applyCoverage`, `retryCoverage`, cleanup trigger handler `apsCoverageCleanup` (guarded by `apsRequireTriggerCall_`).

**Apply:** script lock → requestId de-dup → plan → `Classroom.Courses.get` for both classes (ACTIVE + unchanged name) → row reserved in `Temporary_Class_Coverage` (unique original class + date) → lock released → `tccRunSteps_`: announcement (`Announcements.create`, original class only; on retry an existing post with the same title + Meet URL is reused) → student email (To attendance@, **Bcc** students, Cc admin@) → staff email (To teachers / VP / HM, Cc admin@) → each status written separately → cleanup trigger ensured (every 30 min, deleted when nothing is pending). Announcement failure stops the emails. `apsGmailSend_` gained `bcc`; `attMailSend_` counts BCC recipients against `ATTENDANCE_MAIL_DAILY_LIMIT`.

**Cleanup:** after `Session_End` + `TCC_CLEANUP_GRACE_MINUTES` (default 30) → `Announcements.remove(courseId, announcementId)` for that id only; "not found" → completed (never retried); transient errors → `CLEANUP_FAILED` (retried, up to 5); permission errors / 5 failures → `CLEANUP_REQUIRES_REVIEW`. Statuses: CLEANUP_PENDING / IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED / FAILED / REQUIRES_REVIEW. Deletion works with the existing `classroom.announcements` scope because the same deploying account created the post (the Examination tab already deletes its own announcements this way).

**Sheet `Temporary_Class_Coverage`** (31 plain-text columns, created on first use, widened before the header): Merge_ID, Created_At, Created_By, Requesting_Role, Original_Course_ID/Name, Original_Teacher, Destination_Course_ID/Name, Destination_Teacher, Session_Date, Session_Start/End, Session_Start/End_ISO, Timezone, Meet_URL, Meet_Source, Announcement_ID, Announcement_Status, Student_Email_Status, Staff_Email_Status, Recipients (staff emails + student COUNT only), Cleanup_Status, Cleanup_After_ISO, Last_Error, Retry_Count, Last_Retry_At, Completed_At, Request_ID, Notes. No student addresses or credentials are stored.

**Attendance + cards:** `tccCoverageMap_()` (posted / deleted merges, cached 5 min) → `syncAttendanceForAllCourses_` attributes the original roster from the coverage class's Meet code that session (`tccAttributeMergedSession_`, source `MEET_AUDIT_COVERAGE_MERGE`, shown as "GM(Merged class Meet)"); `getDashboardData` stamps `course.coverageToday` (original: destination + Meet; destination: hosting) until end + grace → `tccCardBanner_` on the card.

**Client:** `#subTabCoverage` in `#classesSubTabs` (shown by `ctaSyncSubTabs_` when `currentUser.coverageAccess` and Access Control allow), `#coverageView` (steps ①–③, summary, recipients, announcement preview, sandboxed `<iframe srcdoc>` email preview, confirmation tick, Confirm & Apply with busy lock + requestId, Merge History with Retry), responsive (stacked history cards ≤760 px). Access Control catalog: new row `classes.coverage` (`AYYYLLL`).

**Optional Script Properties:** `TCC_CLEANUP_GRACE_MINUTES` (default 30), `TCC_COMBINED_CLASS_WARN` (combined-size warning, off by default). **New trigger:** `apsCoverageCleanup` (every 30 min, only while a cleanup is pending). **Scopes:** none new.

**Tests:** `coverage.js` (10: A matching, B server rejection incl. stream-link tick, C authorization on every endpoint + Access Control, D+E announcement + emails + recipients + BCC + budget + record, F duplicate / double-click / hosting, G no permanent change, H cleanup timing / idempotency / unrelated posts kept / review / forged trigger, I email failure → retry without a second post, announcement failure stops emails, crash-after-post reuse, L EST/EDT incl. DST weeks + parser, attendance credit + banner), `ui_coverage.js` (3: HM full flow, VP scope + other roles hidden + forced-open fallback, phone / tablet no page scroll), shared `coveragefixture.js`; Access Control tests now expect 31 rows.

**Assign Classroom:**
- `#asgSubTabs` holds **Re-Map Student** (`#asgRemapPane`, the existing UI) and **Remove Student** (`#asgRemovePane`). Both live in one view, `assignClassroom`, with pane state `asgPane`, synced by `asgSyncSubTabs_()` from `apsApplyTabAccess_()` and `loadAssignmentView()`.
- Re-Map:
  - The audit panel is a flex column, so both panels have equal width (grid 1fr/1fr) and the same height; the log scrolls inside.
  - The select is capped at 100 % (it caused a pre-existing phone overflow).
  - The search also matches APSID, and rows show the APSID.
  - **Bug fixed:** `loadAssignmentView()` returned early for Super Admin, so the lists stayed on "Loading…".
  - `getAdminClassroomAssignments` students now carry `apsId`.

**Access Control:**
- New catalog rows `assignClassroom.remap` and `assignClassroom.remove` (`AYLLLYL`). The catalog now has **33 rows**.
- `getAdminClassroomAssignments` and `assignStudentToClassroom` now check `assignClassroom.remap`; the parent is still honoured by `apsTabAllowed_`.
- `getAdminAssignmentAuditLog` stays on `assignClassroom`.

**Remove Student (server, end of Code.gs, prefix `srm`):**
- `srmViewer_`: Access Control key `assignClassroom.remove`. `isAdminRole_` can remove; BOD is read-only; `requireDashboardMutationPermission_` applies to writes. The role always comes from the server session.
- `getRemovalContext(token)` returns students with their AY26-27 classrooms and class teacher, plus the audit (newest 300). Pairs already REMOVED / ALREADY_ABSENT since `lastSync` are hidden until the next sync.
- `removeStudentFromClassroom(token, {studentEmail, courseId, reason, confirmed, requestId})`:
  1. Checks `confirmed === true`, then the reason (`srmValidateReason_`: 5–200 whitespace-separated words, ≤ 3000 characters), then the request id.
  2. Takes a script lock. The same requestId returns the earlier result (double-click safe); a pending or in-progress removal of the same student and class is refused.
  3. Checks the cached course is AY26-27 and the student is on its dashboard roster; `Classroom.Courses.get` must return ACTIVE.
  4. Writes the audit row (`VALIDATING`) **before** any change.
  5. Live `Students.get`: not found → `ALREADY_ABSENT`, no email.
  6. `REMOVAL_IN_PROGRESS`, then `Students.remove`. An error → `REMOVAL_FAILED`.
  7. Verifies with `Students.get` that the student is not found → `REMOVED` + `VERIFIED`. Otherwise → `REQUIRES_REVIEW` (`STILL_ON_ROSTER` / `NOT_VERIFIED`), no email.
  8. Releases the lock, then `srmSendEmail_`.
- `srmSendEmail_` runs only for REMOVED + VERIFIED.
  - To: Primary Teacher (`tccPrimary_`, falling back to the first visible teacher) plus `tkClassChain_` primary / HM / VP, de-duplicated. CC admin@. Reply-To attendance@.
  - With no class recipients it goes to admin@ only, and the missing roles are recorded.
  - Subject: `[APS] Student Removal Notification – <Student> – <Class>`.
  - Body: approved template inside `apsEmailShell_`, everything escaped, with a plain-text part.
  - Status `EMAIL_SENT` / `EMAIL_FAILED`. If attendance@ sending is paused, admin is alerted.
- `retryRemovalEmail(token, requestId)` works only for verified removals, never calls Classroom, and does nothing if the email was already sent.
- Errors are trimmed and scrubbed of token / secret text before storage.

**Sheet `Student_Removal_Audit`** (main workbook, 19 plain-text columns, created on first use):
- Columns: Request_ID, Requested_At, Requested_By, Requested_By_Role, Student_Name, Student_APSID, Student_Email, Course_ID, Course_Name, Class_Teacher, Reason, Removal_Status, Verification_Status, Email_Status, Email_Recipients, Error, Last_Retry_At, Completed_At, Removed_At.
- The request columns (Request_ID … Reason) are written once; later writes only touch the status columns.

**Remove Student (client):**
- Panel layout: search, then results, then a classroom radio group (pre-selected when the student has only one class), then the reason with a live `N / 200 words` counter and hints, then the summary with a warning and **Confirm & Remove Student**.
- The confirm button is disabled until the reason is valid. The `srm.busy` lock plus a requestId (kept on a network failure, so a resend is de-duplicated) protect against double clicks.
- Result message with a status colour. **Student Removal Audit Log** table at the bottom with status pills and **Retry email** (Admin / SA only).
- BOD: read-only banner and the log only.

**Scopes:** none new — `classroom.rosters` (already used by Re-Map) covers `Students.get/remove`. **Deployment requirement:** the deploying account must be a teacher / owner of the class or a Workspace admin for Classroom to allow the removal; otherwise the row shows `REMOVAL_FAILED` with Google's message.

**Rollback:** redeploy r58 Code.gs + Dashboard.html. The `Student_Removal_Audit` sheet can stay; nothing else reads it.

**Tests:**
- `removal.js` (8 groups covering acceptance points 1–20): reason limits, authorization and forged role, verified removal of one class only, recipients / From / CC / subject / escaping, duplicate and in-progress handling, ALREADY_ABSENT / REMOVAL_FAILED / REQUIRES_REVIEW / roster-check failure, wrong or inactive class, email failure → retry without re-removal, immutable request fields, no new scopes, Re-Map switch.
- `ui_remove.js` (7): rename and one-row layout (desktop / phone), auto-filter by name / email / APSID with empty state, teacher email / APSID search, Re-Map side-by-side equal panels plus the Super Admin load, the full removal flow with a triple click → one removal, the email-failure retry, phone layout, BOD read-only, and hidden for teacher / HM.

## Round 63 (2026-10-10) — TEST environment email guard

**Request:** the TEST Apps Script must not email real teachers, HMs or admins. TEST should redirect to info@ with a TEST notice; LIVE sends as usual. Keep the change small.

**How the environment is detected:** the existing `getDashboardEnvironment_()` reads Script Property `APS_ENVIRONMENT`. `TESTING`, or the old value `TEST`, means TEST. Unset or `LIVE` means LIVE. ENV_VARIABLE_TEST.gs already sets `TESTING`.

**Change (Code.gs only):**
- New `apsTestMailGuard_(m)`:
  - **In LIVE** it returns the message untouched.
  - **In TEST, mode REDIRECT (default):**
    - To becomes `TEST_EMAIL_REDIRECT_TO` (default info@avvaiyarpadasalai.org; an invalid value falls back to it), and CC / BCC are removed.
    - The subject gets the prefix `[TEST ENVIRONMENT] ` (never doubled).
    - A red HTML banner and a plain-text banner show the LIVE To and CC addresses (15 shown, then "+N more"), BCC as a count only, and the time.
    - Attachments and the sender are kept.
  - **Daily cap:** `TEST_EMAIL_DAILY_CAP` (default 30, counter in Script Property `APS_TEST_EMAIL_COUNT`, resets each day). Over the cap, the email is suppressed.

## Round 64 (2026-10-10) — Class-card "Status" box (live Google Meet status)

**Request:** on every card in Classes → Google Classroom, add a separate Status section showing the same status as GCM - Preview, only during class time. It is red when the status has "Teacher not in Meet" or "Google Meet not started yet", and it refreshes every 45 seconds when the Meet status changes.

**Decisions:**
- **When it shows:** from the class start time until it ends. Technically: Class Status `started` or `yet_to_start` from the existing `applyClassStatus_` state machine. This is needed so "Google Meet not started yet" can appear.
- **Who sees it:** every role that can see the card, filtered on the server to the viewer's own classes. It shows counts and the teacher's join time only, no names.

**Server (Code.gs):**
- `apsClassLiveBox_(c)` returns null outside class time, otherwise:
  - `{ live, tone: 'ok' | 'alert', teacherInMeet, notStarted, line1, line2 }`.
  - The lines are built from the same fields and in the same format as GCM - Preview's `gcmCard_` (`teachers[].inMeet`, `students[].inMeet`, `classStatusLabel`, `classMeetDetail.text`).
  - `tone: 'alert'` whenever the teacher is not in the Meet.
- `getDashboardData` stamps `course.liveBox` on every visible course.
- `apsClassLiveBoxesForViewer_(session)`:
  - Builds the map once from cached data (`readAllCoursesFromCache_` + `applyRosterHiddenStaffFilter_` + `applyLivePresence_` + `applyClassStatus_`).
  - Shares the map for 30 s in CacheService (`aps_cls_live_box_v1`), so many open tabs don't recompute.
  - Filters it to the viewer's courses with `getViewerContext_`.
- `getRealtimeStatusSnapshot` (the existing 45-second poll) now also returns `liveStatus`. Any error gives `null`, and the rest of the snapshot is unchanged.
- No new Google API calls. The Meet snapshot underneath refreshes at most every `CLASS_MEET_LIVE_REFRESH_SECONDS` (120 s in r64; 45 s from r65).

**Client (Dashboard.html):**
- `renderCard` adds a `.cls-live-host` between the card header and the flags / teacher list.
- `clsLiveBoxHtml_` renders the box:
  - Title: "Status · Live now", or "Status · Class time started".
  - Badge: 🟢 LIVE in Google Meet / 🟢 Teacher in Meet / 🔴 Teacher not in Meet / 🔴 Meet not started.
  - The two status lines, then "Status refreshes every 45 seconds · updated h:mm:ss EST".
- `clsApplyLiveBoxes_` runs inside `pollRealtimeOperationalStatus` before its unchanged-signature early return. It updates only the boxes, with no full re-render.
- The 5-minute refresh and the first load set the box from `course.liveBox`.
- Red styling uses `.ls-alert`. Text wraps on phones, with no horizontal scroll.
- The poll still pauses on hidden tabs and runs at once when the tab is visible again (existing behaviour).

**Zoho design (prompt §21):** neutral; no student or parent data is added.

**Tests:**

- New `ui_livebox.js` (3): desktop rendering and colours, live poll updates (appear, red, green, disappear) without reload, and the student's own class only with the phone layout.

## Round 65 (2026-10-10) — Honest live Meet status (fix "Teacher not in Meet · 0 of N · Google Meet not started yet" on live classes)

**Problem reported:** classes running in Google Meet, with teacher and students present, showed "👩‍🏫 Teacher not in Meet · 👥 0 of 6 students / Yet to Start — Google Meet not started yet".

**Root cause (from the code, not a regression):** the live snapshot (`classMeetLiveSnapshot_`, r35) has three signals, and during a running class none of them usually sees anything.
1. **Meet REST (`spaces/{code}`):**
   - Works only for Meet spaces the deploying account may read. Classroom Meet links belong to the teachers, so Google answers 403 and the code is skipped for 6 h (`aps_meet_rest_noaccess_v1`).
   - It also needs a known Meet code per class (Course ↔ Meet Link Mapping).
2. **Meet audit log:** Admin Reports writes `call_ended` only when a participant **leaves**, often with minutes of delay. People still in the call are invisible.
3. **Dashboard "Join to Google Meet" clicks:** only joins made through the dashboard are counted.

With no evidence, the code fell through to "Google Meet not started yet". The `classMeetLiveDiagnostic` Script Property shows this; `rest.noAccess` equal to the number of classes in the window confirms cause 1.

**Fix A (this round — no false alarms, small change):**
- `classMeetApplyLive_`, during class time (`yet_to_start`) with no teacher or student evidence:
  - Meet REST saw **no active conference** (`entry.live === false`): "Google Meet not started yet", as before.
  - Meet REST saw a **running conference** but no identifiable participant: "Google Meet is running — participants not identified yet".
  - Meet REST **cannot see** the class (`entry.live === null`): "Live Google Meet status not available for this class".
  - The last two set `detail.statusUnknown = true`. `detail.liveKnown` tells whether the live check can see the class.
- Before class time (`scheduled`) and the existing Class Started / Class Ended logic are unchanged.
- `apsClassLiveBox_`: with `statusUnknown` and no evidence, the box gets `tone: 'unknown'` (grey), with line 1 "👩‍🏫 Teacher: not known · 👥 Students: not known (N on roster)". Evidence, such as a student seen in the audit log, still gives red / green as before.
- GCM - Preview: the item has `meetUnknown`, and `gcmCard_` shows the same "not known" presence line.
- Client: `.ls-unknown` grey style and the badge "⚪ Live status not available".

**Also in this round (user request):**
- **Faster re-checks:**
  - A refused Meet code is re-checked after `MEET_REST_RETRY_SECONDS` (default 45 s; was 6 h). Only refused codes wait; readable codes are checked on every refresh, and a success clears the refusal.
  - The live check itself runs every `CLASS_MEET_LIVE_REFRESH_SECONDS` = 45 s (was 120 s), **only while at least one class is in its scheduled class time**, start → end (e.g. FRI 6:30 - 8:00 PM, FRI 7:30 - 9:00 PM, FRI 9:00 - 10:30 PM, SAT 12:00 - 1:30 PM, SUN 7:30 - 9:00 PM EST). Script Property `MEET_LIVE_REFRESH_SECONDS` overrides it, with a minimum of 30.
  - In the early / late detection window (30 min before start, 60 min after end) the cadence stays at 120 s and no Meet REST call is made. Outside every window there are no Meet calls at all, as before.
  - The Meet REST check, and so its 45 s retry, is made for a class only during that class's own class time (`diag.rest.outsideClassTime` counts the skipped ones; `diag.refreshSeconds` shows the cadence in use).
- **Diagnostic in `classMeetLiveDiagnostic`:**
  - It now also records `rest.retrySeconds`, `skipped`, `noCode` and `lastError` (HTTP code plus Google's message, scrubbed).
  - It is written even when no class is in its window (`classesInWindow: 0`, throttled to once per 5 min). Before, the property was written only during class windows, which is why it didn't appear in Script Properties.
  - `getMeetPreviewData` returns it as `liveDiag`, and GCM - Preview shows it in `#gcmDiag` (`gcmDiagText_`).

**Fix B (next, design only):** a domain-wide-delegated, read-only Google Meet service account that reads each class's Meet as its teacher, giving true live presence. See the design given to the user; it is not built.

**Zoho design (prompt §21):** neutral.

**Tests:**
- `livemeet.js`: the "window open, nobody in Meet" test was rewritten. It covers no visibility (not available), before class time (not started), REST visible with no conference (not started), and REST visible with an anonymous-only conference (running). Total 13.
- `livebox.js`: plus the unknown tone, GCM `meetUnknown`, and evidence over unknown. Total 6.
- `ui_livebox.js`: plus the grey box and the GCM presence line. Total 4.

**Rollback:** redeploy r64 Code.gs and Dashboard.html.

## Round 67 (2026-10-13) — Exam Question Paper: Teacher Copy + Send to Student (Teacher / VP / HM / Admin)

**Request:** let Teacher, HM and VP download the official question paper ("⬇️ Download Teacher Copy", marked TEACHER COPY) and email it to a student who cannot download it ("📧 Send to Student", with a confirmation and an audit log). Nothing in the student download, scoring, submission or grading may change.

**Permissions (all server-side, `examQpStaffAccess_` + `examQpStaffPaperBlock_`):**
- The existing gates are unchanged: Access Control `exam.questionPaper`, `examinationAccessForRole_` (Teacher / HM need `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_STUDENT_TEACHER_ACCESS=true`), and `examQpViewer_`.
- Who may use it:
  - Admin / Super Admin, and Head Master (all classes, the same scope as monitoring).
  - Teacher, including a class VP / HM: only classes where `userHasCourseAccess_` is true (Classroom teacher, or a Description / Room label backed by Classroom membership).
  - BOD and students: never. Students keep only their existing download.
- When: the paper is PUBLISHED, has a PDF, is not locked or cancelled, **and its release time has passed**. This keeps the existing rule (tested in `qp.js`) that only Admin can see a paper before release; Admin still has Preview. There is no close limit, because the purpose is to help students who missed the download window.
- The disabled buttons explain why, e.g. "Available from 10/16/2026 06:15 PM EST — the same time as for students."

**Teacher Copy (`downloadExamQuestionPaperTeacherCopy`):**
- It uses the same pdf-lib personalisation and ticket / polling protocol as Admin Preview.
- `examQpPersonalizePdf_` gained an optional `stamp.watermark`: a red "TEACHER COPY" label at the top of every page plus a faint diagonal. Student stamps never set it, so student PDFs are byte-for-byte the same logic.
- No download key. The stamp line reads "Student: TEACHER COPY - <teacher>".
- The copy is archived in the Personalized folder (`TEACHER_COPY_…pdf`) and audited as `TEACHER_COPY_DOWNLOADED`.
- `fetchExamQuestionPaperDownload` accepts ticket kind `TEACHER` only for the same teacher (`examQpStaffCanFetch_` re-checks access and paper state); tickets are single use.

**Send to Student (`sendExamQuestionPaperToStudent`):**
- Checks, in order:
  1. `confirmed === true` and a `requestId`. The same request id returns the earlier result for 10 min, so a double click sends one email.
  2. Staff access to the paper and `requireDashboardMutationPermission_`.
  3. The student is on that class's roster.
  4. The student has a valid APS email (`…@avvaiyarpadasalai.org`).
  5. The paper's state (as above).
- It builds the student's **own** personalised copy: the same stamp and the same `examQpDownloadKey_` as their own download, so the answer-sheet key workflow is unchanged.
- The copy is archived as `EMAILED_…pdf` and sent with `attMailSend_` From attendance@ to the student, Reply-To the sender, with the PDF attached. The limit is 4 MB, with a clear message if it is exceeded.
- If attendance@ cannot sign in, admin@ is alerted (`attMailAlertAdmin_`).
- Every attempt (refusals included) is written to the new sheet **`EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_EMAIL_AUDIT`** in the question-paper spreadsheet. Columns: `Send_ID, Sent_Date_Time_EST, Sender_Email, Sender_Role, Student_Name, Student_APSID, Student_Email, Exam_Title, Exam_ID, Question_Paper_ID, Class_Grade, Email_Status (SENT/FAILED), Error_Message, Request_ID`.
- It is also mirrored to `EXAM_QUESTION_PAPER_AUDIT` as `QUESTION_PAPER_EMAILED`.
- Student download events, the summary and the monitoring counts are not written to.

**Email:**
- The standard `apsEmailShell_`, subject "[APS] Examination Question Paper – <Exam> – <Class>".
- Body: "Vanakkam <Student>", then "Your <Teacher / VP / HM / Admin>, <name>, is sending you the official question paper … because you may have had difficulty downloading it from the APS Dashboard", followed by a details table (student, APSID, examination, class / grade, sent by, sent on).
- Then the note that the PDF is their personal copy with their download key, a request not to share it, and "please contact <sender> at <email>" (the standard footer says not to reply). A plain-text version is included.

**Mail infrastructure:**
- `apsGmailSend_` gained optional `attachments` (multipart/mixed). Without attachments the MIME is byte-identical to before, checked with a fixed-UUID comparison.
- The MailApp fallback passes the attachments through.
- The TEST guard (r63) keeps the attachment and redirects to info@.

**Monitoring:**
- `getExamQuestionPaperMonitoring` adds `staffActions` (Teacher / HM / Admin), per paper `staffCanUse` / `staffBlockReason`, and per student `canSend` / `lastEmailed` (latest SENT from the email audit).
- BOD and student payloads gain only `staffActions: false`.

**UI (Dashboard.html):**
- Papers table: a "⬇️ Download Teacher Copy" button next to View / Preview.
- Students table: a new "Question Paper" column with a small "📧 Send to Student" button and "Emailed <time>".
- The confirmation modal reuses `examQpModal_`: Name, APSID, APS Email, Examination Name, Class / Grade, plus an "Already emailed" warning when applicable. A busy lock and requestId prevent double sends.
- The student screen is unchanged.

**Zoho design (prompt §21):** neutral; the student is keyed by APS email / APSID, and there is no parent data.

**Tests:**
- `qp.js` +3 (31): Teacher Copy (roles, other class, before release, BOD / student, marking, no key, single-use ticket, student data unchanged); Send (email, attachment = the student's own copy with the same key, duplicate request, confirm required, other class, not on roster, non-APS email, before release, mail failure → FAILED, then success, HM, BOD / student refused, audit columns, monitoring flags); VP / class-HM access via class support.
- `ui_qp.js` +2 (13): teacher end-to-end (download, confirmation contents, double click = one email, Emailed label, already-emailed warning, cancel); student / BOD see no buttons; teacher phone layout.
- `gasmock.js` records Gmail attachments.

**Merged user edit:** the Re-Map Student email's book sentence (r66) now reads "For a grade change, we can NOT guarantee a new set of books for the new grade." This is the user's own edit in their folder, kept; `remap.js` updated.

| 45 s poll — Teacher / Student | ~400 KB every poll | once per course-list change |

| Dashboard.html size | 983 KB | 978 KB |

**Changes:**

  - `getClassCoverageTracking(token, {weekId})`

  - `getClassCoverageHistory(token, {weekId, courseId})`
- **Validation rules in `saveClassCoverage`:**
  - Allowed weeks run from 2 ahead to 12 back.
  - The class must be in the viewer's scope.
  - Action text is required unless the status is Pending, and is at most 300 characters.
  - A request ID is de-duplicated for 10 minutes.
  - The save runs under a script lock.
  - An unchanged save writes no audit row.
  - Text is protected against formula injection (`cctCell_`).
- **Access (`cctViewer_`):**
  - Access Control key `classes.coverageTracking` (cells AYYYLLL), checked first.
  - Admin, Super Admin and HM see every class.
  - A teacher who is VP / HM of a class sees only those classes (`tccCanUse_` / `courseHasSupportEmail_`, the same rule as Temporary Class Coverage).
  - Everyone else is refused.
  - Saves also need `requireDashboardMutationPermission_`.
  - `getDashboardData` and the session context return a `coverageTrackingAccess` flag (UX only).
- **Read-only reuse:** course cache, `primaryTeacherOf_`, `buildAvailabilityBoard_` (teacher's weekly answer and alternative), `tccSchedule_`, `getCurrentWeekId_` / `getWeekLabel_`.
  - No change to teacher or classroom assignment, Classroom, attendance, scheduling, availability or Temporary Class Coverage.
- **UI:**
  - Sub-tab `#subTabCoverageTracking`, view `#cctView` (`.tcc-*` look) and edit / history modal `#cctModal`.
  - Default filter is "Classes with a coverage issue": the teacher answered Not Available, or a record exists.
  - Other filters: quick groups, every status, and search. Summary chips act as filters.
  - The table turns into cards on phones.

### Feature 2 — 🔄 Zoho CRM Sync – Student Contact (Admin / Super Admin)
- **Flow:**
  1. Load Students (`loadZohoSyncStudents`, dashboard course cache only, no Zoho call).
  2. Preview Changes (`previewZohoStudentSync`, bulk Zoho read, no write).
  3. Sync Selected / Sync All (`runZohoStudentSync`, with `confirmed: true` and a requestId).
  4. Sync History (`getZohoSyncHistory`).
  - Also: `getZohoSyncStatus` (booleans only) and `checkZohoConnection` (resolves module and fields, refreshes the cache).
- **Matching:**
  - Key: `Student_APS_Email_Address` = trimmed, lowercased APS email.
  - One match → may update. None → NOT FOUND. More than one → DUPLICATE MATCH.
  - A student in two active classes → MULTIPLE CLASSES. This status was added for clarity; nothing is sent.
  - Never creates a record.
- **Values sent:**
  - Full Google Classroom name (course name as cached).
  - Primary teacher name and email (`tccPrimary_`: PRIMARY_TEACHER from the Course Description, else the single visible teacher; hidden staff and on-call excluded).
  - Grade: the Nilai in title case, e.g. "Nilai 4" / "Munmazhalai". It is matched case-insensitively to the Zoho picklist; a value not in the picklist is skipped with a note.
  - Blank values are never sent, and only changed fields are sent (teacher email compared case-insensitively).
- **Freshness:** right before updating, the records about to change are re-read by id (≤100 per call) and compared again.
- **Batches:**
  - Reads use GET `/crm/v3/{module}?fields=…&per_page=200`, following `page_token`.
  - Updates use PUT `/crm/v3/{module}` with ≤100 records per call.
  - A per-record error marks only that student ERROR; the run continues.
  - A script lock prevents two syncs at once.
- **OAuth:**
  - The refresh-token grant goes to `ZOHO_ACCOUNTS_URL/oauth/v2/token`.
  - The access token is cached server-side (expires_in − 5 min).
  - After a 401 the call is retried once with a new token.
  - `zhSafeErr_` removes secrets and tokens from every message.
- **Field metadata:**
  - `/settings/modules` finds the module whose label or API name is "Student Contact(s)", or `ZOHO_STUDENT_MODULE`.
  - `/settings/fields` resolves each field by label, or by its Script Property override.
  - The result is cached 6 hours. Missing or read-only fields are reported in the UI and skipped, never guessed.
- **Sheets (spreadsheet `ZOHO_SYNC_SPREADSHEET_ID`):**
  - The default `1rfPGPBmyEi7h2nyOwkbu9OVw9NS0c4s4iLZ1w91Ok0Q` is written once, in `ZOHO_SYNC_SPREADSHEET_ID_DEFAULT_`. A Script Property of the same name overrides it.
  - `ZOHO_STUDENT_CONTACT_SYNC`: latest result per student. Columns are the spec's, plus previous / new teacher name and email, Course ID and Run ID.
  - `ZOHO_STUDENT_CONTACT_SYNC_LOG`: one RUN row per preview / sync, plus one row per changed or attempted student with old → new values, admin, status and message.
- **Security:**
  - Every function calls `zhRequireAdmin_`: Access Control key `zohoSync` (cells AYLLLLL), a server-session role of Admin / Super Admin, and the mutation permission.
  - The browser's role is never trusted.
  - The tab is shown only to Admin / Super Admin (`updateMeetPreviewTabVisibility`).
  - Secrets are never returned, logged or written to sheets; the test scans all of them.
  - Nothing calls Zoho on page view.

**Script Properties to add (Apps Script → Project Settings):**

| Property | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| ZOHO_CLIENT_ID / ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET / ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN | yes | Zoho API Console → Self Client (or server-based client) for a dedicated Zoho API user. Suggested scopes: `ZohoCRM.modules.custom.READ,ZohoCRM.modules.custom.UPDATE,ZohoCRM.settings.modules.READ,ZohoCRM.settings.fields.READ` (or the module-specific `ZohoCRM.modules.<Student module>.READ/UPDATE`). |
| ZOHO_ACCOUNTS_URL / ZOHO_API_DOMAIN | if not zoho.com | e.g. `https://accounts.zoho.in` / `https://www.zohoapis.in`. Only Zoho addresses are accepted. |
| ZOHO_STUDENT_MODULE | optional | API name of the Student Contacts module if auto-detection fails. |
| ZOHO_FIELD_CLASSROOM / ZOHO_FIELD_TEACHER_NAME / ZOHO_FIELD_TEACHER_EMAIL / ZOHO_FIELD_GRADE / ZOHO_FIELD_STUDENT_EMAIL | optional | Exact Zoho field API names when the labels differ from "Google Classroom Full Name", "Teacher Name", "Teacher Email Address", "Grade". |
| ZOHO_SYNC_SPREADSHEET_ID | optional | Defaults to the sheet given in the spec. |

**Zoho design (prompt §21):**
- Feature 2 is **toward** the target design: it is the Dashboard → Zoho write-back for class, teacher and grade. It keys on APS email; secrets live in Script Properties; field API names are resolved and cached; and it uses batched v3 calls with no Zoho call on page view.
- Feature 1 is **neutral**: picklist-style status codes, keyed by Course ID + week.

**Tests:**
- `test/cct.js` (6): access per role, VP scope, validation, audit old → new, de-duplication, clearing, availability untouched, Access Control.
- `test/zoho.js` (13), with the new `test/zohomock.js` Zoho v3 + OAuth emulator: role refusal on every endpoint; not-configured case; field metadata, missing field and override; load without Zoho calls; preview statuses and paging; sync-all rules (only changed fields, ≤100 per call, no create, no blank, duplicates skipped); sync selected; requestId; fresh re-read; one failure does not stop the rest; token refresh; picklist; sheets, log and history; spreadsheet ID in one place; no-secret scan; no Zoho call on page view.
- `test/ui_r70.js` (11): tab visibility for 7 roles; coverage add / validate / example / double-click / filters / chips / search / history; VP on a phone; Zoho end-to-end (check, load, preview, select, confirm, cancel, sync, history); Zoho on a phone.

**Known limitations:**
- Zoho was tested only against the emulator. The first real run should be Check Connection, then Preview, then Sync Selected on 1–2 students.
- Field labels in your Zoho may differ; use the ZOHO_FIELD_* overrides.
- Zoho workflow rules on Student Contacts will fire on update, as normal.

- `test/accesscontrol.js` and `test/ui_access.js`: the Access Control table now has 35 rows (33 + 2 new). New checks: `zohoSync` is locked for HM, and `classes.coverageTracking` is locked for students and BOD.
