## Round 71 (2026-10-13) — Zoho CRM Sync: NOT FOUND fix, 🧩 Field Mapping, ⏰ Daily Schedule

**User report:** some students showed NOT FOUND, for example `aadhan_aps3319@…` in the dashboard and `AADHAN_APS3319@…` in Zoho. The user asked to override Zoho values, add a Field Mapping sub-tab with override and default options, and add a daily scheduled sync.

**NOT FOUND — analysis and fixes:**
- r70 already lowercased both sides, so letter case alone would not cause NOT FOUND. Three plausible causes remain, and all three are now handled:
  1. **Paging.** r70 followed only `info.next_page_token`. If Zoho answers `more_records: true` with no token, the read stopped after the first 200 records. `zhReadAllStudents_` now falls back to `page=2, 3…`, up to Zoho's 2,000-record page limit, and reports when it stopped early.
  2. **Records the API user cannot list** (sharing rules / profile). Students missing from the bulk list are looked up with Zoho search (`zhSearchEmail_`): first `criteria=(Student_APS_Email_Address:equals:…)`, then optionally `?email=…` across every email field. The cap is `searchMax` per run (default 100). The row then says "Found (search: …)" and advises checking the API user's visibility.
  3. **Hidden characters.** `zhEmail_` now also removes spaces, NBSP, zero-width characters and a `mailto:` prefix, on both sides.
- Every Preview / Sync now reports `zohoRecordsRead`, `foundBySearch`, `searches` and `zohoReadTruncated`, so an Admin can compare against Zoho's own record count.

**Field Mapping (sub-tab 🧩):**
- **Storage:** Script Property `ZOHO_FIELD_MAPPING`, a JSON list of ≤40 rows `{zohoApi, source, transform, mode, defaultValue, enabled}`.
- **Matching settings:** `ZOHO_SYNC_SETTINGS` `{searchFallback, otherEmailFields, searchMax}`.
- **Audit:** `ZOHO_FIELD_MAPPING_AUDIT` in the Zoho sync spreadsheet. Columns: Date/Time, Admin, Change (Added / Changed / Removed lines), Before JSON, After JSON.
- **Sources (`ZH_SOURCES_`), all from the course cache:**
  - Student: email, name, APSID.
  - Class: full / short Classroom name, Grade, section, day, time, day + time, academic year, course ID, Classroom link.
  - People: Class Teacher, VP and HM name / email (`tccPrimary_` / `tkClassChain_`).
  - Other: sync date, and FIXED.
- **Zoho fields:** the whole module's field list, from `/settings/fields` (cached 6 h in `aps_zoho_meta_v2`).
  - Writable types: text, textarea, email, phone, website, picklist, integer, bigint, double, currency, decimal, percent, boolean, date, datetime.
  - Lookups, subforms, files, formulas, read-only and system fields are shown but cannot be selected.
- **Rules (`zhCompare_` / `zhTyped_`):**
  - value = transform(dashboard value), or the Default when blank; FIXED always uses the Default.
  - A blank value is never sent.
  - Type checks: picklist (Zoho's own spelling), email, number, boolean, date, datetime, max length. A value that fails is skipped with a note.
  - Mode **Overwrite** sends when the value differs (exact comparison, so casing gets corrected). **Fill only if blank** keeps any existing Zoho value.
- **Save validation:** the field exists and is writable; no field mapped twice; the match field only takes the Student APS Email; FIXED needs a Default; the Default is type-checked; at least one row is on.
- **Endpoints:**
  - `getZohoFieldMapping(token, {refresh, sampleEmail})`
  - `saveZohoFieldMapping(token, {mapping, settings})`
  - `testZohoFieldMapping(token, {email, mapping})`: reads one record, writes nothing, saves nothing.
- **Default behaviour:** without a saved mapping, the recommended mapping is used. It is the r70 four fields plus **Student APS Email Address ← Student APS Email (lowercase, Overwrite)**, which rewrites `AADHAN_…` to `aadhan_…` in Zoho, as the user asked.

**Daily Schedule (sub-tab ⏰):**
- `saveZohoSyncSchedule(token, {enabled, hour, minute (0/15/30/45), emailSummary})`. Admin only.
  - It refuses to switch on if Zoho or the mapping isn't usable.
  - It keeps exactly one trigger, `apsZohoDailySync`, set to `everyDays(1).atHour(h).nearMinute(m).inTimezone(America/New_York)`.
  - The setting is stored in `ZOHO_SYNC_SCHEDULE`.
- `apsZohoDailySync()` takes the script lock and runs `zhRunSync_` (the same code as the buttons) with `{all: true}` as "Daily schedule (set by …)". It logs SCHEDULED_SYNC_ALL, stores `ZOHO_SYNC_LAST_SCHEDULED`, and optionally emails a summary to the admin who set it via `attMailSend_` / `apsEmailShell_` (prompt rule 6).

**Other changes:**
- `runZohoStudentSync` is now a thin wrapper (confirm, requestId, lock) around `zhRunSync_`.
- The sync and log sheets gain an **All Field Changes** column. Existing sheets get the new header automatically (`zhSheet_`).
- The UI shows "Kept Zoho value" on rows where Fill only if blank applied.

**Security:** unchanged. Every new endpoint calls `zhRequireAdmin_`, and secrets are never returned or logged.

**Zoho design (§21):** toward. The mapping is the configurable Dashboard → Zoho field map; values come only from the dashboard's own data.

**Tests:**
- New `test/zoho_mapping.js` (10): AADHAN case, invisible characters and mailto; record missing from the list found by search, and NOT FOUND when search is off; other email field; page-number paging; field list / writable flags / sample; save validation (9 cases); Overwrite / Fill only if blank / Default / Fixed / transform / picklist spelling / date, plus audit and "unchanged" saves; Test with Zoho; schedule trigger on / change / off, permissions, refusal without Zoho; the scheduled run itself.
- New `test/ui_zoho71.js` (4): Field Mapping UI end-to-end (recommended rows, disabled lookup, add rows, live preview, picklist check, duplicate flag, Test with Zoho, Save and audit), Sync with the saved mapping and an UPPERCASE Zoho email, Daily Schedule UI, phone layout.
- `test/zoho.js`: two expectations updated. An UPPERCASE teacher email in Zoho is now overwritten, and the email casing change is listed.
- `test/zohomock.js`: adds search (criteria / email), hidden-from-list records and token-less paging.

## Round 72 (2026-10-14) — Zoho CRM Sync: always ignore values that are the same

**User request:** "always ignore if ZOHO field value and APS Dashboard values are same."

**Change (Code.gs, `zhCompare_`):** field equality now goes through `zhSame_` / `zhCanon_`.
- **Text fields:** capitals, runs of spaces / NBSP and zero-width characters are ignored.
- **Email fields:** the match-key normalisation is used (`zhEmail_`: no spaces or invisible characters, no `mailto:`, lowercase).
- **Numbers, booleans, datetimes:** compared as before.
- The result is that `AADHAN_APS3319@…` vs `aadhan_aps3319@…`, `Nilai 4` vs `NILAI 4`, and double spaces count as **the same**. The field is not sent, and a student whose only differences are of this kind shows **NO CHANGE**; no Zoho update call is made for them.
- This reverses r71's behaviour of rewriting an UPPERCASE email in Zoho to lowercase. A blank Zoho field is still filled, and a real difference is still updated.
- The same rule applies to the Preview, to the fresh re-read just before an update, to Test with Zoho and to the daily scheduled sync, because they all use `zhCompare_`.

**Tests:**
- `test/zoho_mapping.js`: the AADHAN case now expects NO CHANGE with no PUT. A Teacher Name that differs only in capitals / spaces, and a Classroom name with doubled spaces, give NO CHANGE; a real different name gives READY with only that field.
- `test/zoho.js`: an UPPERCASE teacher email gives NO CHANGE again; the email row is not in the changed list.
- `test/ui_zoho71.js`: Test with Zoho shows "no change" for the email; Sync leaves the UPPERCASE Zoho email untouched and does not send it.

**Zoho design (§21):** neutral.

**Rollback:** redeploy r71 Code.gs.

## Round 73 (2026-10-14) — Zoho CRM Sync in batch mode (1,041 students) + "URLFetch URL Length" fix

**User report:** the sync could not run for about 1,041 records, failing with **"Limit Exceeded: URLFetch URL Length."** The user asked for batch mode (suggesting 75 per batch, or the best size), a daily run, and minimal API / token use.

**Root cause:**
- Right before updating, `zhReadByIds_` re-read up to 100 records per call with `?ids=<id1,id2,…>`.
- Zoho record ids are 19 digits, and the commas were URL-encoded (`%2C`), so 100 ids made a URL of about 2,300 characters.
- Apps Script refuses UrlFetch URLs over about 2 KB. It only showed with many changed students in one run, because only READY records are re-read.

**Fix:**
- `zhReadByIds_` packs ids into as few calls as fit under `ZH_URL_MAX_` (1,900 characters), about 85–90 ids per call, never more than 100.
- Ids and field API names go through `zhUrlList_` (plain commas; only `[A-Za-z0-9_]`).
- `zhFetch_` refuses any URL over 2,000 characters with a clear message, instead of Google's error.

**Recommended batch size: 75 (default; choices 25 / 50 / 75 / 100).** 75 ids always fit in ONE read-by-id URL, so a batch costs at most 2 Zoho calls (1 read + 1 update, at most 75 records each). 100 would need 2 reads + 1 update. For 1,041 students that is 14 batches, at most about 28 calls plus the one list read (≈6 calls). A batch with nothing to change makes no call at all.

**Batch jobs (Code.gs):**
- **Job storage:** Script Property `ZOHO_SYNC_JOB`. It holds id, op, actor, mode (all / selected), batchSize, total, processed, batches, cursor (last student email done), totals, apiCalls, searches, timestamps and status (RUNNING / DONE / CANCELLED / FAILED).
  - Students are processed in email order after the cursor, so a resume never repeats or skips anyone.
  - A selected-students list is stored in chunked properties `ZOHO_SYNC_JOB_SEL_n` (8 KB each) and removed when the job ends.
- **`zhJobStep_(budgetMs)`:** runs at least one batch, then more until the budget is used. Each batch:
  1. Matches from the cached index.
  2. Searches for missing students, within the per-job limit.
  3. Calls `zhApplyUpdates_` (fresh read-by-id, recompare, update only changed fields).
  4. Writes the latest-per-student sheet and the log (one RUN row per batch).
  5. Saves progress.
  - A cancel is detected between batches.
  - When work remains, a one-off trigger `apsZohoSyncContinue` (in about 1 minute) continues the job.
  - Errors: three consecutive step failures end the job as FAILED; otherwise it retries in 2 minutes.
  - A job not updated for 30 minutes is treated as stalled.
- **Zoho list index (`zhIndexGet_`):** one bulk read, cached in chunks (`aps_zh_idx_v1`, 20-minute reuse, dropped when a job finishes). Preview always reads fresh and a sync started within 20 minutes reuses it. Updates are safe with a slightly older list because records are re-read by id just before writing.
- **Endpoints:**
  - `startZohoSyncJob(token, {all | emails, batchSize, confirmed})`: creates the job and sets a 3-minute safety-net trigger. The chosen batch size is remembered for the schedule.
  - `stepZohoSyncJob(token)`: up to 75 s of batches.
  - `getZohoSyncJob(token)`
  - `cancelZohoSyncJob(token)`
  - `runZohoStudentSync` (kept) starts a job and runs up to 4.5 minutes. If students remain, it returns `inProgress: true` and the trigger finishes the job.
  - `apsZohoDailySync` starts a scheduled job and runs up to 4.5 minutes; triggers continue the rest. The summary email and `ZOHO_SYNC_LAST_SCHEDULED` are written when the job finishes.
  - Every endpoint calls `zhRequireAdmin_`. A script lock prevents overlapping steps.
- **API-call accounting:** `ZH_API_CALLS_` counts every Zoho CRM call, including the 6-hour-cached metadata read when it happens. The job, the progress card, the log and the daily email report it. The OAuth access token is cached about 55 minutes and shared by all batches and executions.

**UI (Dashboard.html):**
- A **Batch size** selector next to the sync buttons (75 recommended).
- The confirmation box states the batch size.
- **Progress card:** bar, processed / total, batch n of N, totals, Zoho API calls, Zoho records read, last problem, **▶ Continue here** and **⏹ Cancel after this batch**.
- The page drives the job step by step. If it is closed or fails, the server trigger finishes it, and reopening the tab shows the running or last job.

**Also in this release (r72, not saved separately):** values that are the same apart from capitals / spaces / invisible characters are ignored (`zhSame_` / `zhCanon_`).

**Tests:**
- New `test/zoho_batch.js` (9), with 19-digit ids: no URL over 2 KB; 75-record batches use one read and one update each, with API calls counted; a no-change run makes zero read / update calls and reuses the preview list; a page-driven job goes step by step to DONE with no repeats, the trigger is set and removed, and the log has per-batch rows; the trigger finishes the job alone; cancel; stalled job; Sync Selected job with chunked selection; a failing record does not stop the job; three step failures end it as FAILED; the daily schedule runs as a job; non-admins are refused.
- `test/ui_zoho71.js` +1 (5): batch UI end-to-end with batch size 25, progress to 100 %, batch size remembered, last job shown again.
- Mocks: `zohomock.js` throws Apps Script's URL-length error for URLs over 2,082 characters; `gasmock.js` triggers support `.after()`.

**Rollback:** redeploy r71 Code.gs and Dashboard.html, and delete any `apsZohoSyncContinue` trigger.
- **Full regression:** 53 suites, all passed (rc=0, 0 failures).

## Round 74 (2026-10-14) — 👣 தமிழ்த் தடம் (Tamil Thadam): student-only achievement journey

**Scope:** a new student-only tab, implemented as a self-contained module (Code.gs `td*` + `getTamilThadam`; Dashboard.html `td*`). No existing module, role, API or data structure was changed except:
- the new Access Control row `tamilThadam` (cells `LLLLYLL`: available to students only; the catalog now has 36 rows) — r75: now `AYLLYLL`, see Round 75);
- small `gasmock.js` additions for tests (`SpreadsheetApp.create`, `getId`).

**Security (server-side):**
- `getTamilThadam(token, {year})` is the **only** endpoint, and it is read-only.
- `tdRequireStudent_` requires a valid session with role `student` (Admin / Super Admin / HM / Teacher / VP / BOD / authorized are refused) and then `apsRequireTabForToken_('tamilThadam')`.
- The student is always the session's own email. Any `apsid` / `email` parameter is ignored, and only the academic year is read from the request.
- No endpoint exists for any role to add, edit or remove points, badges, levels or streaks, and none returns any student's data to staff.
- `getDashboardData` carries no Tamil Thadam data.

**Data sources (read-only reuse, nothing duplicated):**
- **Attendance:** `attReadRecordsForFilters_({}, null)`. STUDENT rows of this email:
  - effective score > 0 → CLASS +10, once per course + class week;
  - score ≥ 100 → FULL_CLASS +25;
  - learning streak = consecutive recorded class weeks joined. An absent recorded week ends a run; a week with no class does not. Milestones at 4 / 6 / 10 weeks give STREAK +25, once per academic year.
- **Grading:** `rosterDataset_` (the student's own classrooms) + `gradesForCourses_`, approved prefixes only. A submission state of TURNED_IN / RETURNED counts as completed:
  - HW_ → HOMEWORK +10, plus ON_TIME +5 when not late;
  - QUZ_ → QUIZ +10, plus QUIZ_HIGH +10 when the grade is at least 80 % of max points;
  - TRMST → PROJECT +20;
  - MODEL_EXAM / EXAM → EXAM +10;
  - ATT_ is ignored, because attendance is never counted twice.
  - Homework % = completed ÷ (completed + those past their due date).
- **Appreciation:** `Appreciation_Certificate_Audit` rows with Result SENT, the student letter type, and this recipient → APPRECIATION +20.
- **Not tracked yet:** speaking / reading / cultural / participation are shown as "Coming Soon", and their badges show a "Coming Soon" tag; nothing is estimated.
- A source that is unavailable degrades to "Coming Soon" for its metrics, and a zero count is not shown at all.

**No duplicates and auditable:**
- Each activity has a deterministic id from its source record (`CLASS|course|week`, `HW|courseworkId`, `APR|timestamp`, `STREAK|year|n`, …). Ids are de-duplicated, and totals are always re-derived from the activity list.
- Separate workbook: Script Property `TAMIL_THADAM_SPREADSHEET_ID`, created on first use under a lock and not shared. It holds:
  - `TAMIL_THADAM_STUDENT`: Key = email|year, APSID, name, year, totals, level, badge count, streak, best streak, last activity, timestamp, plus a compact activity snapshot and earned badges with dates. An earlier year is shown from this snapshot.
  - `TAMIL_THADAM_ACTIVITY`: an append-only ledger. A new activity is written as AWARDED. When a source record no longer supports an activity (a corrected attendance record, for example), it is written as VOIDED with negative points, internally only. The ledger always sums to the total.
  - `TAMIL_THADAM_BADGES`: definitions, seeded with 14 defaults. New badges are new rows using any known metric; inactive rows and unknown metrics are ignored.
  - `TAMIL_THADAM_STUDENT_BADGES`: one row per badge, recorded once, when it is first earned.
- Badge earned dates are deterministic: the date of the activity that crossed the threshold.
- Persistence happens when the student opens the tab (under a script lock). The result is cached 10 minutes per student and year.

**Academic years:** the year of each activity comes from its date (Aug 1 – Jul 31). The current year is `rosterAcademicYear_()`; earlier years come from the stored snapshot and appear in a year selector.

**Levels:**
- 🌱 தமிழ் தொடக்கம்: 0
- 🌿 தமிழ் வளர்ச்சி: 200
- ⭐ தமிழ் திறமை: 500
- 🏆 தமிழ் சாதனை: 1,000
- 👑 தமிழ் சிறப்பு: 2,000

Progress to the next level is worded as "your next milestone is getting closer".

**Certificate:**
- It appears when the academic year has ended (from June 1 of the end year), or early when the year is listed in `TAMIL_THADAM_CERTIFICATE_YEARS`, and only when the student has at least one activity.
- It shows name, APSID, year, level, points, achievements, issue date and a number `TT-<yy><yy>-<APSID>-<HMAC6>`, which is stable.
- It is a print-friendly HTML certificate (Print / Save as PDF).

**UI:**
- Tab `#tabTamilThadam` ("👣 தமிழ்த் தடம் Tamil Thadam"), shown only when `currentUser.role === 'student'` and Access Control allows it. `acRedirectView_` sends anyone else to Classes.

## Round 75 (2026-10-14) — Tamil Thadam read-only look-up for Admin / Super Admin; Super Admin can switch every tab

### 1. 👣 Tamil Thadam — Admin / Super Admin read-only look-up
**Approved by the user:** "View any student, read-only". This changes the r74 rule "no staff can see it" for Admin / Super Admin only. HM, VP, Teachers, BOD and authorized are still refused by the server.

- `tdRequireStudent_` is replaced by `tdViewer_(sessionToken, opts)`:
  - **Student:** always their own email. Any `studentEmail` sent by the browser is ignored.
  - **Admin / Super Admin:** `apsRequireTabForToken_('tamilThadam')`. `opts.studentEmail` is required and must be a student of an AY course on the server (from the roster); otherwise the call is refused.
  - **Any other role:** refused.
- New `searchTamilThadamStudents(sessionToken, query)` (Admin / Super Admin only; tab check). A query shorter than 2 characters returns nothing. It returns at most 20 students `{email, name, apsId, classroom}`, matched on name / email substring or an exact APSID.
- Each admin view appends a row to `TAMIL_THADAM_VIEW_AUDIT` (Date_Time, Viewed_By, Viewer_Role, Student_Email, APSID, Academic_Year) in the Tamil Thadam workbook. The response carries `viewer: {mode:'admin', readOnly:true}`. No write endpoint exists for anyone.

### 2. Access Control — Super Admin can switch every tab and sub-tab for every role
**Approved by the user:** "Every tab a role can use".
- New helpers:
  - `acProtected_`: the pair (superadmin, adminControl) / (superadmin, adminControl.access) can never be switched, so nobody is locked out.
  - `acSwitchable_`: Y, or A unless protected.
  - `acEditableBy_(item, role, viewerRole)`: Admin can change Y cells; Super Admin can change Y and unprotected A cells.
- Changes to existing functions:
  - `saveAccessControl` refuses A cells for Admin ("only Super Admin can change it") and the protected pair for everyone. L cells are always refused.
  - `acEffectiveForRole_`, `apsTabAllowed_` and `acCellValue_` honour saved values on unprotected A cells. The parent → child cascade now includes A children (except the protected pair).

- New server enforcement where none was needed before (these were always on):
  - `acRequireAdmin_` checks `adminControl.access`, so Super Admin can switch Access Control off for Admin.
  - `requireSuperAdminViewer_` (User Roles & Permissions) checks `adminControl.userRoles`.
  - Backup & Archive already checked `adminControl.backup`.
- Client:

- **Note:** Access Control rows saved before r75 can only be on Y cells, because saves to A cells were refused. Existing settings keep their meaning.

## Round 76 (2026-10-16) — Parent-Teacher Arranged Class Coverage: "START GOOGLE MEET" notifications

**Scope:** a new self-contained module appended to Code.gs (`pta*` helpers plus 7 public functions). No existing function was changed. Dashboard.html is unchanged apart from the user's own Tamil spelling edits ("தமிழ்த் தடம்", merged as-is). The user's new Knowledge Base video in Code.gs was also kept.

**Status source (reused, not duplicated):** `readTeacherAvailabilityMap_()` reads `Teacher_Weekly_Availability`, keyed `weekId|courseId` and set from the class card through `setTeacherAvailabilityStatus`.
- `ptaClassStatusLabel_` builds "Not Available to Take Classes - " + `CTA_AVAIL_ALT_LABELS_[alternative]`.
- `ptaIsParentTeacherArranged_` matches it **exactly** against `PTA_STATUS_LABEL_` = "Not Available to Take Classes - Parent-Teacher Arranged".
- Sub-Teacher Arranged, Need HM Support, On-Call Assigned, plain Not Available and Available never match.

**Windows (`PTA_WINDOWS_`, America/New_York = `APS_TZ`):**

| Window | Time | Classes included |
|---|---|---|
| FRIDAY | ~17:30 | FRI / SAT / SUN |
| SATURDAY | ~11:30 | SAT / SUN |
| SUNDAY | ~18:30 | SUN |

- The class week is `getCurrentWeekId_(now)` (the Fri–Sun block; its Friday is the anchor).
- Each class's day comes from its Classroom name (`tccSchedule_` → `parseAPSClassroomName`). The class date = Friday + 0 / 1 / 2.
- A handler that runs on the wrong New York weekday logs SKIPPED and sends nothing.
- A session that has already ended at run time (`tccZoned_` end ≤ now) is left out and counted as Ended.
- Only ACTIVE courses (the course cache comes from ACTIVE-only syncs, plus an extra `courseState` check) whose name passes `courseNameMatches_` (AY26-27).

**Reused data:**
- Primary teacher: `tccPrimary_`. HM / VP: `tkClassChain_` (from the Room labels via classSupport).
- Meet: `tccMeetFor_` + `classMeetLinkMaps_`. Admin mapping and the class description are verified. A class-stream link is shown with a "please confirm" note. A Meet detected only from past logs is treated as missing.
- Classroom link: `course.link`. Coverage note: `cctReadRecords_`. Temporary Class Coverage merge: `tccCoverageMap_`.
- The Parent-Teacher Arranged teacher's name/email is **not stored anywhere** in the dashboard, so it shows as "Not recorded in the dashboard". Adding it would need a new field on the class card; not done here (no new data source).

**Email:**
- One consolidated email per run via the existing transport `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS', …)`.
- From = `TICKET_MAIL_FROM` (default donotreply@). OAuth comes from Script Properties `TICKET_MAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` / `TICKET_MAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` / `TICKET_MAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN`, or `TICKET_MAIL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON`. `TICKET_MAIL_ALLOW_MAILAPP_FALLBACK=true` allows the MailApp fallback. No secret is in the code.
- The TEST-environment redirect (`apsTestMailGuard_`) applies as for every other email.
- To = the de-duplicated Primary / HM / VP emails of all listed classes (admin@ removed from To). CC = `attMailAdminCc_()` (admin@). If nobody is named, the email goes To admin@.
- HTML: `apsEmailShell_` (APS logo/footer), the notice, then day groups. Each class card has its own `▶ START GOOGLE MEET` anchor (`target="_blank"`, that class's Meet URL), the raw URL as a fallback, and the "cannot start this Google Meet" sentence. Then **⚠️ Action Required / Missing Information**.
- A plain-text part is included.
- **Sender:** prompt §21.5 rule 6 (attendance@ only) is overridden for this feature by the user's explicit request: donotreply@.

**Duplicate prevention:** new sheet `Parent_Teacher_Arranged_Notify_Log` (Logged_At, Run_ID, Row_Type RUN|CLASS, Notification_Window, Notification_Key, Course_ID, Classroom, Class_Date, Class_Day, Primary_Teacher, HM, VP, Meet_URL, Recipients, Result, Details).
- No existing log fits a per-class key: `Teacher_Availability_Email_Log` is a per-report run log.
- Notification_Key = `COURSE_ID|yyyy-MM-dd|WINDOW`. Keys with Result SENT are skipped, under the script lock, so a re-run or double trigger never re-sends.
- A FAILED send writes FAILED rows, so the next run retries.
- RUN rows record: Window, Run time, Courses found, Eligible, Friday / Saturday / Sunday counts, Recipients, Emails sent, Duplicate/Already sent, Ended, Missing Meet URL / Primary Teacher / HM / VP, Errors.

**Public functions:**
- Trigger handlers (refuse anything but their own trigger, via `apsRequireTriggerCall_`): `apsPtaCoverageNotifyFriday`, `apsPtaCoverageNotifySaturday`, `apsPtaCoverageNotifySunday`.
- Editor / owner only (`apsRequireOwnerOrTrigger_`):
  - `createParentTeacherArrangedCoverageTriggers`: deletes the three, then creates `onWeekDay(...).atHour(h).nearMinute(30).inTimezone(APS_TZ)`.
  - `removeParentTeacherArrangedCoverageTriggers`.
  - `previewParentTeacherArrangedCoverage(window)`: dry run.
  - `runParentTeacherArrangedCoverageNow(window)`: only on that window's own weekday.
- Switch: `PTA_COVERAGE_NOTIFY_ENABLED` (default true).
- **Timing:** Apps Script fires weekly triggers within about ±15 minutes of the chosen minute.

**Zoho target design (rule 11):** neutral. No data-model change; the log is keyed by Course ID and contains no student rows.

**Tests:**
- New `test/pta.js` (8): exact status only; one consolidated email (sender, To/CC dedupe, subject, day groups, one button per class with its own Meet, missing-information section, text part); re-run safety and a newly arranged class sent alone; Saturday / Sunday windows; class-date and ended logic; AY / ACTIVE filter; send failure → retry; disabled switch; trigger setup (3 triggers, no duplicates, editor-only) and handler guards.
- `gasmock.js`: `ScriptApp.WeekDay` gains FRIDAY / SATURDAY / SUNDAY.
- `ui_tamil.js`: follows the user's spelling change.

**Rollback:** run `removeParentTeacherArrangedCoverageTriggers()`, or set `PTA_COVERAGE_NOTIFY_ENABLED=false`, or redeploy r75 Code.gs. The log sheet can stay.
- **Full regression:** 56 suites (55 + new pta.js), all passed (rc=0, 0 failures).

## Round 77 (2026-10-17) — Temporary Class Coverage decision support + speed; Class Teacher Availability colours

**Principle:** surgical, presentation-first. No sheet or column changes. No change to permissions, merge logic, emails, Classroom calls or Teacher Availability logic. The only behaviour change is the requested explicit confirmation when the destination already hosts coverage.

**Code.gs**
- `tccPlan_`:
  - Reads `tccRows_()` **once** per plan. Before, it read the merge sheet `1 + 2×N` times: `busy` and `hosting` re-read the whole sheet for every candidate.
  - Each destination now carries `teacherApsId`, `availability {weekId, weekLabel, current, state, lines[], error}`, `apsTeacher {level, classes}` and `hosting [{source, date, mergeId}]`, via the new `tccDecorateDest_`. This is wrapped in try/catch, so a failure only flags `availability.error`.
  - Destinations are sorted by `tccDestRank_` (ranking only; never auto-selected).
  - `plan.destHosting` is set and also returned by `tccPublicPlan_`.
- New `tccDestContext_` loads everything once per plan:
  - the session's class week, via `attWeekIdForDateStr_` (same Friday-anchored key as Teacher Availability, America/New_York);
  - `readTeacherAvailabilityMap_()` (class card, `Teacher_Weekly_Availability`);
  - `ctaReadSelections_(week)` (Teacher Availability form);
  - Primary Teacher counts from `classSupport`.
  - Other new helpers: `tccTimeText_`, `TCC_DAY_FULL_`.
- **Availability rules:** only the session's class week, never older weeks, never inferred from the schedule.
  - If the session is in the current class week it is labelled "This Week"; otherwise "Week of …" (an upcoming week normally has no record yet, so it shows "No availability submitted").
  - Badge state: the class-card answer for that destination class first, then the form status; otherwise not submitted.
- **APS teacher:** "existing" only when an APSID is parsed from the teacher's APS email (`extractAPSID_`) AND the teacher is the PRIMARY_TEACHER (Course Description) of ≥1 active AY class. "Newer" / "Experienced" are not shown: there is no reliable tenure data (`Class_Access_Map.First Seen` only dates from the class-support sync).
- `applyCoverage` refuses when `plan.destHosting > 0 && req.confirmMultiHost !== true` (warn-and-confirm, never a hard block).
  - Existing hard rules are unchanged: an original class already arranged or hosting is blocked; a destination whose own teacher is unavailable that day is blocked.
- `getDashboardData` adds `course.teacherAvailabilityAlt` (the arrangement key, or 'none' for Not Available without one) for the quick filter. `teacherAvailabilityStatus` is unchanged.

**Dashboard.html**
- Destination list (`tccRenderPlan_`):
  - Badges come from `tccDestBadges_` / `tccAvailBadge_`; details from `tccDestDetails_`.
  - The summary shows the destination teacher's APSID.
  - `#tccMultiBox` + `#tccMultiOk` (`tccRenderMulti_`): "Destination Class Already Has Temporary Coverage" for 1, "Multiple Classes Already Combined" for ≥2. `tccSyncApply_` requires the tick, and `applyCoverage` sends `confirmMultiHost`.
  - Selecting a destination calls `tccMarkDest_`, which highlights the choice at once and shows "Loading the coverage summary…" (`#tccDestStatus`). The rest of the screen stays usable.
  - All of this uses the one `getCoveragePlan` response: **no new server calls**.
- **Colours:**
  - `getTeacherAvailabilityStatusStyle(status)` is the single, central mapping, tolerant of case and wording: NEED_HM_SUPPORT 🔴 danger, SUB_TEACHER_ARRANGED 🟢 success, PARENT_TEACHER_ARRANGED 🔵 info, ON_CALL_ASSIGNED 🟣 oncall, TEMPORARY_CLASS_COVERAGE 🟠, NEEDS_REVIEW 🟡.
  - `availabilityStatusInfo` uses it (existing label and class kept, new `availability-status-*` class added). `availabilityChipHtml_` adds the chip on the class card badge (`renderWeeklyInline`) and in the Teacher Availability report (`ctaAvailBadge_`).
  - 🟠 "Temporary Class Coverage" appears on a card whose class is merged today (`coverageToday`).
  - Server email colours are unchanged.
- **Quick filter:** new `alt:*` options in the existing `#teacherAvailabilityFilter`, via `apsAvailFilterMatch_` (the existing three values behave exactly as before).

**API calls / performance (measured on the test fixture: 3 candidates, 1 existing merge):**
- Before: one Destination Class selection = 1 server call with **7** merge-sheet reads (1 + 2×3). With a typical 8–10 matching classes that is 17–21 reads, roughly 2–5 s in Apps Script.
- After: 1 server call with **1** merge-sheet read, plus 2 small reads (class-card availability and the form), whatever the number of candidates: about 0.3–0.8 s.
- No Google Classroom, Zoho or per-class calls are added. Live Classroom re-checks still happen only in `applyCoverage`, as before.

**Zoho target design (rule 11):** neutral.

**Tests:**
- New `test/tcc77.js` (7): APSID, availability states, session-week only, availability failure is non-blocking, APSID missing, existing coverage (1 and 2) plus the server tick, ranking, one merge-sheet read per plan.
- New `test/ui_tcc77.js` (3): decision-support list, slow-server loading line, warning plus extra tick, apply; tablet layout; colour chips, central mapping, quick filter.

**Regression risks:**
- Callers of `applyCoverage` that target a destination already hosting a merge must now send `confirmMultiHost: true` (only the dashboard calls it).
- The destination order changed (ranking).

**Rollback:** redeploy r76 Code.gs and Dashboard.html.
- **Full regression:** 58 suites (56 + tcc77.js + ui_tcc77.js), all passed (rc=0, 0 failures); existing coverage.js / ui_coverage.js unchanged and passing.

## Round 79 (2026-10-17) — 🎓 சிறப்பு வகுப்புகள் (Special Classes)

**Scope:** an additive module (Code.gs `sc*` plus 9 endpoints; Dashboard.html `sc*`, `#scView`, `#tabSpecialClasses`, modals). The only shared change is the Access Control extension below.

**Data**
- Spreadsheet `SPECIAL_CLASSES_SPREADSHEET_ID` (Script Property; default `1itBHvjvjPwQc4BUJMenFdDoqKcSKutjk10v5F_NlpcE`), tab `SPECIAL_CLASSES_SHEET_NAME` (default `APS_SPECIAL_CLASSES_LIVE`).
- The spreadsheet currently holds only an empty "Sheet1" (inspected read-only). It is left untouched; the tab is created on the first Admin save.
- **Columns:**
  - Found **by header name** (case, space and punctuation tolerant, plus aliases).
  - Missing columns are appended at the end on an Admin save. Existing columns are never renamed or moved; unknown columns are kept.
  - Order: Special Class ID, Title, Description, Audience, Mode, Program Start Date, Program End Date, Enrollment Start Date, Enrollment End Date, Fees, Class Start Time, Class End Time, Registration Link, Status, Display Order, Created Date, Created By, Updated Date, Updated By.
  - Then the extras: Mode Details, Class Day, Registration Mode, Card Icon, Instructor / Coordinator, More Info Link, Maximum Seats, Google Classroom ID, Enrollment Options (JSON `[{label, classroomId, seats}]`), Class Link (enrolled only).
- **Values:**
  - Audience is stored as STUDENTS_ONLY / TEACHERS_ONLY / STUDENTS_AND_TEACHERS / ALL; Mode as GOOGLE_CLASSROOM_MEET / ZOOM / OTHER. Labels and codes are both accepted on read.
  - Status is ACTIVE / INACTIVE (blank = ACTIVE).
  - Dates are stored as text `yyyy-MM-dd`. A sheet Date is read in America/New_York.
  - Times are stored as `h:mm AM`. A sheet time value is read in the spreadsheet's time zone.
  - Text beginning with = + - @ is stored with a leading apostrophe (never a formula).
- **Stable ID:** `SC-YYYY-NNN`, created under the script lock. The title is never the key.
- **Bad rows** (missing ID or title, unknown audience, duplicate ID) are skipped and logged. An unreadable date, time or link is blanked for that field only.

**Access**
- **Access Control** gains a cell code **`N`**: available but OFF by default. It is switchable like `Y` (`acSwitchable_`, `acEditableBy_`, `acCellValue_`, `acEffectiveForRole_`, `saveAccessControl`); on the client `acResetRole_` resets N cells to off.
- New row `specialClasses` = `AYNNYNN` (Super Admin A, Admin Y, HM N, Teacher N, Student Y, BOD N, Authorized N). The catalog now has 37 rows.
- Every endpoint calls `apsRequireTabForToken_('specialClasses')`. Unknown roles are refused.
- **Audience** (`scAudienceAllows_`): Students Only = student; Teacher Only = teacher (which includes a class VP / HM) and headmaster; Both = student, teacher, headmaster; All = any role with the tab. Admin / Super Admin see every active program.
- **Management** endpoints need Admin / Super Admin plus `requireDashboardMutationPermission_`.
- Registration Links are sent only for visible programs in the OPEN state, and only as `http(s)` (`javascript:` / `data:` are refused on save and hidden on read).
- Class Links are sent only to people with an ENROLLED record, for current or upcoming programs. Google Classroom IDs never go to non-admins.

**Registration state (derived, never stored; `scState_`):** past Program End → COMPLETED; before Enrollment Start → UPCOMING ("Registration Opens <date>"); after Enrollment End → CLOSED; otherwise OPEN (or NONE when there are no enrollment dates and no link).
- COMPLETED is hidden from users unless the setting `SPECIAL_CLASSES_SHOW_COMPLETED=true` (an Admin setting in the UI).
- Sort order: OPEN, UPCOMING, CLOSED-and-running, other CLOSED, NONE, COMPLETED; then Program Start, Display Order, Title.

**Enrollments (future-ready):**
- Tab `APS_SPECIAL_CLASSES_ENROLLMENTS`: Enrollment_ID, Special_Class_ID, User_Email, User_APSID, User_Name, Role, Enrollment_Option, Google_Classroom_ID (taken from the option, or the program), Enrollment_Status, Payment_Status, Enrollment_Date, Source (ADMIN now; NATIVE later), Added_By, Updated_At, Updated_By, Classroom_Mapping_Status (NOT_MAPPED; for the future automatic Classroom placement), Notes.
- Enrollment_ID, program and email never change after the first write.
- Admin adds people by APS email or APSID (looked up in the course rosters), with duplicate protection.
- **⭐ My Special Classes:** `scMyPrograms_` returns the viewer's non-cancelled enrollments, grouped CURRENT / UPCOMING / PAST, even when the program is completed, inactive or for another audience.
- Native enrollment later only needs a NATIVE_ENROLLMENT Registration Mode branch in `scRegisterHtml_` and an endpoint writing the same row (Source NATIVE).

**Endpoints:** `getSpecialClasses`, `getSpecialClassesAdmin`, `saveSpecialClass`, `setSpecialClassActive`, `saveSpecialClassesSettings`, `getSpecialClassEnrollments`, `addSpecialClassEnrollments`, `updateSpecialClassEnrollment`. There is no delete.

**Audit:** the tab `APS_SPECIAL_CLASSES_AUDIT` (Date_Time, Action, Special_Class_ID, Title, Changed_By, Changed_By_Role, Details) records:
- CREATE_ / UPDATE_ (with the changed fields) / ACTIVATE_ / DEACTIVATE_SPECIAL_CLASS;
- ADD_ / UPDATE_SPECIAL_CLASS_ENROLLMENT;
- UPDATE_SPECIAL_CLASSES_SETTINGS.

There is no generic admin audit in the project; per-feature audit sheets are the existing pattern.

**Caching / performance:** programs and enrollments are each read once (CacheService, 10 minutes, `aps_special_classes_v1` / `aps_special_classes_enr_v1`) and cleared on every change. Filtering happens in memory: no per-card reads, no Classroom calls.

**Errors:** an unreadable spreadsheet gives "⚠️ Special Classes are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later."; other tabs are unaffected. If enrollments can't be read, the programs list still shows.

**Zoho target design (rule 11):** toward. Enrollment rows are keyed by APS email / APSID and leave room for a Zoho ID; statuses are picklists; fees and payment status are display-only. Payment ownership stays with Zoho / PayPal later (rule 2).

**Tests:**
- New `test/special.js` (9): Access Control defaults and refusal; create, IDs and headers; existing-sheet header mapping and bad rows; audience × role and the Access Control on/off switch; date states and ordering; validation; edit and activate / deactivate with audit and no stale cache; a single cached read and the unavailable message; enrollments plus My Special Classes and privacy.
- New `test/ui_special.js` (4): student view, register link, details; teacher off / on; admin manage flow (add with validation, edit, preview, enrollments, deactivate, settings); phone / tablet; unavailable message.
- `accesscontrol.js` / `ui_access.js`: 37 rows; N cells default off.

## Round 80 (2026-10-19) — 👪 APS Parent Portal, phase 1 (separate app) + Dashboard bridge

**Purpose.** Parents enroll children themselves, and the class time can no longer be misread.

- Every class shows **APS CLASS TIME (ET)** and **YOUR LOCAL TIME** side by side.
- The parent ticks a confirmation at class selection and again before PayPal.
- Both confirmations are stored as an audit record.

Design: the Claude Doc *APS Parent Portal — Enrollment & Provisioning Design*, decisions D1–D5 / Q1–Q14 (Oct 19, 2026).

**Architecture.**

- The Parent Portal is a **separate Apps Script web app** (`PARENT_PORTAL/`: `Portal.gs`, `Portal.html`, `appsscript.json`, `README.md`, `tests/`), with its own Restricted workbook (sheets `PP_*`).
- Parents never touch the Dashboard's Google sign-in, roles or tabs. A parent email still resolves to role `none` here.
- The Dashboard stays the **only integration hub** (§21.1). The Portal reaches Zoho, donotreply@ mail and the course cache only through the new signed `doPost` bridge.
- Data owners:
  - Parent / household / registration: **Zoho** (D1). The Portal saves to Zoho first and keeps a working copy.
  - Payment: **PayPal**, checkout in the Portal, captured and verified server-side, copied to Zoho (D2).
  - Seat holds and timezone confirmations: Portal.
  - APSID, Google account, Classroom: Dashboard (phase 3).

**Dashboard changes in this round (surgical; no existing function name, URL, role, sheet or tab changes):**

| Change | Where | Why |
|---|---|---|
| New `doPost` + `portalVerify_`, `portalDispatch_`, `portalLog_`, `portalSendEmail_`, `portalZohoMap_`, `portalZohoUpsert_`, `portalLookupStudent_`, `portalListCourses_`, `portalErr_`, `portalHex_` | **new file `PortalBridge.gs`** in the Dashboard project (Apps Script shares globals across .gs files) | Signed server-to-server bridge for the Portal, kept out of `Code.gs` so it can be added or removed without touching the main file. This is the first `doPost` in the project |
| `apsEmailShell_` takes two new optional opts, `subtitle` and `noButton` | `Code.gs` (patch `PARENT_PORTAL/dashboard_r80_Code.gs.patch`) | Portal emails say "Parent Portal" and sign-in codes carry no Dashboard button. Calls without these opts give **byte-identical** output (test-checked) |
| `APS_CLASS_TIMINGS.MAX_STUDENTS` 7 → **8** | `Code.gs` (same patch) | D4: 8 students maximum per Google Classroom. Class Change capacity checks and the Re-Map warning now use 8 |
| Assign Classroom "OVER 7" / "7-student guideline" texts now read `maxStudents`; Class Change fallback 7 → 8 | `Dashboard.html` (4 lines) | Same cap shown everywhere, from the server value |

**Bridge protocol.**

- **Request body:** `{ portal:1, p:<JSON string {action,data,v}>, ts, nonce, sig }`, where `sig = hex(HMAC-SHA256(PORTAL_SHARED_SECRET, ts + '.' + nonce + '.' + p))`.
- **Refusal codes:**
  - `NOT_CONFIGURED`: no secret, or a secret shorter than 24 characters.
  - `BAD_SIGNATURE`: the signature does not match.
  - `STALE`: the timestamp is more than 5 minutes off.
  - `REPLAY`: a nonce is used a second time (nonces are kept in CacheService for 10 minutes).
  - `TOO_LARGE`: the body is over 200 KB.
  - `UNKNOWN_ACTION`.
- **Actions:**
  - `ping`: env, Zoho configured, mail mode, whether the map is set.
  - `sendEmail`: exactly one recipient, From donotreply@ through `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')`, wrapped in `apsEmailShell_`, optional admin@ CC (`PORTAL_ADMIN_CC`). Two separate daily budgets (soft limits, CacheService): sign-in codes `PORTAL_OTP_DAILY_LIMIT` (800) and notices `PORTAL_MAIL_DAILY_LIMIT` (600), so a flood of code requests cannot block receipts. The TEST guard (r63) still redirects to info@.
  - `zohoUpsert`: logical keys → Zoho API names from `PORTAL_ZOHO_MAP` (never hard-coded). Mapped keys only; blanks never sent; lookups `{id}`. `PUT` when the Zoho ID is known, otherwise `POST /{module}/upsert` with `duplicate_check_fields`. Uses `zhAccessToken_` / `zhFetch_`.
  - `lookupStudent`: course cache (current AY first) plus Zoho search (`zhMeta_`, `zhSearchEmail_`). Parent emails go back to the Portal **server** only.
  - `listCourses`: AY courses with `parseCourseSchedule_` day / start / end, section, `srmClassTeacher_`, and roster emails.
- **Logging:** every call is logged to the new sheet **`Portal_Bridge_Log`** (Date/Time EST, Action, Result, Code, Detail, Duration ms), with no payloads and no secrets.

**New Script Properties (Dashboard):**

- `PORTAL_SHARED_SECRET` (required for the bridge).
- `PORTAL_ZOHO_MAP` (JSON; example in `PARENT_PORTAL/README.md`).
- Optional: `PORTAL_ADMIN_CC`, `PORTAL_REPLY_TO`, `PORTAL_MAIL_DAILY_LIMIT`, `PORTAL_OTP_DAILY_LIMIT`.

**Portal (phase 1) summary.** The Portal side is described in full in `PARENT_PORTAL/README.md`.

- Sign-in: personal email + 6-digit code.
- Household with an IANA timezone; old names such as Asia/Calcutta are canonicalised.
- New / existing child. An existing student is linked only when the parent email matches; otherwise an Admin verification request is sent.
- Class catalog (`ppAdminImportCatalogFromDashboard`): new rows arrive CLOSED with Capacity 8.
- Seat holds: 15 minutes under `LockService`. Seats = Base_Enrolled + paid + live holds.
- Confirmation 1 + confirmation 2, both stored in `PP_TZ_Confirmations`.
- PayPal Orders v2: `PayPal-Request-Id`, capture verified (status / amount / currency / custom_id).
- Discount / waiver request: Admin decides; the seat is reserved up to 60 days.
- After payment the enrollment moves to `EVALUATION_PENDING` (phase 2 next).
- A 10-minute job captures approved orders, releases expired holds and retries deferred Zoho saves.

**Time handling.**

- The class master is Day + Start_ET + End_ET + `America/New_York`.
- Local times are computed on the server for each real class date with `Utilities.formatDate`, through to `PP_TERM_END`.
- A different day is highlighted, and clock-change shifts are listed. For example:
  - Chennai: Sat 5:00 AM → 6:00 AM from Nov 7.
  - London: Sat 12:30 AM ↔ Fri 11:30 PM in the UK/US clock-gap weeks.

**Roles / security.**

- The bridge is server-to-server only, with no browser access. HMAC secrets live only in Script Properties.
- Parents can reach only their own household: children are addressed by list position, never by an ID from the browser.
- The Portal Admin helpers run from the editor only.
- No Dashboard role or Access Control row changes in this round. The Dashboard *Evaluation & Approval* sub-tab (phase 2) will add an `AC_CATALOG_` row.

**Triggers.**

- Dashboard: none added.
- Portal: one `ppTriggerEvery10Min`, installed by `ppInstallTriggers` (duplicate-safe).

**Performance.**

- Each bridge call opens the Dashboard workbook once, for the log row.
- `lookupStudent` / `listCourses` read the cached course list; there are no Classroom API calls.
- Zoho is called only for parent saves and existing-student checks, never on page view.
- The Portal reads each `PP_*` table once per request, memoised.

**Zoho target design (rule 11): toward.** This round implements D1 (Zoho master for parent data, through the Dashboard) and Q9 (Enrollments module). Enrollment Status values follow §21.3, plus a new *Awaiting Parent Confirmation* value that the Zoho admin must add for phase 2.

**Tests (mock runs, Node):**

- `PARENT_PORTAL/tests/portal.test.js`: 39 tests. Time / DST, sign-in, sessions, household, Zoho first, students, existing-student privacy, catalog, holds and the last seat, payment verification and idempotency, closed-tab capture, late payment over capacity, discounts / waivers, cross-household isolation, trigger idempotency. The 10 security tests added after an adversarial review cover: unverified invited parents cannot prove parenthood, invitations need acceptance, no free text in invites, stale PayPal tabs refused, random return tokens ignored, double Pay, hold extension and caps, OTP failure cap, Admin fee preconditions, atomic audit rows.
- `bridge.test.js`: 10 tests, real Portal.gs ↔ **real Code.gs** `doPost`. Signature / replay / stale / not configured, donotreply@ MIME, Zoho mapping, lookup, listCourses, `apsEmailShell_` unchanged, cap 8.
- `ui_e2e.js`: Portal.html in Chromium at desktop (Los Angeles) and phone (Kolkata) sizes, with no page errors.

All passed. **Not executed — environment/authorization required:** a real Apps Script deployment, PayPal sandbox and live Zoho calls.

**Known limitations.** PayPal webhooks are not used, because Apps Script cannot read headers. Rate limits are per email and global, because Apps Script cannot see the caller's IP. Admin actions run from the Portal editor until phase 2.

## Round 81 (2026-10-20) — "New student added to your class" email after every roster sync

**Where:**
- **Hook:** at the end of `rosterRunSync_` (only when the roster tables were written), wrapped in try/catch. An email problem never changes the sync result.
- **When:** the roster sync runs from `gradingRunSync_`: Admin "Sync Now" in Examination → Grading, and the daily `classroomRosterAutoSync` (~5 PM EST, which refreshes the roster when it is older than `APS_GRADING_ROSTER_REFRESH_HOURS`, default 12).
- **Not hooked:** the Classes "Force Sync" (`syncClassroomData`) builds a different cache and has no email.

**Detection (no new data source):**
- `Roster_Students` already stamps `First_Seen` per enrollment (`Course_ID|student`).
- A student is "new" when ACTIVE (an invited student is announced once they accept), `First_Seen` is after the baseline `NEW_STUDENT_EMAIL_SINCE`, and the key is not yet SENT in `New_Student_Email_Log`.
- The first run only sets the baseline, so existing students are never announced.
- A student removed before the sync is never announced.
- A student re-mapped to another class has a new key, so the new class's teacher is told.

**Email:**
- `nsaNotifyAfterSync_` sends one email per class (at most 60 classes per run; the rest go at the next sync). The message is built by `nsaMessage_`.
- **To:** the class Primary Teacher(s) (`tkClassChain_` → `tccPrimary_` → the roster's own teacher columns as a fallback), addressed by name.
- **CC:** the class HM from the Room label (`NEW_STUDENT_EMAIL_CC_HM`, default true) and admin@ (`attMailAdminCc_`). With no Primary Teacher, it goes To admin@ with a "please forward" note.
- **Content:** subject "New student(s) added to your class – <class> (n)". Standard `apsEmailShell_` layout (logo, footer, dashboard button); table of name, APSID, APS email, date added (EST); plain-text part.
- **Sender:** donotreply@ through the shared `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')`, using the existing `TICKET_MAIL_*` Script Properties. The user approved this exception to §21.5 rule 6. In MailApp-fallback mode, Google sends it from the script account under the name "APS Dashboard Tickets (do not reply)".
- The TEST-environment redirect applies.
- **Log:** `New_Student_Email_Log` (Logged_At, Enrollment_Key, Course_ID, Classroom, Student_Name, Student_Email, APSID, Date_Added, To, CC, Result, Details). A FAILED row is retried at the next sync, under the script lock.
- **Switch off:** `NEW_STUDENT_EMAIL_ENABLED=false`. Students waiting while it is off are announced when it is switched back on.

**Zoho target design (rule 11):** toward. The log is keyed by APS email / APSID, and statuses are picklist values.

**Tests:** new `test/nsa.js` (5):
- baseline only on the first run;
- one combined email (To teacher by name, CC HM + admin@, from donotreply@, all fields, no repeats);
- two classes give two emails; no teacher gives admin@;
- a failure is retried, the switch works, and the sync never fails;
- the HM CC switch, and a removed student is not announced.
- **Full regression (on the merged files — r80 Parent Portal edits + r81):** 61 suites, all passed (rc=0, 0 failures).

## Round 82 (2026-10-20) — Bug fix: Attendance Overall % for re-mapped students

**Rule:** Attendance Overall is cumulative across student class / grade re-maps. Historical attendance is kept by the student's identity and the class that applied in each attendance week. The current class assignment must not overwrite or exclude historical attendance.

**Root cause:**
- `Attendance_Summary` keeps one row per **classroom + person** (sum of effective week score × weight, and sum of weight).
- The Weekly Attendance tab (`getAttendanceRecordsForViewer`) and the Monday class report email (`sendWeeklyClassAttendanceReports_` path) read the Overall with `attSummaryKey_(record.courseId, email)`.
- So after a Re-Map every row showed only the weeks of that row's classroom. The reproduction student scored (0×95 + 100×64) / (95 + 64) = **40.3 %**, from the new class LB only, with the four 100 % weeks in PA ignored.

**Fix (Code.gs only, surgical):**
- `readAttendanceSummaryMap_` (still one range read) also adds up, for every **STUDENT**, the same weighted sums of all their classroom rows under `attStudentOverallKey_(email)`. The identity is the APS email.
- New `attOverallFor_(summaryMap, record)` is used at the two places that set `overallPct`. Students get the all-classroom figure. Teachers keep the per-classroom figure, because they teach several classes in the same week.
- Unchanged:
  - the sheet structure;
  - the per-classroom summary rows;
  - the scoring rules (`attEffectiveScore_`, overrides, `attRecordWeight_`) and the rebuild;
  - the O(1) override update (`attApplyOverrideToSummary_`), which updates the classroom row and is picked up by the total;
  - historical rows' Class column;
  - the UI.
- Any number of re-maps is covered, since every classroom row of the student is added.

**Tests:** new `test/attremap.js` (7):
- a student who never moved is unchanged;
- one re-map, then several (A → C → B), with each historical row keeping its own class;
- an override on an old-class week;
- teachers per classroom; no attendance shows "–";
- the result survives a rebuild after a sync;
- the reproduction values (LB only = 40.3 % → 81.6 % across PA + LB when week 1 is an override weighted by its 90 scheduled minutes).
- **Full regression:** 62 suites (61 + attremap.js), all passed (rc=0, 0 failures).

## Round 83 (2026-10-20) — Dashboard Performance Optimization

**Scope:** surgical. No change to business rules, attendance calculations, roles, sheet schema, tab names, Classroom or Zoho behaviour. Work was done in the main project folder (`CURRENT_PROD_CODE` stays read-only, §1).

**Audit (measured with `test/perf_measure.js`: the real start-up path, then each visible tab opened twice; each server call treated as a fresh Apps Script execution):**
- **Sign-in fired 13–14 `google.script.run` calls.** Nine of them were tiny token-only lookups (suffix, phone flag, last sync, last sync error, sheet URL, approver info, letter access, country preference, deployment info), each a full round trip plus a session check.
- **`getCacheSheetUrl` opened the main spreadsheet** for a link that is commented out of the HTML.
- **The main spreadsheet was opened several times in ONE call:** `getWorkbook_()` had no per-execution memo. For example `getDashboardData` opened it 4×, `getTicketBootstrap` 3×, `getChatMessages` / `getWeeklyPanelData` 2×.
- **Revisiting a tab re-fetched everything:** Attendance 6 calls, Assign Classroom 2, Special Classes 1.
- **The 5-minute background `getDashboardData` refresh (≈346 KB for Admin / HM) ran even while the browser tab was hidden.**
- **Already fine:** no `innerHTML +=` loops; the Classes search and filters are local and debounced; no listener growth on tab revisits (checked at runtime); realtime and chat polls already pause while hidden; KB and Directory already cache.

**Changes:**

| Change | Where |
|---|---|
| `getWorkbook_()` per-execution memo `WORKBOOK_MEMO_` (same pattern as the existing `ATTENDANCE_WORKBOOK_MEMO_`; globals reset every execution) | Code.gs |
| `getStartupBundle(token, names)`: runs whitelisted (`APS_BUNDLE_FNS_`) read-only, token-only endpoints in one call. Each still runs its own session / role check and returns its own `{ok}` / `{err}` | Code.gs |
| `apsWrapRunner_` remembers each chain's handlers. Zero-argument calls to whitelisted names (`APS_BATCHABLE_`, which must match the server list) made in the same moment are grouped by `apsBatch_` and dispatched to their own success / failure handlers. A single call, or a failed group, falls back to the normal call; an expired session goes to sign-in as before | Dashboard.html |
| `loadSyncInfo` requests `getCacheSheetUrl` only when `#sheetLink` exists | Dashboard.html |
| `quietRefreshDashboard` skips while `document.hidden`. On `visibilitychange`, if 5 minutes have passed, it refreshes once | Dashboard.html |
| `apsTabFresh_(key, ms)`: a revisit within 2 min reuses what is on screen for Attendance and Assign Classroom (Re-Map). Special Classes reuses its data for 5 min. Each tab's Refresh / Sync / Save / Re-map still reloads, as do Force Sync and the 5-minute data refresh | Dashboard.html |

**Bundle whitelist:** getCourseNameSuffix, getShowContactPhone, getLastSyncInfo, getCacheSheetUrl, getLastSyncError, getGradeChangeApproverInfo, getReferenceLetterAccessInfo, getMyCountryPreference, getAdminWebAppDeploymentInfo, getAttendanceLastSyncInfo, getAttendanceSyncDiagnostics, getCourseMeetLinkMappings, getAttendanceCourseAwkMap, getZohoSyncStatus, getZohoSyncJob.

**Before → after (same fixture, same steps):**

| Role | Sign-in calls | Sign-in spreadsheet opens | First visit to every tab | Second visit to every tab | Sign-in payload |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| admin | 14 → 7 | 11 → 5 | 21 → 17 calls, 15 → 10 opens | 17 → 7 calls, 13 → 4 opens | 420 → 421 KB |
| student | 14 → 8 | 10 → 5 | 10 → 10 calls, 17 → 9 opens | 6 → 4 calls, 7 → 3 opens | 12 → 12 KB |
| teacher | 13 → 7 | 10 → 5 | 8 → 8 calls, 13 → 5 opens | 4 → 3 calls, 7 → 3 opens | 10 → 10 KB |
| headmaster | 13 → 7 | 10 → 5 | 13 → 10 calls, 16 → 7 opens | 9 → 3 calls, 10 → 3 opens | 420 → 420 KB |

Classes search: 0 server calls before and after. Timings in seconds were not measured (the mock has no real Apps Script latency).

**Not changed (identified, left for a separate decision):**
- The Admin / HM `getDashboardData` payload (~346 KB): every field feeds existing card features.
- Tickets / GCM Preview / Zoho / Letters / Admin Control still refresh on every open, because those show live status.

**Tests:**
- New `test/ui_perf.js` (6): grouped start-up with every handler run; fallback when the group fails; session expiry; revisit reuse and reload after the window; local search; hidden-tab refresh skip and catch-up; server whitelist and per-function role checks.
- New measurement tool `test/perf_measure.js`: not in the regression run.
- **Full regression:** 63 suites (62 + ui_perf.js), all passed (rc=0, 0 failures).

## Round 84 (2026-10-21) — Google Review request (students) + Assign Classroom → Add/Remove Student (multi-classroom) + weekly report

### Feature 1 — Google Review request
| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Link | `getGoogleReviewUrl()` — Script Property `APS_GOOGLE_REVIEW_URL` (optional), default `https://g.page/r/CUwNOLbnb2InEAE/review`. Only an `https://` value is accepted; anything else falls back to the default. It is a public link, not a secret. |
| Popup | Students only. At most once per calendar month (America/New_York), key = Script Property `GOOGLE_REVIEW_PROMPT_<email>` = `yyyy-MM` (same per-user Script Property pattern as the Student Login Notices). It is shown after sign-in, **after** the login notices. Buttons: **⭐ Write a Google Review** (a real `<a target="_blank" rel="noopener">`, so pop-up blockers do not stop it), **Maybe Later**, **✕**. Esc and the backdrop also close it. `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, labelled title and message, focus moves in and is kept inside, and goes back on close. Responsive (buttons stack under 480 px). |
| No extra call | The popup state rides on the existing sign-in call `getStudentLoginNoticeStatus` (new field `googleReview`). |
| Header | **⭐ Google Review** link in the header bar (students only). |
| Events | `recordGoogleReviewEvent(token, event, place)`. Events: `GOOGLE_REVIEW_PROMPT_SHOWN`, `GOOGLE_REVIEW_CLICKED`, `GOOGLE_REVIEW_DISMISSED`. Sheet **Google_Review_Events**: Timestamp, APSID (APSXXX when unknown), Email, Name, Role, Event, Source = `Dashboard`, Details = Monthly popup / Header button. Identity comes from the session only. A second SHOWN in the same month is ignored, and repeated clicks are logged once per 20 s (CacheService). Nothing records or claims that a review was posted; Google does not tell us. |
| Email footer | `getGoogleReviewEmailFooter()` (HTML) and `grEmailFooterText_()` (plain text). `apsEmailShell_(title, body, { googleReview: true })` adds it; without that option the shell is byte-for-byte unchanged. Used on two emails: **Add Student** (new) and the Re-Map **“APS Classroom Assignment Updated”** email to the student. It is not used on error, security, alert or internal reports (attendance pause alerts, sync failures, removal, tickets, weekly reports, coverage). |
| Helpers (as named in the request) | `getGoogleReviewUrl()`, `getGoogleReviewEmailFooter()`, `shouldShowGoogleReviewPrompt(token)`, `recordGoogleReviewEvent(token, event, place)`. |

### Feature 2 — Assign Classroom → **Add/Remove Student**
- **Sub-tab:** the r60 "Remove Student" sub-tab is renamed **Add/Remove Student**. The Access Control key stays `assignClassroom.remove`, so saved settings are kept; only the label changes. Inside it, two buttons: **➕ Add Student** (default) and **➖ Remove Student**. The r60 Remove flow is unchanged except:
  - the confirmation title is now "Remove Student from Google Classroom?" with **Confirm Remove** / **Cancel**;
  - the email subject is now `APS Dashboard – Student Removed from Google Classroom – <name>` (sender unchanged: attendance@);
  - each removal also writes one line to the Assign Classroom audit log.
- **Roles:** Admin + Super Admin (`isAdminRole_`). There is no separate "Sub-Admin" role in the dashboard, so Admin covers it. BOD can only read the audit. Everyone else gets **"You do not have permission to perform this action."** from the server (`adsViewer_`), whatever the client sends. The Access Control switch is also checked on the server.
- **Server endpoints:**
  - `getAddStudentContext(token, email)` — steps 1–3:
    - validate the APS email (trim, lowercase, `APS_ALLOWED_DOMAINS`);
    - find the account: dashboard roster → `AdminDirectory.Users.get` → `Classroom.UserProfiles.get`; suspended or archived accounts are refused;
    - list memberships: live `Classroom.Courses.list({studentId, courseStates:['ACTIVE']})`, falling back to the dashboard roster with a notice;
    - list the classroom picker: active AY26-27 classrooms from the course cache, with Nilai, section, day, time, teacher, course ID, count, status, type and `alreadyEnrolled`.
  - `addStudentToClassroom(token, {studentEmail, courseId, requestId, confirmed, confirmMultiRegular})`:
    - under a script lock, re-check: the request ID (idempotency key; a repeat returns the stored result); the classroom (on the dashboard, AY26-27, and `Courses.get` says ACTIVE); the student; the live memberships (same classroom → `ALREADY_ENROLLED`); and Regular + Regular without the tick → `VALIDATION_FAILED`;
    - write the audit row **before** the change;
    - `Classroom.Courses.Students.create` (the same call Re-Map uses; it never removes anyone);
    - verify with `Students.get` (`srmOnRoster_`);
    - patch the dashboard course-cache row: Detail JSON + Student Count, then `invalidateCoursesMemo_`. On failure → `SYNC_PENDING` with the warning "the dashboard data synchronization is pending. Please do not retry";
    - release the lock, then send the email;
    - an email failure gives `EMAIL_FAILED` and a warning. It never rolls back.
  - `cancelAddStudentRequest(token, {...})` — Cancel on the confirmation screen writes one `CANCELLED` row.
- **Classroom types (`adsClassify_`):**
  1. Script Property `CLASSROOM_TYPE_OVERRIDES` (JSON `{courseId: TYPE}`).
  2. Script Property `SPECIAL_CLASS_COURSE_IDS` (comma list), plus the Special Classes sheet (`Google Classroom ID` and every Enrollment Option's classroom ID).
  3. Name fallback: special / workshop / camp / club / summer / spelling / competition / சிறப்பு → `SPECIAL_CLASS`.
  4. An APS Nilai name with a schedule → `REGULAR_ACADEMIC`.
  5. Anything else → `OTHER`.
- **Business rule:** multiple memberships are allowed when intentional:
  - Regular + Special and Special + Special: allowed.
  - Regular + Regular: allowed only after the "I understand…" tick, recorded as `Override_Reason = ADMIN_OVERRIDE`. The button reads **Override & Add**.
  - Same classroom: never added twice.
- **Error messages:** friendly only. Already enrolled; classroom unavailable; permission problem; invalid account; Google Classroom temporarily unavailable. The raw API text goes only to the audit sheet's `Error` column, which is never sent to the browser.
- **Client:**
  - double-submit protection: the button reads "Adding student..." and is disabled, and one request ID per confirmation (kept after a dropped connection);
  - auto-refresh after a change: the audit log, the Remove list and the Re-Map lists;
  - mobile layout without horizontal scroll;
  - tooltips on the new controls.

**Audit:**
- New sheet **Student_Add_Audit** (main workbook). It follows the Student_Removal_Audit pattern: the request fields up to `Source` are written once, and later writes change only the status columns. Cells are written as plain text and never as formulas.
  - Columns: Request_ID, Requested_At, Requested_By, Requested_By_Role, Action, Student_Name, Student_APSID, Student_Email, Existing_Classroom_Count / _Names / _Types, New_Classroom_Name, New_Course_ID, New_Classroom_Type, Override_Reason, Source, Status, Verification_Status, Sheet_Update_Status, Email_Status, Email_Recipients, Result_Message, Error, Completed_At, Zoho_Student_ID (reserved).
  - Actions: `ADD_STUDENT_TO_CLASSROOM`, `ADD_STUDENT_TO_MULTIPLE_CLASSROOMS`, `WEEKLY_MULTIPLE_CLASSROOM_REPORT`. Removals stay in Student_Removal_Audit and are copied as `REMOVE_STUDENT_FROM_CLASSROOM`.
  - Status values: `SUCCESS`, `FAILED`, `CANCELLED`, `ALREADY_ASSIGNED` (Google Classroom returned "already exists" between the check and the add), `ALREADY_ENROLLED` (found in the membership check), `VALIDATION_FAILED`, and `IN_PROGRESS` (transient; a stale one older than 10 minutes no longer blocks).
- Every final add, cancel and removal, plus the weekly report, also appends one line to the existing **Assign Classroom audit sheet**, with `ACTION · STATUS` in its Action column. `getAdminAssignmentAuditLog` splits that into Type / Status, so the existing Re-Map audit table shows these rows. Old rows are unchanged.
- UI: a new **Add Student Audit Log** table with **Action** and **Status** filters. It is loaded by the same `getRemovalContext` call (new fields `canAdd`, `addAudit`, `multiAck`), so there is no extra round trip.

**Email (Add):**
- From donotreply@ (`apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')`, TEST-environment guard included).
- To: the Primary Teacher, HM(s) and VP(s) of the class (`srmClassTeacher_` + `tkClassChain_`), de-duplicated, with admin@ in CC. With no class recipients it goes to admin@.
- Subject: `APS Dashboard – Student Added to Google Classroom – <Student Name>`.
- Body: Vanakkam → student details table (name, APSID, APS email, classroom, type, schedule, teacher, added by, date / time EST, other classrooms) → Nandri, APS Tech Support Team → Google Review footer. HTML + plain text.
- After a sent email the student's roster key is logged as SENT in **New_Student_Email_Log**, so the r81 post-sync "New student added" email does not announce the same student again.

**Weekly report:**
- Trigger: `apsWeeklyMultipleClassroomReport`, Monday ~7:30 AM America/New_York. It is guarded by `apsRequireTriggerCall_`.
- Install it once from the editor with `createMultipleClassroomReportTrigger()`, which is idempotent. Also available: `removeMultipleClassroomReportTrigger()`, `previewMultipleClassroomReport()` and `sendMultipleClassroomReportNow()` (editor / owner only).
- Data: the dashboard's ACTIVE course cache (no Classroom API calls), grouped by normalized email; staff accounts are excluded. Per assignment: type, name, course ID, teacher, schedule, status. Regular + Regular is marked **Requires review** and listed first.
- One email to admin@ from donotreply@, subject `APS Dashboard – Weekly Report – Students Assigned to Multiple Google Classrooms`.
- Sent once per Monday-week (Script Property `MULTI_CLASSROOM_REPORT_LAST_WEEK`), so a second firing is a no-op. Audited as `WEEKLY_MULTIPLE_CLASSROOM_REPORT` with the student count. It never removes anyone.

**Performance:**
- Look-up costs one live `Courses.list` (studentId-filtered) and one Directory lookup only when the student is not on any dashboard roster. The Special Classes sheet is read through its existing 10-minute cache.
- Confirm costs one `Courses.get`, one `Students.create` and one `Students.get`, plus one cache-row patch.
- No new start-up call: Google Review uses the existing notice call, and the add audit uses the existing removal-context call.

**Zoho design:** moves toward it.
- The roster add is a single audited server function with request ID, actor, time and reason (`Override_Reason`), so it can later be written back to Zoho as a note.
- Students are keyed by APS email and APSID, and a `Zoho_Student_ID` column is reserved.
- Status values are explicit picklist-style codes.
- donotreply@ is used for the Add email and the weekly report, as the request specified (the same approved sender as r76 / r81).

**Known limitations:**
- The live membership list needs the Classroom `courses.list?studentId` permission of the deploying account; otherwise the dashboard roster (last sync) is shown with a notice.
- The weekly report covers classrooms in the dashboard's course cache (ACTIVE, synced). A Special Class classroom outside the cache is not counted.
- The Google Review month is tracked per APS email in Script Properties. That is one small property per student, the same as the login notices.

**Tests:**
- New `test/addstudent.js` (13) and `test/ui_addstudent.js` (5), with shared fixture `test/addfixture.js` (not run alone).
- Updated for the new wording: `removal.js`, `testmail.js`, `ui_remove.js` (the Remove button is now behind "➖ Remove Student").
- **Full regression:** 65 suites (63 + addstudent.js + ui_addstudent.js), all passed (rc=0, 0 failures). Not executed: anything that needs the real Google Classroom / Admin Directory / Gmail APIs — environment/authorization required.
