## Round 85 (2026-10-22) — 📚 Assignment & Grading Monitoring

**Purpose:** Detect → Notify Student → Notify Teacher → Follow Up → Escalate → Admin Intervention → Audit, for weekly APS assignments (ATT, HW, QUIZ; more types configurable), inside the existing dashboard.

**Source of truth = Google Classroom, through the existing Grading sync (no second Classroom reader):**
- The data comes from `gradesSyncCore_`: `CourseWork.list` plus one `StudentSubmissions.list(course, '-')` per classroom. It runs daily at 5 PM and on Admin Sync now.
- It is read through the cached `gradesForCourses_` model, plus the roster dataset and the course cache.
- **Sync change (the smallest possible):** the sync now *also* captures monitored titles that the Grading prefixes do not cover (for example `HW-04`, `QUIZ-04`, or an Admin-typed title). It writes the coursework it does not monitor to **AM_Unclassified_CourseWork** so an Admin can classify it.
- The Grading tab and Tamil Thadam still filter with `gradesCategory_`, so what they show is unchanged (tested).
- **The only extra Classroom call:** a live `StudentSubmissions.list` for a classroom just before student reminders go out for it, so a student who turned in after the last sync is never reminded.

**Classification (`amClassify_`):** a title belongs to a type when it **starts with** one of the type's patterns and the next character is not a letter.
- Defaults: ATT ← `ATT`; HW ← `HW`; QUIZ ← `QUIZ`, `QUZ` (the real Classroom titles are `ATT_LSN_5`, `HW_LSN_4`, `QUZ_LSN_4`).
- `HW-04`, `HW_LSN_4` and `att lsn 2` match. `HWK`, `ATTENDANCE NOTES`, `Reading Material` and `TRMST…` do not.
- An Admin-set type (`SET_TYPE` override, per class and coursework) wins over the patterns. Anything else is **UNCLASSIFIED** and is not monitored.

**Status model (`amStatus_`), matched to the Classroom Grades tab:**

| Status | Rule |
|---|---|
| RETURNED | Classroom state RETURNED |
| GRADED | turned in with a grade, or a real grade without a turn-in (ATT "100 · Not turned in") |
| UNGRADED | turned in, no grade, and the assignment has points (grading monitored) |
| TURNED_IN | turned in, and the assignment has no points, or grading monitoring is off for the type |
| MISSING | past due and not turned in. This also covers an assigned **0** on overdue work ("0 · Missing") and a draft grade only ("0 · Draft · Missing") |
| NOT_STARTED | not turned in, not yet due, or no due date |
| EXCLUDED | assignment or student excluded by an Admin |

Submitted-but-ungraded work is **never** counted as missing, anywhere: the dashboard, emails, teacher summaries and reports.

**Who is assigned:** students who have a Classroom submission record for the coursework and are ACTIVE in the roster. A coursework item with no submission records yet is skipped, so the system never guesses.

**Counts and rates:**
- Counts per assignment, class, teacher and overall: assigned, submitted, graded, returned, ungraded, ungraded past the grace days, missing, not started, excluded.
- Submission rate = submitted ÷ (submitted + missing).
- Grading completion = graded ÷ (graded + ungraded).

**Health:**
- 🔴 for a class when missing ≥ `classRedMissingPct`%, or overdue-ungraded ≥ `classRedUngraded`, or the number of students with repeated missing work ≥ `classRedRepeatStudents`.
- 🟡 when there is any missing or overdue-ungraded work. 🟢 otherwise.
- For an assignment: 🔴 when issues ≥ `assignmentRedPct`% of assigned, 🟡 when there are some, 🟢 when complete.

**Escalation (`amEscalate_`, configurable):**
- **L1 Student:** missing.
- **L2 Teacher:** missing ≥ `missingAfterHours`, or ungraded past `gradingGraceDays`.
- **L3 VP / HM:** repeated missing work (≥ `repeatMissing`), a teacher backlog ≥ `vpHmUngradedBacklog`, or the class is 🔴.
- **L4 Admin:** unresolved ≥ `adminAfterDays`.
- An Admin "Reviewed" mark stops an issue from escalating.

**Access:**
- Access Control row `assignMon` (cells `AYYNNNN`):
  - on for Super Admin, Admin and HM;
  - off by default, but switchable, for Teacher, Student, BOD and Authorized.
- A teacher account that is a **class VP / HM** (Room "VP Email:" / "HM Email:") always sees **their own** classes while the module is ON.
- Teachers who are switched on see the classes they teach or support (`userHasCourseAccess_`). Students who are switched on see **only their own rows**.
- Server: `amViewer_` runs on every endpoint. Admin Control actions need `isAdminRole_` plus the mutation permission. `getDashboardData` returns `assignMonAccess` (tab and home card).
- **Master ON/OFF** is Script Property `ASSIGNMENT_MONITORING_CONFIG.enabled`, switched in the tab's ⚙️ Admin Control. OFF means only Admin / Super Admin see the tab, there is no home card and no email, and the scheduler is removed.

**Configuration (Script Property `ASSIGNMENT_MONITORING_CONFIG`, JSON, edited in ⚙️ Admin Control and validated by `amSanitize_`; bad values fall back to the defaults):**
- Master switch.
- Types: code, label, patterns, and whether to monitor, track missing work, and track grading.
- Email switches, which **all start OFF**: student reminders and each stage (R48 / R24 / DUE_DAY / MISSING), teacher Action Required, weekly teacher summary, weekly Admin summary.
- Timing:
  - reminders at 48 h / 24 h / 6 h before the due time, and a missing notice for up to 72 h after it;
  - the teacher email hour (default 7 PM, after the 5 PM sync) and how often it repeats (every 3 days);
  - the Monday summary hour (7 AM).
- Thresholds, the default date window (last 21 days to the next 7 days), the email limit per run (150), and the training link.

**Notifications (all From donotreply@ via `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')`, TEST guard included):**
- **Student:**
  - one email per student per class per run, listing every item due;
  - subject `APS Action Required – <assignment> Due Soon | Missing`, or "… – N assignments need your attention";
  - contents: the student's name, class, assignment, type, due date (EST), current status, the action to take, and the Google Classroom link.
- **Teacher Action Required:**
  - subject `APS Assignment Monitoring – Action Required – <class>`, sent to the Primary Teacher, or to admin@ when there is none;
  - contents: Student Submission Issues, Grading Issues, a summary with grading completion, the Classroom link and the "How to Grade" link.
- **Weekly teacher summary:** `APS Weekly Assignment Summary – <class>`.
- **Weekly Admin summary:** `APS Assignment Monitoring – Weekly Summary`, sent to admin@ with a dashboard button.
- **Duplicates:** prevented by **AM_Notification_Log** (`Notification_Key`):
  - per student, assignment and stage;
  - per class and day for the teacher email, which also repeats at most every N days;
  - per week for the weekly summaries.
- **Ordering:** a later reminder stage never re-sends an earlier one.
- **Live check:** if the live check fails, the item is logged as SUPPRESSED and audited.
- **Mailbox not configured:** sending pauses for that run.
- **Manual reminders** (Admin, with confirmation) are de-duplicated per day.

**Scheduler:**
- **One** hourly trigger, `amScheduler`. It is guarded by `apsRequireTriggerCall_` and the script lock.
- Each run: student reminders; teacher emails at or after `teacherDailyHour`; weekly summaries on Monday at or after `weeklyHour`.
- It is installed automatically when an Admin saves settings with an email channel ON, and removed when every channel is OFF or the module is OFF. One hourly trigger is used instead of three because Apps Script allows 20 triggers per project.
- `createAssignmentMonitoringTrigger()` does the same from the editor.

**Admin Control:**
- Actions: ON/OFF; email switches; timings and thresholds; assignment types; unclassified coursework → "Monitor as"; exclusions and overrides with Remove; Sync Google Classroom now (`gradingRunSync_`); send due student reminders now; per issue, Remind / Exclude student / Reviewed / Note; per class, Teacher reminder; per assignment, Exclude / Include; audit log.
- Every action is audited in **AM_Audit_Log**: MONITORING_ON/OFF, CONFIG_CHANGED, MANUAL_SYNC, EXCLUDE_/INCLUDE_ASSIGNMENT, EXCLUDE_/INCLUDE_STUDENT, SET_TYPE, MARK_REVIEWED, ADD_NOTE, REMOVE_*, MANUAL_STUDENT_REMINDER, MANUAL_TEACHER_REMINDER, RUN_REMINDERS_NOW, REMINDER_SUPPRESSED.
- Overrides live in **AM_Overrides**: Kind EXCLUDE_ASSIGNMENT / EXCLUDE_STUDENT / SET_TYPE / REVIEWED / NOTE, with a reason, the Admin and the date and time. They are deactivated, never deleted.
- Anything that can send email asks first.

**UI:**
- New top tab 📚 Assignment Monitoring, with sections Overview, Student Issues, Teacher Grading, Class Monitoring (class cards with 🟢/🟡/🔴 per assignment, then a click opens the student list, students × assignments with Overall Good / Attention / Action Required), Email / Notification History, and ⚙️ Admin Control.
- Filters: Academic Year, Nilai, Section, Teacher, Class, Type, Assignment, Status, and the due-date range. Search by student name, APSID, APS email, assignment or class. Every filter except the date range is local, with no server call (tested).
- "🎓 How to Grade Google Classroom Assignments": the configured training link, or else the 8 built-in steps plus a link to Knowledge Base – Videos (the existing training videos).
- Home card "📚 Assignment Health · this week" in Classes, via `getAssignmentHealthCard`. It is cached for 10 minutes and grouped with the start-up bundle.
- Responsive layout: tables scroll inside their box, with no horizontal page scroll.

**Endpoints:**
- Read: `getAssignmentMonitoring(token, {from,to})`, `getAssignmentMonitoringClass(token, courseId, {from,to})`, `getAssignmentHealthCard(token)`, `getAssignmentMonitoringHistory(token)`, `getAssignmentMonitoringAdmin(token)`.
- Write: `saveAssignmentMonitoringConfig(token, cfg)`, `amAdminAction(token, req)`.
- Trigger: `amScheduler(e)`.

**Performance:**
- Opening the tab is one call, with no Classroom API call; it reads the cached roster, course and grades plus one overrides-sheet read.
- The class student list loads on demand.
- The item list is capped at 4,000 rows (with a "narrow the date range" notice). The table shows 200 at a time.

**Zoho design:** neutral to it. Students are keyed by APS email and APSID; statuses are explicit picklist values; no parent or payment data is used.

**Known limitations:**
- The data is as fresh as the last Grading sync (daily ~5 PM, or Sync now). Reminders re-check live.
- Coursework assigned to individual students is recognised from its submission records only.
- The weekly Admin summary covers classes in the roster's ACTIVE AY26-27 list.

**Tests:**
- New `test/assignmon.js` (10) and `test/ui_assignmon.js` (4), with fixture `test/amfixture.js` (built on the Grading fixture).
- Updated: `accesscontrol.js` and `ui_access.js` (38 rows; `assignMon` off by default for Teacher / Student / BOD / Authorized). `gasmock.js` gained `everyHours`.
- Also updated: `special.js` (38 rows) and `grading.js`. `att lsn 2` is now captured for monitoring only; the Grading tab still hides it, and with monitoring OFF nothing extra is captured (tested).
- **Full regression:** 67 suites (65 + assignmon.js + ui_assignmon.js), all passed (rc=0, 0 failures). The first run flagged `grading.js` and `special.js` on the expected changes above; both were updated and re-run green, and no product code changed after the run.
- **Not executed:** anything that needs the real Google Classroom, Gmail (donotreply@) or trigger runtime (environment / authorization required).

## Round 86 (2026-10-22) — ATT_ / QUZ_ "Mark as complete" teacher reminder (background job)

**Purpose:** The Google Classroom API cannot perform the teacher-side **Return ▾ → Mark as complete**. Once a day this job finds ATT_ / QUZ_ assignments that are at least 10 days old and emails the class teacher the students who still need it. VP, HM and admin@ are CC'd. The email includes the steps and the Student Work link. **It never changes anything in Google Classroom.** There is no UI.

**Built from the user's script, reviewed and moved onto the dashboard standard:**

| In the script | Now |
|---|---|
| `courseStates: 'ACTIVE,ARCHIVED'` (archived classes would be emailed) | ACTIVE AY26-27 classes only: roster ACTIVE + `courseNameMatches_` |
| Courses / Students / Teachers / CourseWork / per-assignment Submissions / UserProfiles API calls every run (the earlier quota problem) | Reuses the Grading sync data (`gradesForCourses_`; ATT_ / QUZ_ are already captured) + roster + course cache. Only **one live `StudentSubmissions.list(course,'-')` per class that has something to send** |
| Dates via `new Date(y, m-1, d)` in the script time zone (Classroom due dates are UTC → off-by-one) | New York calendar dates: `mcDays_` on `yyyy-MM-dd` (due date from the sync, already EST) |
| Student Work link with raw numeric IDs (does not open) | Web-safe base64 IDs, the same form as the class link, verified against the course link; otherwise the class link |
| Hard-coded spreadsheet ID / admin / info emails; new `Log_<id>` tab every run; MailApp from the owner | Script Properties; two fixed sheets in the main workbook; `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')` = donotreply@ + `apsEmailShell_` (TEST guard) |
| Teacher / VP / HM parsed from text with its own regex | Existing class roles: `srmClassTeacher_` / `tkClassChain_` (Course Description Primary Teacher, Room VP / HM) |
| DRY_RUN had no effect | `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_DRY_RUN=true` → logs `DRY_RUN` rows, sends nothing |
| One email per assignment; Google user / submission IDs | One email per class (all due assignments); students by name + APSID + readable status |
| Class without a teacher email skipped | To admin@ with a "please forward" note |
| Separate Retry_Queue sheet | Retry is implicit: a FAILED send (or failed live check) is never logged as SENT, so the next run sends it again and logs "Retry of an earlier failed send" |

**Rules:**
- Age: due date ≥ `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_AGE_DAYS` (10) days old; with no due date, the created / assigned date. Today 2026-10-22 → due 10-12 eligible, 10-13 skipped.
- States: TURNED_IN and RETURNED are skipped. NEW, CREATED and RECLAIMED_BY_STUDENT are listed, and so is "graded but not returned".
- Only ACTIVE roster students; staff accounts excluded.
- Re-sent per class + assignment at most every `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_REMINDER_DAYS` (3) days while any student still needs it. The subject then says "Reminder". Running twice in a day never sends twice.

**Recipients:**
- To: the Primary Teacher.
- CC: VP(s), HM(s) and admin@ (`ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_CC_VP` / `_CC_HM` / `_CC_ADMIN`, default true).
- Subject `[APS Action Required] Mark Assignment(s) as Complete – [Reminder – ] <assignment –> <class>[ (N assignments)]`.

**Script Properties (all optional):**

| Property | Default |
|---|---|
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_ENABLED` | true |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_DRY_RUN` | false |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_PREFIXES` | `ATT_,QUZ_` |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_AGE_DAYS` | 10 |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_REMINDER_DAYS` | 3 |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_MAX_AGE_DAYS` | 0 (no limit) |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_HOUR` | 23 |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_CC_VP` / `_CC_HM` / `_CC_ADMIN` | true |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_MAX_STUDENTS` | 200 per assignment |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_MAX_EMAILS` | 150 per run (the rest go next run) |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_ADMIN_SUMMARY` | false (one summary to admin@ per run, only when something was sent or failed) |
| `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_LOG_DAYS` | 7 (log rows kept) |

**Scheduler (separate):**
- Handler `apsAttQuzMarkCompleteDaily`, daily at about `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_HOUR`:00 America/New_York. It is guarded by `apsRequireTriggerCall_` and the script lock.
- Install once from the editor with **`createAttQuzMarkCompleteTrigger()`** (idempotent). Also available: `removeAttQuzMarkCompleteTrigger()`, **`previewAttQuzMarkComplete()`** (no email, nothing written) and `runAttQuzMarkCompleteNow()`. All are owner-only.
- Time budget: it stops starting new classes after 4.5 min, and the rest go next run.

**Log retention:** every run ends by deleting rows older than `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_LOG_DAYS` (default **7**, never fewer than the reminder interval + 1) from both sheets, with one `deleteRows` per sheet. The detail is not needed long-term; there is no tab per run and no growth over the year.

**Performance analysis (measured on the 116-class test fixture):**
- **Dashboard pages: no impact.** There is no UI, no new browser call and no change to `getDashboardData` or start-up. Dashboard.html is byte-identical to r85.
- **Nightly job:** runs in its own trigger at ~11 PM (outside class and sync hours). When nothing is due, the run makes 0 Classroom calls and 4 sheet range reads (~2 ms in the mock). When one class is due, it makes 1 live submissions call, 10 range operations and 1 email.
- **Compared with the original script:** that one listed every course, then students, teachers and coursework for each class, one submissions list per ATT/QUZ assignment, and user profiles. That is roughly 2,000+ Classroom calls a night for ~180 classes, the same quota pressure as before. This version makes one call only for each class that actually has students to list.
- **Quota:** at most 150 emails per run (`ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_MAX_EMAILS`). Classes are grouped, so it is one email per class.
- **Conclusion:** a low-importance background job with negligible cost. It can be switched off at any time with `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_ENABLED=false` or `removeAttQuzMarkCompleteTrigger()`, without affecting anything else.

**Audit:**
- **ATTQUZ_Complete_Log** has one row per class + assignment per run: Execution_ID, key, class, assignment, reference date / type, age, To, CC, student count, students, reminder flag, Result (SENT / FAILED / DRY_RUN) and details.
- **ATTQUZ_Complete_Runs** has one row per execution: the counts, failures, deferred classes and errors.

**Data freshness:** the sync runs daily at ~5 PM and the job at 11 PM, and the live check right before each class's email catches students marked complete in between.

**Zoho design:** neutral.

**Tests:**
- New `test/markcomplete.js` (8): the 7-day log cleanup; the age boundary; prefixes and states; archived excluded; recipients and CC switches; the consolidated email, with the link and no Classroom write; the interval, the reminder and the live drop-out; retry after a failed send or a failed live check; DRY_RUN; the OFF switch; the trigger guard; the optional admin summary.
- **Full regression:** 68 suites (67 + markcomplete.js), all passed (rc=0, 0 failures). The 7-day cleanup was added after that run; `markcomplete.js` was re-run with it (8/8 passed). No other code changed.
- **Not executed:** the real Google Classroom / donotreply@ / trigger runtime (environment / authorization required).

## Round 87 (2026-10-23) — ATT_ / QUZ_ "Mark as complete" reminder: lighter, dashboard data only

Revisits Round 86, at the user's request:
1. Emails go only to the class: To the Primary Teacher, CC the class VP(s) + HM(s) + admin@.
2. Reuse the APS Dashboard's data, with no new API calls; keep the feature very light.
3. No impact on dashboard performance.

**Changes:**
- **No Google Classroom API call at all.** The live `StudentSubmissions.list` re-check before each class email (r86) is removed. The job uses only the dashboard's synced data:
  - the Grading sync (`gradesForCourses_`; ATT_ / QUZ_ submissions, daily ~5 PM + Sync now);
  - the roster dataset;
  - the course cache (Primary Teacher / VP / HM).

  All of these are cached reads.
- The email now says *"Student status is as of the APS Dashboard's last Google Classroom sync (<time>); if you already marked a student complete after that, you can ignore that student."* A student marked complete drops out after the next daily sync.
- **The optional Admin summary email is removed** (`ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_ADMIN_SUMMARY` is ignored). The only email is the one consolidated email per class.
- `ATTQUZ_Complete_Runs` keeps its column order. `Skipped_Live_Done` is now always 0.

**Unchanged:**
- ATT_ / QUZ_ assignments ≥ 10 days old (by due date, or created date when there is none).
- TURNED_IN and RETURNED students are not listed.
- One email per class, with the navigation steps (Classwork → assignment → Student work → select students → Return ▾ → Mark as complete) and the Student Work link.
- A reminder every 3 days while needed, and a failed send is retried on the next run.
- DRY_RUN, the 7-day log cleanup, and the separate daily trigger at ~11 PM ET (`createAttQuzMarkCompleteTrigger()`).

**Performance (measured on the 116-class fixture):**
- **Classroom API calls per run: 0.**
- With one class due, a run does 10 sheet range operations and sends 1 email (~12 ms in the mock). With nothing due, it does 4 range operations (~3 ms).
- **Dashboard pages: no impact.** Dashboard.html is byte-identical to r85; there are no new browser calls and no change to `getDashboardData` or start-up. The job runs in its own trigger, outside class and sync hours.

**Tests:**
- `test/markcomplete.js` (9):
  - new: "a run makes NO Google Classroom API call" (every Classroom and Directory method wrapped and counted = 0); "only the class email (no admin summary)";
  - updated: the reminder test now uses the next sync instead of the live check, and the retry test covers failed sends only.
- **Full regression:** 68 suites. 67 passed. `ui_tcc77.js` (Temporary Class Coverage) failed with the same assertion against the unchanged r86 Code.gs. It is a pre-existing, date-dependent fixture issue (it computes "next Friday" from today, and 2026-10-23 is a Friday), not caused by this change. The only code changed is the mark-complete module.
- **Not executed:** the real Google Classroom / donotreply@ / trigger runtime (environment / authorization required).

## Round 88 (2026-10-23) — ON / OFF toggle for the ATT_ / QUZ_ "Mark as complete" reminder

**Request:** a sliding on/off switch under Assignment Monitoring, "Send Weekly Reminder to Teacher" for ATT_ and QUZ_ assignments, replacing manual edits of the `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_ENABLED` Script Property.

**UI:**
- **📚 Assignment Monitoring → ⚙️ Admin Control** has a new card, **📌 ATT_ / QUZ_ — Mark as complete**. It holds a sliding switch (`role="switch"`, keyboard-focusable): **"Send weekly reminder to teachers for ATT_ and QUZ_ assignments"** with an ON / OFF badge.
- **Remind every (days)** defaults to 7, i.e. weekly.
- A status line shows whether the nightly schedule is ON or OFF and the last run (time, emails, failures).
- Switching asks for confirmation first; Cancel leaves it unchanged. It then saves at once, with no separate Save button. Changing the days also saves at once.
- The card loads with the existing `getAssignmentMonitoringAdmin` call (new field `markComplete`), so there is no extra call.

**Server:**
- `saveMarkCompleteSettings(token, {enabled, reminderDays})` is Admin / Super Admin only (`amViewer_(…, true)` plus the mutation permission).
- It sets `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_ENABLED` (and `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_REMINDER_DAYS`, 1–60), then **installs or removes the nightly trigger** (`mcEnsureTrigger_`: one trigger at most, ~11 PM America/New_York).
- Audited in AM_Audit_Log as MARK_COMPLETE_REMINDER_ON / _OFF / _DAYS.
- `mcStatus_()` returns the toggle state, the schedule and the last run (from ATTQUZ_Complete_Runs).

**Default changes:**
- The reminder is **OFF until an Admin switches it on**. Previously `ATTQUZ_COMPLETE_ENABLED` defaulted to true, but nothing ran until an editor installed the trigger.
- The interval defaults to **7 days (weekly)**, previously 3.
- The editor functions (`createAttQuzMarkCompleteTrigger`, `previewAttQuzMarkComplete`, `runAttQuzMarkCompleteNow`) still work, but are no longer needed.

**Independence:**
- The switch is independent of the Assignment Monitoring master switch and its email switches. It only controls this reminder.
- The job still makes **no Google Classroom API call** and has no effect on dashboard page performance (r87).

**Tests:**
- `markcomplete.js` (10): new test for the toggle — OFF by default, 7-day default, ON / OFF installs / removes exactly one trigger, Admin + Super Admin allowed, HM / VP / teacher / student / BOD refused, days validated, audited.
- `ui_assignmon.js` (5): new test — the switch shows OFF, Cancel keeps it OFF, Confirm turns it ON and the schedule ON, then OFF again; screenshot `r88_toggle.png`.
- **Full regression:** 68 suites; 67 passed. `ui_tcc77.js` failed the same way as in r87: a pre-existing, date-dependent fixture issue on Fridays, unrelated to this change.
- **Not executed:** the real Google Classroom / donotreply@ / trigger runtime (environment / authorization required).

## Round 89 (2026-10-23) — Classes → 👩‍🏫 Temp Teacher (Temporary Teacher Assignment – TCS/TTS) + class-card note

**Request:**
- When a Primary Teacher is unavailable, an authorized user adds another APS teacher to one Google Classroom as a Classroom **Teacher** for a period (Start Date → mandatory Removal Date).
- The teacher is removed automatically on the Removal Date. The Primary Teacher and the class setup are never changed.
- Mid-request addition: every class card shows "On-Call Teacher Assigned" with the teacher's name and APSID, in advance, so students know.

**Access:**
- Access Control row `classes.tempTeacher`, parent `classes`, cells `AYYYLLL`. The catalog now has 39 rows.
- Admin, Super Admin and HM can act on every active AY class.
- Teacher accounts (including class VP / HM) can act on the classes they teach or support (`userHasCourseAccess_`).
- Students, BOD and Authorized users are refused on every endpoint.
- Every endpoint re-checks the session role, the Access Control row, the class scope and the mutation permission on the server. `ctx.tempTeacherAccess` / `ttmCanUse_` only show or hide the sub-tab.

**Endpoints:**
- `getTempTeacherData`.
- `createTempTeacherAssignment(token, {courseId, teacherEmail, startDate, removalDate, reason, requestId})`.
- `removeTempTeacherNow(token, {assignmentId, confirmed:true})`.
- `cancelTempTeacherAssignment(token, {assignmentId})`.
- Scheduler: `processTemporaryTeacherAssignments` (trigger-only, `apsRequireTriggerCall_`).
- Editor-only: `createTempTeacherTrigger`.

**Validation (server):**
- **Classroom:** must be in the user's scope and `Courses.get` must return ACTIVE.
- **Teacher:** must be a known APS teacher, must not be the Primary Teacher, and must not already be a teacher of the class (checked in the cache, then live with `Teachers.get`). The account is verified (Admin Directory, then Classroom profile); suspended or not-found accounts are refused.
- **Dates:** valid yyyy-MM-dd; the start may not be in the past; the removal date is required and not before the start.
- **Reason:** 5–200 words, with the exact messages.
- **Overlap:** an open assignment (Scheduled / Active / Failed) for the same classroom with overlapping dates is refused, and the message names the existing assignment.
- **Double submit:** the request ID becomes the Assignment ID (`TT-<requestId>`), so a resubmission returns the existing record.
- Everything after the dates runs under the script lock.

**Classroom API:**
- Uses the same service and account as the rest of the dashboard.
- Add: `Courses.Teachers.create({userId})` (TEACHER, never a student), then verified with `Teachers.get`.
- Remove: `Courses.Teachers.remove` (NOT_FOUND counts as removed), then verified.
- An ALREADY_EXISTS on add marks the assignment `FAILED / ALREADY_MEMBER`; that teacher is **never** removed automatically.
- A removal is refused if the teacher has since become the class's Primary Teacher (Course Description).

**Scheduler:**
- Runs hourly, installed when an assignment is created and removed when nothing is open.
- Each run:
  - adds on the Start Date;
  - retries failed adds until the Removal Date;
  - removes from `TEMP_TEACHER_REMOVAL_HOUR` (Script Property, default 23 = 11 PM America/New_York) on the Removal Date, so the teacher covers the whole last day;
  - retries failed removals;
  - closes never-added assignments past the Removal Date as Cancelled (`EXPIRED_NOT_ADDED`).
- Idempotent: every step is decided from the stored status under the lock, and email flags prevent repeat emails.
- Display status `REMOVAL_DUE` = Active and the removal time reached.

**Emails (From donotreply@, `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')`):**
- **Added** and **Removed:** To the temp teacher; CC the Primary Teacher, HM(s), VP(s) and admin@.
- **ACTION REQUIRED – Temp Teacher Removal Failed** (or Add Failed): To admin@; CC HM, VP and the Primary Teacher. Sent once per failure (`Failure_Email_Sent`).

**Storage (main workbook):**
- `TEMP_TEACHER_ASSIGNMENTS`: 31 columns. The sheet is widened before the header is written (a new sheet has 26 columns). Request fields are written once; the status fields are updated in place; no row is ever deleted.
- `TEMP_TEACHER_AUDIT`: one row per event: TEMP_TEACHER_ASSIGNMENT_CREATED / _ADDED / _ADD_FAILED / _REMOVAL_STARTED / _REMOVED / _REMOVAL_FAILED / _CANCELLED / _EMAIL_SENT / _EMAIL_FAILED.
- Structured `console.log('[TempTeacher] {...}')` lines carry no credentials, and Classroom errors pass through `srmSafeErr_`.

**Class-card note:**
- `getDashboardData` → `ttmStampCards_` adds `course.tempTeacherNote = [{name, apsId, start, removal, now}]` for Scheduled / Active / Failed-removal assignments that have not ended.
- One cached read (`ttm_cards_v1`, 5 min), cleared on every write. With no sheet the cost is one cache hit.
- Card: `ttmCardNote_` shows "👩‍🏫 On-Call Teacher Assigned: Name (APSID) · start – removal", or "(upcoming)" before the start. Every role sees it, including students. No email and no reason are shown.

**UI:**
- Classes sub-tab **👩‍🏫 Temp Teacher** (`#subTabTempTeacher`, view `tempTeacher`, `#ttmView`).
- Summary cards (Active Temp Teachers / Scheduled / Removal Due / Failed) that also act as filters.
- Filters: Status, Date (covers), Teacher, Classroom; search "Search classroom / teacher". Filtering and search are local.
- The **+ Assign Temp Teacher** form includes classroom and teacher search with info panels and a live word counter.
- Table with View Details (modal), Remove Temp Teacher Now (confirmation) and Cancel Assignment.

**Zoho design:** neutral — no Zoho fields or sync are involved.

**Tests:**
- `tempteacher.js` (23 server tests; fixture `ttfixture.js` on top of `coveragefixture.js`). It covers:
  - the roles and the class scope;
  - every validation message;
  - already-teacher (cache, Primary Teacher, live), overlap, and double submit;
  - Scheduled → added on the Start Date;
  - removal at 11 PM ET on the Removal Date;
  - idempotent repeated runs;
  - removal failure with a single ACTION REQUIRED email and a successful retry;
  - Remove Now and Cancel;
  - add failure and the ALREADY_MEMBER rule (never removed);
  - Primary Teacher protection;
  - the audit events, with no credentials;
  - the card note (student view, name + APSID only, upcoming, cache cleared on change);
  - the Access Control switch-off;
  - trigger-only scheduler;
  - expiry of a never-added assignment.
- `ui_tempteacher.js` (4 browser tests). Screenshots: `r89_tt_form.png`, `r89_tt_list.png`, `r89_tt_detail.png`, `r89_card_student.png`, `r89_tt_phone.png`.
- Access Control row counts updated to 39 in `accesscontrol.js`, `special.js` and `ui_access.js`.
- `coverage.js` / `ui_coverage.js` follow the user's new "📢🔀 Class Merge Notice 🔀📢" announcement title.
- **Full regression:** 70 suites; 69 passed. `ui_tcc77.js` failed in the same way as in r87 / r88: a pre-existing fixture issue that depends on the date and fails on Fridays ("next Friday" is computed from today), unrelated to this change.
- **Not executed:** the real Google Classroom add / remove, donotreply@ delivery and the hourly trigger (they need the live environment / authorization).

## Round 93 (2026-10-23) — GCM - Preview: "All Days" → dynamic "All Class Timing"

**Request:** rename the GCM - Preview "All Days" filter to **All Class Timing**, with options built dynamically from the classes' actual Day + Start + End time:

- `#gcmDay` (same id) starts with only `All Class Timing`.

## Round 94 (2026-10-25) — 📨 Apply Leave (every role) + student attendance Excused (70%)

**Request:** a new **Apply Leave** tab for every role.
- **Form:** Start (default today), End (default the start, not earlier), mandatory Reason, then Apply Leave and a confirmation.
- **Duplicates:** overlapping and double submissions are prevented.
- **Approval:** no approval workflow exists in APS, so a submitted leave is treated as **Approved**.
- **Student leave:** attendance becomes **Excused = 70%** with a comment, and the teacher, HM and VP are emailed.
- **Teacher leave:** the HM and VP are emailed, plus a confirmation with class-coverage instructions.
- **Email sender:** all emails from donotreply@.
- **History:** each user sees their own history; Admin sees all.
- **Audit and failures:** audit log; email failures never lose a leave; no duplicate emails; no extra Google Classroom calls.

**Existing code reused (no new email, role, Access Control or Classroom function):**
- **Access and identity:** `apsRequireTabForToken_` with the new Access Control row `applyLeave` (`AYYYYYY`, 40 rows now). Identity comes from the session only.
- **Course cache:** `readAllCoursesFromCache_`, `courseHasStudentEmail_`, `userHasCourseAccess_`, `tkClassChain_` (Course Description / Room mapping → Primary Teacher, HM, VP), `srmClassTeacher_`, `adsSchedule_`, `findDisplayName_`, `getAPSIdFromEmail`.
- **Email:** `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')` (donotreply@), `apsEmailShell_`, `attMailAdminCc_`, `ttmList_`.
- **Attendance:** the existing override model.
  - `ATTENDANCE_OVERRIDE_SCORES_.EXCUSED = 70` was already defined and is unchanged; no other status changed.
  - Override Status / By / At / Reason columns, `attEffectiveScore_`, `attApplyOverrideToSummary_`, `appendAttendanceAuditLogEntries_`, `attReadSheetRecords_`, `attWeekSheetNameForDate_`.
- **Other helpers:** `amAppend_` / `amCell_` (audit sheet, formula-safe cells), `rosterTs_`, `ttmToday_` / `ttmFmtDate_` / `ttmFmtTs_` (APS_TZ dates), `srmSafeErr_`.

**New server functions (Code.gs, module `lv*`):**
- Endpoints: `getApplyLeaveData(token)`, `submitLeaveRequest(token, {startDate, endDate, reason, requestId})`, `retryLeaveNotification(token, {leaveId})` (Admin / Super Admin).
- Storage helpers: `lvRows_`, `lvWrite_`, `lvSheet_`, `lvAudit_`.
- Recipients: `lvClasses_`, `lvRecipients_`.
- Notification: `lvNotify_`.
- Attendance: `lvStudentLeaveIndex_`, `lvApplyToNewRecord_`, `lvApplyToCapturedAttendance_`.

**Storage (main workbook):**
- `APS_LEAVE_REQUESTS`: Leave_ID, Request_ID, APSID, User_Email, User_Name, Role, Leave_Start_Date, Leave_End_Date, Reason, Submitted_DateTime, Submitted_By, Affected_Classes, Zoho_Student_ID (blank — reserved per §21.5), Status, Notification_Status, Notification_Detail, Attendance_Override_Status, Comments, Updated_At, Updated_By.
  - Request fields are written once; the mutable columns run from Status onward. Plain text; no row is ever deleted.
  - Status values: APPLIED / APPROVED / REJECTED / CANCELLED. Only APPROVED is used today (auto).
  - Notification values: PENDING / SENT / PARTIAL / FAILED. Notification_Detail holds `NOTICE=SENT; CONFIRM=FAILED <error>` flags, so a retry never re-sends a part already sent.
- `APS_LEAVE_AUDIT`: Timestamp, Leave_ID, Event (LEAVE_SUBMITTED, ATTENDANCE_OVERRIDE, EMAIL_SENT, EMAIL_FAILED), actor, user, dates, result, details. Structured `[Leave]` console log lines are written too.

**Validation (server):**
- Dates must be valid yyyy-MM-dd and the end cannot be before the start (exact messages from the request). Today is computed in America/New_York.
- The start can be at most `APS_LEAVE_MAX_PAST_DAYS` in the past (Script Property, default 14). A leave can cover at most `APS_LEAVE_MAX_DAYS` days (default 90).
- The reason is trimmed, required and at most 1000 characters.
- Under the script lock:
  - **Idempotency:** the same Request_ID for the same user returns the first result (double click / retry → one leave, one email).
  - **Overlap:** an APPLIED / APPROVED leave of the same user is refused with "A leave request already exists for this date range."
- The person, role, APSID and name always come from the session and course cache; client-sent fields are ignored.

**Attendance override (students only; staff leave never changes attendance):**
- **At submission:** rows of that student already captured inside the leave (week sheets up to today) get
  - Override `EXCUSED`;
  - By `APS Leave LV-…`;
  - Reason `Excused – Student leave: <reason> from MM/DD/YYYY to MM/DD/YYYY (LV-…)`;
  - Score 70.
  
  This is the same column write, summary adjustment and attendance audit (action `LEAVE_EXCUSED`) as `editAttendanceRecordStatus`, under the script lock.
- **At capture:** `syncAttendanceForAllCourses_` builds a leave index once per run (one sheet read) and `lvApplyToNewRecord_` marks each new STUDENT record inside an approved leave. The existing upsert keeps any override already on the row, so a manual correction (or an earlier leave) always wins and later syncs keep the Excused value. Rows outside the dates, other students and other classes are untouched.
- `Attendance_Override_Status` values: `APPLIED n` · `MANUAL_KEPT n` · `AUTO_AT_CAPTURE` · `NO_CLASS_DATES` · `NOT_APPLICABLE` (staff) · `FAILED — …`.

**Emails (From donotreply@; one consolidated email per leave; recipients from the course cache, nothing hard-coded):**
- **Student:**
  - To the class Primary Teacher(s); CC HM(s), VP(s), the student's APS email and admin@.
  - Subject `APS Leave Notification – <Student> – <start> to <end>`.
  - Body from the APS template: dates, reason, class, Excused – 70%, teacher action, parents' paragraph.
  - Parent emails are not in the dashboard (Zoho-owned per §21), so only the student is copied.
- **Staff (teacher, VP / HM teacher account, HM, Admin, BOD, Authorized):**
  - Notice to the HM(s) of the affected classes, with the VP(s) and admin@ in CC; admin@ is the To when no HM is named.
  - Affected classes: for a teacher, the classes they teach or support; for other roles, only classes whose Description / Room names them.
  - The notice lists every affected class with its day and time, and the Parent Teacher / weekly availability / HM coordination steps.
  - A separate confirmation goes to the applicant: `APS Leave Request Submitted – <start> to <end>`.
- **Failures:** a failure never fails the submission. The status is set to PARTIAL / FAILED, the user sees the requested message, the EMAIL_FAILED audit entry is written, and Admin can **Resend email**, which sends only the failed parts.

**Client (Dashboard.html):**
- Main tab `#tabApplyLeave` (📨) and view `#lvView`.
- Form, My Leave History, and an Admin "All Leave Requests" card with search and role / notification filters (local, no server call) and Resend email.
- Wired into `switchView`, `acRedirectView_`, `AC_EL_KEYS_`, `AC_VIEW_KEYS_`, tab visibility (`lvOk_`) and the role-aware ⓘ Help (`lvView`).

**API / quota:**
- No new Google Classroom, Directory or Reports call: recipients and classes come from the course cache.
- Per leave: one sheet read and write of the leave sheet; for a student, the touched attendance week sheets (only dates up to today); 1–2 Gmail sends.
- One extra leave-sheet read per attendance sync run.

**Zoho design:** moves toward it. Student identity is keyed by APS email / APSID, the Zoho_Student_ID column is reserved, statuses are picklist-style, and no parent data is created.

**Known limitations:**
- No approval / cancel workflow; a mistaken leave can be corrected by Admin with the existing attendance override.
- The parent is not emailed directly (no parent emails in the dashboard yet).

**Tests:**
- `leave.js` (12):
  - Excused on a captured date, with comment and audit;
  - a manual correction is kept;
  - a future leave is Excused at capture and kept by the next sync;
  - teacher leave does not change attendance;
  - validation (exact messages, past and span limits, overlap, idempotency, session identity);
  - history and Admin visibility;
  - Access Control;
  - student, teacher, VP, no-HM and HM-role emails (recipients, sender, wording);
  - an email failure is recorded and Resend sends only the failed part;
  - no Classroom call.
- `ui_leave.js` (4): the student form (defaults, required reason, end follows start, success, history), the teacher reminder and overlap message, the Admin table, filters and Resend, the phone layout and the Access Control switch-off.
- Screenshots: `r94_leave_*.png`.
- `accesscontrol.js`, `special.js` and `ui_access.js` now expect 40 Access Control rows.
- **Full regression:** 73 suites (71 + `leave.js` + `ui_leave.js`); all 73 passed.

## Round 95 (2026-10-25) — Exam Question Paper: "Display Past Exams" also drives the statistics

**Request:** the r92 switch (default OFF) must apply to every Overall statistic on Examination → Exam Question Paper, for every role.
- **OFF:** only today's and upcoming exams (Exam Date ≥ today, APS time zone).
- **ON:** the full history.
- **No reload:** switching recalculates instantly, with no duplicate API call.

**Server (`getExamQuestionPaperMonitoring`), no new endpoint or read:**
- In the same pass over the same records, students and events, a second tile object `tilesCurrent` is built from records with `Class_Date >= today` (America/New_York). A record without a valid date counts as current.
- **Current-only counts:**
  - Total Exams / Classes / Students use their own sets.
  - Published / Pending, Eligible, Downloaded and Repeated are counted only for current papers.
  - Failed Downloads and Unauthorized Attempts count only events of current papers.
  - Not Downloaded and Download Rate are derived in the same way as for `tiles`.
- The response adds `tilesCurrent` and `pastPaperIds` (the past papers in the viewer's scope). `tiles` (full history) is unchanged.

**Client:**
- `renderExamQpMonitoring_` shows `tilesCurrent` while the switch is OFF and `tiles` when ON.
- Download Activity and Suspicious Activity hide rows of `pastPaperIds` while OFF (`examQpShowQp_`). The Audit Log is unchanged.
- The switch still resets to OFF on every page load, and re-renders from the loaded data (no server call).

**Zoho design:** neutral.

**Tests:**
- `qp.js` (32): a new r95 test.
  - On the exam day at 11:50 PM `tilesCurrent` equals `tiles`, so today is never past.
  - Two days later `tilesCurrent` matches the current papers exactly (exams, classes, published, eligible, downloaded, not downloaded), the full `tiles` are unchanged, and `pastPaperIds` lists the past papers.
  - Teachers get the same pair.

## Round 96 (2026-10-26) — Fix: "800+ simultaneous executions" warning (Apps Script limit 1,000)

**Problem:** Google warned that the LIVE project (web app executed as the deploying account, so every user's requests count against one project) reached 800+ simultaneous executions, close to the limit of 1,000. Simultaneous executions ≈ requests per second × how long each request runs.

**Measured before the fix** (fake-clock browser harness, one open tab, one hour, no class live):

| Role | Calls per hour | Breakdown |
|---|---|---|
| Student | 171 | getRealtimeStatusSnapshot 66, getChatMessages 60 (closed chat, every 60 s), getDashboardData 12, plus 4 × 11 extras on every 5-minute refresh (getWeeklyPanelData, getStartupBundle, getStudentLoginNoticeStatus) |
| Teacher | 165 | similar |
| Admin | 138 | similar |

All polls ran on fixed intervals, so tabs opened together at class start stayed in lock-step.

**Slow paths that made each request longer:**
- `getChatMessages` opened the workbook and read the chat sheet on every poll.
- `recordHeartbeat_` (every `getDashboardData`) waited up to 2 s for the **shared script lock**, then wrote two large Script Properties. Under load, requests queued behind each other (and behind the attendance and other locks), which raised concurrency further.
- When the 30-s class-card live-status map expired, every concurrent request rebuilt it at once (a course-list read plus the live Meet check).

**Fix (no feature or UI change):**
1. **Chat** — `getChatMessages` is served from CacheService (`aps_chat_msgs_v1`, 10 min; ≤ 95 KB, otherwise it reads the sheet).
   - `postChatMessage` and a pruning deletion call `chatChanged_()`, which clears the cache and bumps `aps_chat_ver_v1`.
   - `getRealtimeStatusSnapshot` returns `chatVersion`. The browser reloads the chat only when it changes.
   - The closed chat is no longer polled; the 15-s poll runs only while the chat is open and visible.
   - Timestamps are returned as ISO strings; the client already did `new Date(timestamp)`.
2. **Adaptive, jittered polling** — `getRealtimeStatusSnapshot` returns `pollMs`: 45,000 while any class is in its live window, otherwise `APS_IDLE_POLL_MS_` = 90,000.
   - The client replaced its fixed `setInterval`s with `setTimeout` chains jittered ±15 % (`apsJitter_`), for the realtime poll and the 5-minute quiet refresh.
   - Hidden tabs still make no calls, and a tab coming back into view polls once.
3. **5-minute refresh** — weekly panel, startup bundle (sync info) and the student login notices now run on every 3rd refresh (~15 min). Availability changes still arrive through the realtime map.
4. **Heartbeat** — `recordHeartbeat_` writes at most once per person per `APS_HEARTBEAT_MIN_SECONDS_` (60 s, CacheService key `aps_hb_<email>`).
   - It waits at most `APS_HEARTBEAT_LOCK_MS_` (300 ms) for the script lock. If the lock is busy it **skips** the best-effort write; it previously wrote without the lock, risking lost updates, and the next refresh records it.
   - The presence "online" window (3 min) and the Last Login semantics are unchanged.
5. **Live-status map** — single-flight rebuild of `aps_cls_live_box_v1`. A 20-s build marker (`_b`) and a 10-min stale copy (`_s`) mean that while one request rebuilds, the others reuse the last map instead of rebuilding in parallel.

**Measured after:**

| Role | Calls per hour | Breakdown |
|---|---|---|
| Student | 55–60 | realtime ~36, getDashboardData 12, 3–4 each of the extras |
| Teacher | 57 | — |
| Admin | 59 | — |

- That is about **−65 %** when no class is live.
- While a class is live: about 80 realtime + 24 ≈ 105 per hour (about −40 %).
- Chat calls drop to one per posted message.
- The work per request is lower too: no chat sheet open, no 2-s lock wait, no rebuild stampede.

**Unchanged:**
- No new endpoint or Google API call; permissions unchanged.
- No trigger change. Triggers are a handful of executions and were not the cause.

**Zoho design:** neutral.

**Tests:**
- `concurrency.js` (4): the chat cache hit makes no sheet read, a post clears it and bumps the version, and the list shape is unchanged; the snapshot's `chatVersion` and `pollMs` (90 s idle / 45 s live); the heartbeat writes once a minute and skips on a busy lock without waiting; the live-map single-flight serves the stale copy while another request builds.
- `ui_concurrency.js` (2), fake clock:
  - a student tab makes ≤ 75 calls per hour with no chat polling, the 5-minute refresh is kept, and a posted message is loaded exactly once within 2 min with no further chat calls;
  - a live class gives the 45-s cadence (11–16 polls in 10 min), and a hidden tab makes 0 calls.

**Operational advice:**
- Watch Apps Script → Executions (concurrency) at the next class start.
- The constants above (`APS_IDLE_POLL_MS_`, `APS_HEARTBEAT_MIN_SECONDS_`, `APS_HEARTBEAT_LOCK_MS_`) can be raised if needed.
- **Not executed — environment/authorization required:** the real Apps Script concurrency under live load. The numbers above come from the harness.
- **Full regression:** 75 suites (73 + `concurrency.js` + `ui_concurrency.js`); 74 passed on the first run. `ui_concurrency.js` had a timing flake in the test itself: the fake clock ran ahead of an async reply. The test now lets each reply land, and it then passed 5 of 5 runs.

## Round 100 (2026-10-29) — Review of r89–r99 (no regressions) + fixes + performance

**Request:**
- "make sure this newly added feature is not breaking any of the existing feature and improve the need places"
- "improve the APS Dashboard performance UI and Backend performance"

**Method:**
- Three independent reviews (Temp Teacher; Apply Leave / Access Control / concurrency; Exam QP + GCM). Each finding was reproduced in a scratch copy.
- Every fix has a test that fails on the r99 code and passes now (verified by running the new tests against r99).
- Performance was measured with `test/perf_measure.js` (admin / teacher / student): startup has no duplicate calls and no Classroom API calls.

**Fixes (Code.gs unless noted):**
- **Exam QP auto email (r99):**
  - `examQpAutoRun_` treats a `DOWNLOAD_COMPLETED` event as downloaded. The summary row is skipped when the script lock is busy; monitoring already counted from the events. *Before: a student who downloaded at the exam-start rush could also be emailed.*
  - `examQpAutoState_(qpSet, true)` rethrows; a failed log read stops the run. *Before: an unreadable log meant "never sent", so the student was emailed again.*
  - The per-student cache claim now lasts until the paper window ends (+1 h, max 6 h), not 15 min.
  - New reason `MEET_STATUS_UNKNOWN` ("Meet Status Unknown – Email Not Sent"): no Meet data for the class at the exam time. It counts as "Not Sent", not "Not Online". `setExamQuestionPaperAutoEmail` returns `customTimePapers` and a warning.
  - New class papers of an existing `Exam_ID` inherit `Auto_Email_Enabled` / `Auto_Email_Minutes`.
  - Client: the exam selector follows Display Past Exams, shows "Mixed", and is disabled while saving; a save result is applied only to the exam it was for.
  - Monitoring skips the auto-log read when no paper in scope ever used the setting.
- **Temp Teacher:**
  - `ttmViewer_` (teacher role): a class where the viewer is the temp teacher of an OPEN assignment is not manageable, unless the viewer is that class's Primary Teacher or VP / HM.
  - Typed email is per class: `v.all || classSupportElevated_`. Classes carry `anyEmail`, used by the client.
  - `ttmActivate_`: one direct `Teachers.create`. On a transient error it checks `Teachers.get`, then retries; ALREADY_EXISTS after its own retry counts as added. *Before: such a teacher was never removed.*
  - `ttmRemove_`: courses are parsed once (was twice). REMOVAL_STARTED is audited on the first attempt or a manual one only. `SKIPPED_PRIMARY` is its own Last_Process_Status.
  - New `ttmRemovalParked_` + `TTM_MAX_AUTO_REMOVE_ATTEMPTS_` (24): parked records are not retried or counted as open; Remove Now still works.
  - Trigger install / remove happens inside the script lock.
  - Client: a class or teacher hidden by the search is cleared before submit.
- **Apply Leave:**
  - `retryLeaveNotification` uses a cache claim taken under the lock (`lv_resend_<id>`), so two Resends never email twice. The send moved to `lvResend_`.
  - `lvPublic_.canResend` allows Resend for PENDING older than 10 min (client uses it).
  - Performance: `attApplyOverrideToSummary_(before, after, memo)` reads the Attendance Summary once per leave (was once per excused row, under the script lock).
- **Chat (r96):** `getChatMessages` caches only if the chat version did not change during its read (fixes a hidden-message race), and the cache size check is now in bytes.

**Performance (UI + backend):**
- Apply Leave tab: re-opening within 60 s reuses the loaded data (was a server call every time).
- Temp Teacher: one TEMP_TEACHER_ASSIGNMENTS read per request (`v.rows` reused).
- Leave summary memo; Exam QP monitoring skips the unused log read.
- Hourly Temp Teacher job: parked records add no rows or calls.

**Known / not changed:**
- Switching off the **Classes** or **Student Onboarding** tab for a role in Access Control hides it in the browser, but `getDashboardData` still returns the class list (other tabs depend on it). This is noted for the user to decide.
- A student can back-date a leave up to 14 days (`APS_LEAVE_MAX_PAST_DAYS`) with no approval, as designed in r94.

- `tempteacher.js` 26 (new test 26).
- `leave.js` 13 (new E6).

## Round 101 (2026-10-30) — Weekly Class Consolidation Analysis AY26-27 (read-only report email)

**What:** every Wednesday, two steps:
- ~7:00 PM America/New_York: analysis.
- ~7:30 PM: one HTML email from **donotreply@** (mail profile `TICKETS`, the existing `apsGmailSend_`, no new sender).

**Data and recipients:**
- The analysis runs in memory from the synced course cache (`readAllCoursesFromCache_`). It makes **no Classroom / Admin SDK / Drive calls** and **writes nothing to Classroom**.
- Recipients are:
  - HM/VP from `classSupport` (`tkClassChain_`);
  - `HEADMASTER_EMAILS`;
  - the fixed list (Script Property `CLASS_CONSOLIDATION_FIXED_RECIPIENTS`; default admin@, Vasuki_APS999@, tcs_asvika_aps8112@).
  - Addresses are de-duplicated and lower-cased.

**Rules (`ccwBuild_`):**
- **Classes included:** active, `AY26-27`, and the day/time can be parsed (`examQpParseClassName_`). Test and on-call classrooms are excluded (`CLASS_CONSOLIDATION_EXCLUDE_REGEX`, default `^NILAI\s*99\b|ON\s*CALL`) and listed as "Not analysed".
- **Slot:** same Nilai + day + start + end. `ccwBestPartition_` makes non-overlapping groups of 2–3 classes with ≤8 combined. It prefers, in order: the most classes removed, then the most exact-7 groups, then the fewest 8s. Each class appears at most once; >8 and different Nilai are never merged.
- **Priority:** ≤7 = HIGH ("MERGE RECOMMENDED"); 8 = MEDIUM (review).
- **Review instead of a merge:**
  - the same teacher on both classes → "REVIEW … HM/VP review required";
  - a missing primary teacher → REVIEW REQUIRED, plus a data note.
- **Continuing teacher (`ccwMergeRecord_`):** fewest classes first, then the larger class (fewer students move). The teacher must have no other overlapping class (`ccwOverlap_`); otherwise "HM/VP review required".
- **Low / explore:** a class with ≤4 students and a same-Nilai class at another time, combined ≤7. Each pair is listed once.
- **Bands:** 1–3 Critical, 4–5 Review, 6 Near Target, 7 Target, 8 Maximum.
- **Teachers:** multi-class teachers are flagged when two classes overlap in time.
- **Impact:** "Potential" classes / assignments reduced, and teachers with no remaining class.

**Storage and idempotency:**
- Sheet `CLASS_CONSOLIDATION_WEEKLY` holds one row per `Report_ID = CCW-<AY>-<yyyy-MM-dd>` (APS_TZ). The result JSON is stored in `Payload_1..4` (45 KB chunks), together with the counts, status, email status, recipients and a masked error.
- **Analysis (`ccwRunAnalysis_`):** runs under the script lock. On a build exception or zero classes it sets Status FAILED (no report). It is refused once that Report_ID was SENT.
- **Email (`ccwRunEmail_`):**
  - No row → runs the analysis once ("analysis missing at email time").
  - FAILED → retries the analysis once ("retry at email time"); if it still fails, sends one notice to admin@ only (`FAILURE_NOTICE_SENT`) and **never a partial report**.
  - SENT → skipped, so there are no duplicates.
  - A send failure keeps the stored result (Email_Status FAILED). A later `runClassConsolidationNow()` resends it **without re-analysing**.
  - Tokens are masked in the stored error.
- Subject: `APS Class Consolidation Analysis – AY26-27 - MM/dd/yyyy` (no time). The body follows the requested structure (Vanakkam … APS Tech Support Team / Avvaiyar Padasalai) with HTML tables in `apsEmailShell_`. It contains no raw JSON or debug text.

**Entry points:**
- **Trigger handlers:** `apsClassConsolidationAnalysis(e)` and `apsClassConsolidationEmail(e)`. Both are guarded by `apsRequireTriggerCall_`, so a browser call or another handler's trigger is refused.
- **Editor / owner only** (`apsRequireOwnerOrTrigger_`):
  - `createClassConsolidationTriggers()`: Wednesday `atHour(19).nearMinute(0)` and `nearMinute(30)` `.inTimezone(APS_TZ)`. It removes older copies first, so there are no duplicates and no hard-coded UTC offset.
  - `removeClassConsolidationTriggers()`, `previewClassConsolidationAnalysis()`, `runClassConsolidationNow()`.
- No dashboard UI and no `google.script.run` data function. Dashboard.html is unchanged.

**Setup:** run `createClassConsolidationTriggers()` once from the Apps Script editor. Apps Script's `nearMinute` fires within about ±15 minutes.

**Zoho design:** neutral. It is a read-only report keyed by Course ID and teacher email, and the same logic would apply to a Zoho-synced roster cache.

**Tests:** `test/classconsol.js` has 20 tests:
- partitioning, priorities, never mixing Nilai, same-teacher / missing-teacher review, the continuing teacher with a conflict;
- multi-class teachers with the same-time flag, bands / explore / impact, recipients;
- storage, the exact subject and the TICKETS sender, the HTML sections;

## Round 103 (2026-10-30) — Production fix: "You have exceeded the property storage quota"

**Incident (10/30/2026, ~7 PM EDT):**
- About 500 students and 100 teachers signed in, and Script Properties reached the **500 KB per-store** limit (513 KB).
- `getDashboardData` writes presence and last-login on every load, so every load failed.
- **Largest keys:**
  - `lastLoginMap` 105 KB
  - `apsUserCountryMap_v1` 79 KB
  - `onboardedStudents` 69 KB
  - `teacherAvailabilityRealtimeMap` 67 KB (never pruned; 374 entries across past weeks)
  - `presenceMap` 44 KB
  - 310 `GOOGLE_REVIEW_PROMPT_<email>` keys
- **Emergency fix (no deploy):** the editor script `Claude outputs/APS_PropertyQuota_Fix.gs` (`apsPropFreeSpace`) took the store from 513 KB to 369 KB. It removed only rebuildable data.

**Permanent fix (Code.gs only; Dashboard.html unchanged):**
- **Second store.** Helpers `apsBigStore_` / `apsBigGet_` / `apsBigSet_` / `apsBigJson_` / `apsBigSetSafe_` keep `presenceMap`, `lastLoginMap`, `apsUserCountryMap_v1`, `onboardedStudents` and `GOOGLE_REVIEW_PROMPT_*` in `PropertiesService.getUserProperties()`, which has its own 500 KB quota.
  - Under `executeAs: USER_DEPLOYING`, the web app, triggers and the editor all use the deploying account's store (see the r52 note in `getStudentLoginNoticeStatus`).
  - Reads fall back to the Script Property until the first write. The first write puts the merged value in the second store and deletes the Script Property copy, so no migration step is needed and nothing is lost.
  - **Operational rule:** always deploy from the same owner account.
- **Never fatal.** Display-only writes (online dot, last login, onboarded, detected country, Google Review prompt, availability live overlay) go through `apsBigSetSafe_` or try/catch: a full store logs `[Storage] … not saved` instead of failing the request. The user's own Default Country choice still reports an error to that user.
- **Availability overlay.** `apsAvailRealtimePrune_` drops weeks before the current `WK-` id on every write (`updateTeacherAvailabilityRealtimeCache_`, `setTeacherAvailabilityStatus`). The answers themselves stay in the sheet.
- **Daily check.** `apsPropHealth_(allowEmail)` runs from `apsDailyForceSync` before the enabled check, so it runs even with the daily sync off:
  - moves leftover big keys and review keys into the second store;
  - above 70% of Script Properties: removes diagnostics (`meetPresenceDiagnostic`, `classMeetLiveDiagnostic`, `attendanceSyncDiagnostic_v1`) and the unused `attendanceFinalizedThrough_v1/_v2`, and prunes the overlay;
  - at 80% or more of either store: emails admin@ once a day (`attMailSend_`, from attendance@; key `APS_STORAGE_ALERT_DAY`). The email contains sizes only, never values.
- **Report.** `apsStorageReport()` (editor or owner only) shows both stores and their 25 largest keys, with emails masked.
- **Bug fixed.** `recordViewerCountry` replaced the person's whole entry on every auto-detect, which erased `defaultCountry*`. It now merges.

**Zoho design:** neutral. Parent and contact data still have no second source of truth; these are display caches keyed by APS email.

**Tests:**
- New `test/storage.js` (9 tests): migration with no data loss; the onboarded map moved; country default kept; **both stores full → `getDashboardData` / `getWeeklyPanelData` / `getRealtimeStatusSnapshot` / `getStudentLoginNoticeStatus` work for admin, HM, teacher, VP, student and BOD**; availability save with a full overlay; old-week pruning; review prompt; daily health (move, trim, one alert per day, settings never removed); trigger hook and editor-only report.
- On r102 code, 8 of the 9 fail, including the full-store test, which reproduces the exact production error.
- `gasmock` now has a real User Properties store plus `getKeys` / `getProperties`. `concurrency.js` and `maintenance.js` read presence from the second store.

**Full regression:** 79 suites. 77 passed, including `storage` 9/9, `concurrency`, `maintenance`, `addstudent` and `ui_addstudent`. The two Add Student tests set the monthly Google Review flag in the old store and were updated to set it in the second store, which correctly takes priority. `ui_concurrency` and `ui_tcc77` fail with the same assertion as on the pre-r101 code (date-dependent fixtures; see Round 101). Live Apps Script (real User Properties, real quota): not executed — environment/authorization required.

**r103 update (2026-10-30, before deploy):**
- **Report masking.** `apsStorageReport` masked only part of an email that contains "_" (seen live: `GOOGLE_REVIEW_PROMPT_vihaan_<email>`). New `apsPropKeyLabel_` hides the whole address for the per-person prefixes and generally. `storage.js` test 9 checks it; `storage` 9/9, `concurrency`, `maintenance` and `addstudent` were rerun and pass. The full regression was not rerun (log-label change only).
- **Live observation, 8:21 PM.** Running `apsStorageReport` from the editor moved `presenceMap`, `lastLoginMap`, `apsUserCountryMap_v1` and `onboardedStudents` into the second store: Script Properties 137 KB (27%), second store 275 KB (55%). Two seconds later `onboardedStudents` (14 KB) reappeared in Script Properties, written by the still-deployed old web-app version. Until the live deployment is updated to r103, the old version reads empty lists (last login, onboarding and flags look reset); the data itself is safe in the second store.

**Code.gs:**

  - `examQpTeacherCopyTeachers_(course, courses)`: primary teacher (`srmClassTeacher_`) plus `course.teachers`, minus `isRosterHiddenStaffEmail_`; from the synced course, no API call.

- **Modified (each keeps its old behaviour except the Teacher Copy part):**
  - `downloadExamQuestionPaperTeacherCopy`: new access and block checks, `TEACHER_COPY_DENIED` audit, new failure message.
  - `fetchExamQuestionPaperDownload`: TEACHER tickets use `examQpTeacherCopyCanFetch_`.
  - `getExamQuestionPaperMonitoring`: new per-paper `tcopyShow` / `tcopyCanUse` / `tcopyBlockReason`. `staffCanUse` / `staffBlockReason` are unchanged and still drive Send to Student.
  - `EXAM_QP_EVENTS`: + `TEACHER_COPY_DENIED`, `TEACHER_COPY_EMAIL_SENT` / `_FAILED` / `_SKIPPED`.

**Email logic:**
- **Which papers:** each 5-minute run picks papers that are PUBLISHED, have a PDF, are unlocked, belong to AY26-27, were published at least 24 h before the start, and are inside the window start − 60 min ≤ now < start.
- **Sending:** each assigned teacher with an @avvaiyarpadasalai.org address gets one email: `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')`, from donotreply@, To = the teacher only, Reply-To admin@.
- **Idempotency:** emails already in `Teacher_Copy_Email_Sent_To` are skipped, and a cache claim per paper and teacher (6 h) covers concurrent runs.
- **Failures:** a failed send releases the claim and is retried on the next run. A non-APS address, or a class with no assigned teacher, is logged as SKIPPED, not more than once per 6 hours.
- **Timing:** with a 5-minute run, the email arrives 55–60 minutes before the start.

**Dashboard.html:**

- `#examQpTcOverlay` is a red warning with the requested text, shown on every click; Cancel, Esc or a backdrop click download nothing.
- Failure messages use the requested text.

**Security:** every check is made on the server, in the download call and again at ticket delivery. Hidden buttons, client role, client ids and URL parameters are never trusted. Logs never contain the PDF content or any download key.

**API calls added:** none per page view. The background run sends one Gmail call per teacher per exam, and the download keeps its existing Drive read.

**Zoho design:** neutral. Teacher identity is the APS email; the data is the existing exam sheets.

  - a non-APS address or no teacher → skipped and logged; a send failure is retried once;
  - cancelled / locked / after the start; the trigger is removed when nothing is left; the student download is unchanged.
- Updated tests:
  - `qp.js` r67 test: the HM is now refused, C3 is refused by the 24-hour rule (re-published 13 h before), and the new messages.
  - `ui_qp.js`: the fixture is re-published ≥ 24 h before; the red popup is checked (Cancel = no call and no download, asked again every time, Confirm downloads).
  - `qp_autoemail.js`: Publish now installs the 5-minute run (for the Teacher Copy email) even with the student toggle off.

## Round 105 (2026-10-31) — Daily / Monthly Class Management Summary & Review (Tamil)

**Code.gs: new r105 module at the end of the file. No existing function is changed.**
- **Constants:**
  - `DS_SPREADSHEET_DEFAULT_` (`12USIGS9TtQznvQRVy5YLtPXuLrAoftAqAPxIylUNU1Q`; Script Property `DAILY_SUMMARY_SPREADSHEET_ID` overrides it).
  - `DS_DAILY_TAB_` "Daily Summary", `DS_MONTHLY_TAB_` "Monthly Summary".
  - `DS_RECIPIENTS_DEFAULT_` board@amchats.org + admin@ (Script Property `DAILY_SUMMARY_RECIPIENTS` overrides it).
  - `DS_DAILY_HEADER_` (32 columns), `DS_MONTHLY_HEADER_`, the Tamil / English day and month names, `DS_LOW_ATTENDANCE_PCT_` 50, `DS_LATE_MIN_` 10, `DS_CELL_MAX_`.
- **Date helpers (all in APS_TZ):** `dsToday_`, `dsDateParts_`, `dsDow_`, `dsShift_`, `dsIsLastDayOfMonth_`, `dsEnLabel_`, `dsTaLabel_`, `dsTaTime_`, `dsMinOf_`, `dsPct_`. The report date is the APS calendar date, so 11 PM EST on Friday reports Friday even though it is already Saturday in UTC.
- **Facts:**
  - `dsClassesOn_` takes the cached courses (`readAllCoursesFromCache_`), parses them with `examQpParseClassName_`, excludes those matching `ccwExcludeRe_` and matches the day of the week.
  - `dsBuildDay_` returns null when there is no class. Otherwise it collects:
    - attendance from the AWK week sheet (`attWeekSheetNameForDate_` + `attReadRecordsForSheets_`);
    - availability (`buildAvailabilityBoard_` for `getCurrentWeekId_`);
    - coverage (`cctReadRecords_`), merges (`tccRows_`), temporary teachers (`ttmRows_`), leave (`lvRows_`) and exams (`examQpReadRecords_` and related; silent when the exam module is not configured);
    - sync / storage status (`LAST_SYNC_ERROR_KEY`, `ATTENDANCE_LAST_SYNC_SUMMARY_KEY`, `apsPropBytes_`).
- **Wording:** `dsComposeDaily_` builds the Tamil sections, with only the sections that have data. A missing Meet record is reported as "பங்கேற்பு பதிவு கிடைக்கவில்லை" and HM is asked to confirm; the report never concludes that a class or teacher did not happen. A zero-present class with records gets a separate "find the reason" action.
- **Rendering:** `dsText_`, `dsHtml_` (inside `apsEmailShell_`, with `htmlEscape_` on every value).
- **Storage:** `dsSheet_` creates or reuses the tab, adds missing columns and expands beyond the 26-column default. `dsFind_`, `dsWrite_` (plain-text '@' format; a leading `'` before formula-like values), `dsReadAll_`.
- **Sending:** `dsSend_` uses `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')` from donotreply@, Reply-To admin@. It records Email Sent / Sent At / Error (Bearer tokens masked) and Recipients.
- **Daily run:** `dsRunDaily_` uses the key `yyyy-MM-dd | DAILY`:
  - sent → skip;
  - a saved row whose email failed → resend the stored report (`dsSectionsFromText_`), with no rebuild;
  - otherwise build, save (Email Sent FALSE), then send.
- **Monthly run:** `dsRunMonthly_` uses the key `yyyy-MM | MONTHLY` and is built only from the month's Daily Summary rows (no extra API calls). It reports totals, weighted attendance, and repeated Attention / Not-Set / Temporary-Teacher classes (on 2 or more days), plus unresolved FAILED temporary-teacher assignments.
- **Nightly:** `dsNightly_` takes the script lock with `tryLock` (it never waits indefinitely). It reports today, plus yesterday only when yesterday's build failed (a cache flag kept 48 h). The monthly report runs on the last day of the month, and a failed monthly email is retried on the 1st.
- **Triggers:**
  - `apsDailySummaryPrep` (~10:50 PM) and `apsDailySummaryReport` (~11:00 PM), both checked with `apsRequireTriggerCall_`.
  - `dsPrep_` runs the attendance sync once per class day (cache flag) and is skipped on a no-class day.
  - `createDailySummaryTriggers` / `removeDailySummaryTriggers` (editor only; re-running removes the old triggers first).
- **Editor-only tools:** `previewDailySummary`, `runDailySummaryNow`, `runMonthlySummaryNow`.

**API calls added:** none per page view and none per class or student. A class night adds one run of the existing attendance sync, one open of the summary spreadsheet with a few range reads and writes, and one Gmail send per report. All other data comes from the existing sheets and cache. The Classroom API is never called (checked by a test).

**§31 storage:** no Script Properties are written. Run state is kept in CacheService flags with a 6–48 h lifetime, and the report rows are in a spreadsheet.

**Security:** there is no session-token or browser entry point. Every entry point is trigger-only or owner/editor-only. Recipients are fixed server-side. Automatic runs log only the report key and the email result; only the owner-run `previewDailySummary` logs the report text. Errors are masked.

## Round 106 (2026-11-02) — Daily / Monthly Summary: next-morning schedule, missed-run fix, automatic catch-up

**Why:** the Sunday Nov 1 daily report and the October monthly report were never sent. The sheet holds only the 12:50 PM manual run of Oct 31, so the 11 PM trigger never completed. The r105 design also had a real defect:
- the ±15-minute report trigger could start before the 10:50 PM capture;
- it then ran the attendance sync inline (up to 4.5 min) before building the report;
- that could exceed the 6-minute Apps Script limit;
- a run stopped this way left no row and no failure flag, so nothing caught it up.

**User decision:** daily report the next morning ~7:00 AM; monthly report on the 1st of the next month ~8:00 AM; the fix for missed emails; automatic catch-up of any missed day or month.

**Code.gs (Daily Summary module only):**
- **Removed:** `dsNightly_`, the inline `dsPrep_` call in `apsDailySummaryReport`, and the `ds_fail_` cache flag.
- **New constants:** `DS_MONTHLY_HANDLER_` (`apsMonthlySummaryReport`), `DS_LOOKBACK_DAYS_` 7, `DS_RUN_BUDGET_MS_` 3.5 min, `DS_HOURS_` {prep 6, report 7, monthly 8} (APS_TZ, `nearMinute(0)`).
- **`dsMorning_(now)`** (7 AM) runs under `tryLock(30000)`:
  - reads the Daily Summary rows once;
  - for every date from max(first Report Date in the sheet, today − 7) to yesterday: skips sent rows and no-class days without a row, then calls `dsRunDaily_` (build → save → send, or resend the stored report when the email failed);
  - stops starting new reports after 3.5 min; the remaining dates are returned as `deferred` and run the next morning.
  - The sheet is the state, so a cut-off run, a failed build and a failed email are all caught up the same way. With an empty sheet the floor is yesterday, so there is no surprise back-fill after a deploy.
- **`dsMonthlyMorning_(now)`** (8 AM daily):
  - previous month already sent → skip;
  - no Daily rows in that month → skip;
  - any class day of that month (from the sheet floor) without a Daily row → `deferred`, so the monthly always includes the last class day;
  - otherwise `dsRunMonthly_` (which already resends a stored report whose email failed).
  - On the 1st this is the scheduled send; on later mornings it catches up a missed one.
- **`dsPrep_(now)`** (6 AM) captures **yesterday's** classes with the existing `syncAttendanceForAllCourses_({})`, once per date (cache flag) and only if yesterday had a class.
  - The scheduled sync covers yesterday in every case: Mon–Thu dates belong to the coming weekend's week, and Sunday is covered by the existing previous-week grace until Monday 8:00 AM (`ATTENDANCE_PREVIOUS_WEEK_GRACE_DEFAULT_HOURS_`).
- **Handlers:** `apsDailySummaryPrep`, `apsDailySummaryReport` and the new `apsMonthlySummaryReport` are all `apsRequireTriggerCall_`-checked.
  - `dsMigrateIfEvening_`: a handler that fires outside 4 AM–12 PM APS time (an old r105 10:50 / 11 PM trigger) reinstalls the morning triggers and returns `{migrated:true}` without sending.
- **Triggers:** `dsInstallTriggers_` is used by `createDailySummaryTriggers` and by the migration. `dsDeleteTriggers_` now includes the monthly handler.
- **`dsBuildDay_` changes:**
  - **Status window:** the sync-error and attendance-sync status checks now match the class day **or the morning after** (`F.window`).
  - **Back-fill:** for a caught-up older day (`F.backfill`), the current sync-error and storage status are left out, because they are not about that day.
- **Wording:** "இன்று / இன்றைய" (today) became "அன்று / அன்றைய" (that day), and the status heading is now "வகுப்பு நிலவரம் – <date>", because the report is read the morning after.
- **Manual tools:**
  - `runDailySummaryNow` and `runMonthlySummaryNow` accept past dates / months only. The Oct 31 manual run during class marked Saturday as sent with no attendance.
  - Defaults: yesterday / last month. `previewDailySummary` defaults to yesterday.

**Effect on production after deploy + `createDailySummaryTriggers()`:**
- The next 7 AM run sends the missed Sunday Nov 1 report (inside the 7-day window, after the sheet floor of Oct 31) and any other missed class day.
- The next 8 AM run sends the October monthly report (Oct 31 has a Daily row).
- The Oct 31 report already sent stays as it is; delete its row and run `runDailySummaryNow('2026-10-31')` to send a complete one.

**API calls:** unchanged per report. The report run no longer runs the attendance sync, so the sync runs once per class day (6 AM). The new 8 AM monthly check opens the summary spreadsheet once a day (one key lookup; Daily rows are read only when the month is not yet sent). No Classroom API call.

**§31 storage:** nothing in Script or User Properties. The only temporary state is CacheService (`ds_prep_<date>`, 15 min / 6 h); records are in the sheet.

**Zoho design:** neutral.

**Tests:** `test/dailysummary.js` was rewritten for the morning schedule (15 tests):
- Friday reported Saturday ~7 AM, with no "today" wording;
- a duplicate run;
- the monthly waits for Saturday's daily, is sent once on Nov 1 ~8 AM, and the failed daily email is resent next morning;
- the monthly content;
- Mon / Tue send and Wed / Thu don't;
- a failed build caught up;
- the Nov 1 incident (mornings that never ran are caught up oldest first, once each);
- a fresh deploy sends yesterday only;
- the 7-day window and the 3.5-minute budget (deferred, finished next morning);
- the 6 AM capture runs once for yesterday and the 7 AM report never syncs;
- triggers 6 / 7 / 8 AM America/New_York with no duplicates, and forged / editor checks;
- an old evening trigger migrates itself and sends nothing;
- manual runs past-only;
- a reused tab;
- no browser entry.

**Full regression:** 81 suites, all passed (rc=0, 0 fails), including `dailysummary` 15/15, `editoronly` 5, `accesscontrol` 9, `storage` 9/9, `teachercopy` 12/12. Live Gmail send, the live 6 / 7 / 8 AM triggers, the evening-trigger migration on the real project and writing to the real summary spreadsheet: not executed — environment/authorization required.
