- HM / VP get two days before the next class.

**Existing code reused (nothing changed):**
- `attReadRecordsForFilters_` (one bulk read of every AWK week sheet; effective score, hidden accounts removed);
- `readAllCoursesFromCache_`, `courseNameMatches_`, `ccwExcludeRe_`, `examQpParseClassName_`;
- `srmClassTeacher_` (class teacher), `tkClassChain_` (HM / VP from Class Support);
- `cctReadRecords_('')` (CLASS_CANCELLED, one read), `lvStudentLeaveIndex_` (approved leave);
- `getAPSIdFromEmail`, `apsGmailSend_('TICKETS')` (donotreply@), `apsEmailShell_`;
- `ctaSheet_` (tab in the dashboard workbook), `apsRequireTriggerCall_` / `apsRequireOwnerOrTrigger_`.

**Code.gs: new r107 module at the end of the file (no existing function modified):**
- **Constants:** `ABSENCE_CONFIG` (exactly as specified; `var` like the rest of the file), `SA_SHEET_` `STUDENT_ABSENCE_NOTIFICATIONS`, `SA_HEADER_` (24 columns), `SA_HANDLER_`, `SA_DRY_RUN_PROP_`, `SA_RUN_BUDGET_MS_` (4 min).
- **`saEvaluate_(now)`** (read-only):
  - classes = active AY26-27 courses minus test / on-call;
  - students = the current rosters;
  - a session is **conducted** when someone of that course joined that date (PRESENT / PARTIAL / active minutes) and it is not CLASS_CANCELLED for that week;
  - per student, each week (`weekOf`) is A (any PRESENT / PARTIAL, override first), E (EXCUSED) or X (ABSENT); missing rows add nothing;
  - newest first, E weeks are skipped and the run of X weeks before the first A is counted;
  - qualifies if more than `ABSENCE_THRESHOLD_WEEKS`; fewer than 5 counted weeks means insufficient history;
  - students on approved leave today are skipped.
  - It returns the key `<APS ID or email>|<first absent weekOf>`, last attended date, class(es), schedule, teacher(s), HM, VP and weeks.
- **Emails:**
  - `saStudentText_` / `saStudentHtml_` (approved wording verbatim);
  - `saSendStudent_`: To the student, CC the class teacher(s) or admin@ when missing (recorded as `MISSING – CC admin@`), Reply-To the teacher;
  - `saAdminHtml_` / `saAdminText_`: the 11 specified columns with the student-email status under the name; a "Still absent — already reported" section; the HM / VP action text; a DRY RUN banner when in dry run.
- **Log:** `saSheet_`, `saReadLog_`, `saWriteRow_` (plain text, `'` before formula-like values), `saFill_`, `saLogRun_`.
- **`saRun_(now, runBy)`** runs under `tryLock(30000)`:
  - **Dry run:** admin preview only, plus a RUN row.
  - **Live:**
    1. One batch append of the new notification rows (PENDING) before any email.
    2. One email per student not yet SENT. The result is written to its row immediately; one failure never stops the others; after 4 min the rest are `deferred` to the next run.
    3. One admin report for every qualifying student whose `Admin_Reported` is not TRUE. After it is sent the flag becomes TRUE, so a failed admin report is retried on the next run.
    4. Each qualifying row is refreshed (weeks absent, last attended), then a RUN row is written.
- **Trigger and editor tools:**
  - `apsStudentAbsenceWeekly` (trigger-checked);
  - `createStudentAbsenceTrigger` / `removeStudentAbsenceTrigger` (Wednesday 9:30, `nearMinute(30)`; re-run safe);
  - `previewStudentAbsence`, `runStudentAbsenceNow`, `enableStudentAbsenceEmails` / `disableStudentAbsenceEmails` (all owner / editor only).

**Dry run (default):** Script Property `STUDENT_ABSENCE_DRY_RUN` (absent = dry run). No student email and no notification rows; admin@ gets a "[DRY RUN]" preview; a RUN row records the counts.

**§31 sizing:** one Script Property (`STUDENT_ABSENCE_DRY_RUN`, under 30 bytes). No per-student keys, no second store. Notification history lives in the sheet: about 1 row per absent student per cycle plus 1 RUN row per week, so a few hundred rows a year.

**API calls per weekly run:**
- reads: one bulk read of the attendance week sheets, one course-cache read, one CCT read, one Leave read, one log-sheet read;
- writes: one batch append for new rows, plus one row write per student email and per qualifying row;
- Gmail: one send per newly notified student and one admin report;
- no Classroom / Meet API calls, and no extra trigger beyond the one weekly trigger.

**Zoho design:** neutral. Keyed by APS email / APS ID; the log has Student APS ID and Student Email columns, written as plain text.

**Tests:** new `test/absence.js` (12 tests) covering:
- evaluation: 6 weeks qualifies; 2 / exactly 4 / attended last week → no; excused weeks skipped; missing rows not counted; short history → no; withdrawn and on-leave excluded; test class excluded;
- cancelled and not-held sessions not counted (4 counted → no; 5 → yes);
- dry run: admin preview only, RUN row only;
- live: exact subjects and body including the shared-account text; CC teacher; admin@ fallback when no teacher; a failed email logged with the token masked while the others continue; the admin table fields;
- duplicates: re-run sends only the failed one, then nothing; a still-absent student next week gets no email and a refreshed count;
- admin failure retried next run without resending student emails;
- return-then-absent-again gives a new cycle and a new key;
- no qualifying students → no email;
- trigger: Wednesday 9:30 America/New_York, single, forged rejected, editor-only tools;
- §31: one setting key only;
- full scale: 180 classes, 1,094 students, 37,800 rows, one bulk read, about 0.14 s of evaluation (the real sheet read time is extra).

**Full regression:** 82 suites, all passed (rc=0, 0 fails), including the new `absence` 12/12, `dailysummary` 15/15, `editoronly` 5, `accesscontrol` 9. Live Gmail sends, the live Wednesday trigger and a dry run against the real attendance sheets: not executed — environment/authorization required (run `previewStudentAbsence()` / the dry run after deploy).

## Round 108 (2026-11-02) — Weekly Attendance: earlier weeks of students now in my class (previous / closed class), view-only

**Why:** `hm.nilai5_aps9014` (class HM via the Room field of every Nilai 5 class) saw only week 8 of APS3352.

**Code.gs — `getAttendanceRecordsForViewer` (teacher branch only):**

  - "My Attendance" (`scope: 'mine'`) keeps the old allowed scope.
  - Admin / Super Admin / HEADMASTER_EMAILS / BOD and student branches.

**API / storage:** no new reads, writes, triggers or properties (§31 neutral). One bulk attendance read per call, as before.

**Zoho design:** neutral.

**Tests:**

  - the old classmate and old teacher stay hidden; a class the HM isn't on stays hidden;

A fixture student enrolled in three classes now shows his other classes' rows to the teacher, labelled and view-only. The assertion was updated to the r108 rule (own-class rows as before; other rows `previousClass` + view-only + only that teacher's students), and the suite passes (39/39).

## Round 109 (2026-11-04) — APS School Leave / Holiday, Phase 1 (central service + guards + banner)

**Design rule:** check the **class date** the job works on, not only "today". The Monday 5 AM sync, the Monday 7 AM report, the Tue–Thu availability emails and the next-morning Daily Summary all run on a normal day but work on holiday dates.

**Code.gs: new r109 module at the end of the file:**
- **Constants:** `SL_SHEET_` APS_SCHOOL_LEAVES, `SL_HEADER_` (the spec's 15 columns plus `Change_Version` / `Notified_Version` for r110), `SL_AUDIT_SHEET_` APS_SCHOOL_LEAVE_AUDIT_LOG, `SL_TYPES_`, `SL_STATUS_`, `SL_CACHE_KEY_`, `SL_MEMO_`.
- **Log tab names:** they are not APS_LEAVE_* on purpose. The existing Apply Leave tabs are APS_LEAVE_REQUESTS / APS_LEAVE_AUDIT.
- **Service:**
  - `slEnabled_()` (`APS_SCHOOL_LEAVE_ENABLED`, default true; false = rollback switch);
  - `slDateStr_` (Date or text → yyyy-MM-dd in APS_TZ);
  - `slSheet_` / `slReadAll_` / `slWrite_` (plain text, foreign columns kept);
  - `apsSchoolLeaves_()`: the approved list. Read once, cached 6 h in CacheService plus memory for the run; if unreadable it is treated as no leave, so a job never stops;
  - `slInvalidate_()` on every write;
  - `slCovering_`, **`isAPSSchoolHoliday(date)`**, **`getAPSSchoolLeaveStatus(date)`** (`periodEndDate` follows back-to-back leaves);
  - `apsClassDateInWeek_(weekId, dow)`;
  - **`apsLeaveSkip_(area, date)`**: the single guard. It logs SKIPPED_SCHOOL_LEAVE once per area + date (memory, a 36 h cache key, and one audit row);
  - `slAudit_`, `slValidate_`, `slOverlaps_`, `slNewId_`.
- **Editor tools (owner only):** `addSchoolLeaveNow(title, start, end, reason, type)` (validates, blocks duplicates, reports overlaps, creates APPROVED, sends no email), `listSchoolLeavesNow()`, `cancelSchoolLeaveNow(id)`.

**Guards in existing functions (one line each):**
- `attendancePendingOccurrences_`: a leave date is not an occurrence. No rows are written (not ABSENT), the finalized cursor moves past it, and it is never back-filled. This covers the daily 5 PM full sync, the Monday 5 AM sync, Sync Attendance Now, the r105/r106 capture and the pre-report sync.
- `attSendAttendanceReportsForWeek_`: rows on leave dates are dropped, including rows captured before the leave was approved.
- `ctaBuildReport_`: classes whose class date in the week is a leave date are left out. `ctaRunScheduled_` skips and logs SKIPPED_SCHOOL_LEAVE when every class with a readable day that week is on leave.
- `ptaBuild_`: leave dates are not listed, so those recipients aren't emailed. `ptaRunWindow_` logs SKIPPED_SCHOOL_LEAVE.
- `dsClassesOn_`: a leave date has no classes, so there is no Daily Summary, no row and no capture. The monthly completeness check ignores the date.
- `getDashboardData`: `ctx.schoolLeave = getAPSSchoolLeaveStatus(today)` (cached).

**Dashboard.html:**
- `#apsSchoolLeaveBanner` sits below the header.
- `apsRenderSchoolLeaveBanner_()` is called from `renderViewerInfo()`. It is HTML-escaped and fits a phone.

**Not guarded (on purpose):** Classroom / roster / grading / Meet-link sync, Temp Teacher processing, coverage cleanup, Zoho sync, weekly backup, storage health, exam auto-email, new-student emails. These are data syncs, lifecycle jobs or separately scheduled events, per the spec's exceptions. The r107 absence monitor already ignores classes nobody held, and leave dates now have no rows at all.

**r110 will add:** the Admin screen, announcement emails, and run-date guards for Assignment Monitoring / Mark Complete / Class Consolidation / Multiple-classroom / Absence on leave days.

**§31:** one optional setting (`APS_SCHOOL_LEAVE_ENABLED`), records in a sheet, cache with a TTL. **API calls:** a cache read per execution (plus one small sheet read when the cache is cold). No new triggers or APIs.

**Zoho design:** neutral.

**Tests:**
- New `test/schoolleave.js` (11 tests):
  - Tests A–E (Nov 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 including midnight edges);
  - Test I + J (back-to-back periods, cancel, draft ignored);
  - Test K (cache served without a sheet read, invalidated on add and cancel, kill switch);
  - validation, duplicate, overlap and editor-only checks;
  - **real attendance sync:** no rows on a leave date, the next day identical to the control, no back-fill, the skip logged once;

## Round 111 (2026-11-05) — Re-Map grade transfer, Parts 1 + 2 (capture before removal; view-only carried grades)

**Why:** Re-Map calls `Students.remove` (old class), then `Students.create` (new class). After removal, Classroom hides the student's work in the old class and the API stops returning it. The API also can't grade teacher-created coursework (`ProjectPermissionDenied`). So the grades are saved in the dashboard **before** the removal.

**Code.gs: new r111 module at the end of the file:**
- **Storage:** `GT_SHEET_` STUDENT_GRADE_TRANSFER, with 27 columns, so `gtSheet_` expands past the 26-column default. One row per transfer has `Record_Type` SUMMARY, one per assignment ITEM, plus VOID when the move failed.
- `gtRequired_()` reads `GRADE_TRANSFER_REQUIRED` (default true).
- **`gtCapture_(from, to, email, by, reason, courses)`** (read-only, 2 Classroom calls, both through the existing `gradesList_`, so field-mask fallback and paging behave the same):
  - `CourseWork.list` (PUBLISHED, fields mask) and `StudentSubmissions.list(course, '-', {userId: email})`;
  - only approved categories, with the same exclusions as Grading (`gradesCategory_`, `gradesIsExcluded_`);
  - status, dates and lesson via the existing `gradesStatus_`, `gradesDue_`, `gradesIso_`, `gradesHistoryTime_`, `gradesLessonNo_`;
  - one batch append of all rows, plain text.
- `gtVoid_`, `gtReadItems_` (ITEM rows of transfers that aren't voided; one sheet read).

**Modified:**
- **`assignStudentToClassroom`:**
  - When the student has a current class, `gtCapture_` runs **before** `Students.remove`. A failure throws "Re-Map stopped … Nothing was changed", unless `GRADE_TRANSFER_REQUIRED=false`, in which case it is logged and the message says so.
  - A failure of remove or create after the capture writes a VOID row. The existing rollback is unchanged.
  - The result message adds the saved count; the result carries `gradeTransfer`.
- **`getGradingData`:** returns `carried` (view-only rows) using the **same scope rule as Grading**:
  - the student (their own);
  - teachers / VP-HM whose class the student is in now (`scope.teach`), or whose class is the transfer target;
  - all-classes roles (`APS_GRADING_ALL_CLASSES_ROLES`).
  - Nothing else in the payload changed; `exportGrading` / `gradingReportRows_` are unchanged.

**Dashboard.html:**
- `#grdCarried` panel under the Grades table; `grdRenderCarried_(f)` is called from `grdRender_`.
- Rows are grouped per student + transfer: from → to, date, count, graded points, and lessons replaced by the current class (same category + Lesson No graded there). It honours the class / Nilai / assignment / date / status / graded / search filters, has no controls, and is HTML-escaped.

**What students see in Google Classroom:** unchanged (no coursework, grade or comment writes).

**§31 / API:** +2 read calls per Re-Map, one sheet append, one sheet read per Grading view. No properties except the optional switch. No triggers.

**Zoho design:** moves toward it. Student rows are keyed by APS email + APS ID with request fields (reason, actor, time), plain text.

**Tests:**
- New `test/gradetransfer.js` (5 tests). The submissions mock hides a removed student's work, like Classroom does.
  - Capture happens while the student is still enrolled (one call), then remove + create, and no other Classroom writes;
  - every approved assignment is captured with grade / max / status / late / dates / lesson; summary fields are checked; the message count is checked;
  - a capture error stops the Re-Map with nothing changed; the switch allows the move with a warning;
  - a failed move → rollback + VOID, and the voided capture is hidden;
  - a first assignment has no capture;
  - Part 2 visibility: the new teacher, Admin (with all-classes Grading) and the student see the rows; another student, an unrelated teacher, and an Admin without all-classes access (same rule as Grading) do not.
- New `test/ui_gradetransfer.js` (browser): the panel content, a replaced lesson dimmed and left out of the total, view-only, the class filter hides it, no JS errors.
- Screenshot `r111_grades_carried_over.png`.

**Full regression:** 90 suites, all passed (rc=0, 0 fails), including `gradetransfer` 5/5, `ui_gradetransfer` 1/1, `remap`, `addstudent`, `grading` and `ui_grading`. A live Re-Map against real Google Classroom: not executed — environment/authorization required.

**Not in r111 (proposed r112):** Part 3 (optional carry-over items in the new class's Classroom gradebook) and the backfill tool for students moved before r111.

- **`grdRenderCarried_`:** uses the helper; the header now explains the matrix and Overall % behaviour.
- **`grdRenderMatrix_`:** each non-replaced carried row joins the student's current-class row:

  - otherwise its own cell, under its title column (created when the view has none), grey, `data-grd-prev`.
  - Graded carried rows add to the row's `pts` / `mx`, so Overall % includes them, and the cell notes "incl. N 📦 from previous class". A current cell that is already graded wins; nothing is counted twice.
  - Column class averages, the tiles, the Assignment Report and Export CSV are unchanged (current class only).
- **Help popups:** Overall % and `[data-grd-prev]`.

**Code.gs:** no change. **API / §31:** no new calls, no properties.

## Round 114 (2026-11-06) — 👩‍🏫 Volunteer/Teacher Management → Weekly Teacher Appreciation (scoring, storage, dashboard)

**User request:** a weekly Teacher Appreciation module. The design was agreed in chat:
- Wednesday 7 PM run;
- Monday–Sunday reporting week;
- engagement = lesson work the teacher posted (student non-submission is never a penalty);
- no score in teacher emails;
- weekly plus monthly emails;
- sender attendance@;
- HM and teacher views later.

r114 = scoring, storage and dashboard; r115 = emails.

**Code.gs — module "WEEKLY TEACHER APPRECIATION" (end of file):**
- **`taEvaluate_(weekId, now, cfg)` (read-only, no Classroom API).** Reads each source once:
  - the course cache: active AY26-27 classes, minus `ccwExcludeRe_` test classes; the class teacher is `srmClassTeacher_`;
  - `attReadRecordsForFilters_({weekOf})` for the evaluated week and the 3 weeks before (consistency);
  - `gradesForCourses_` (the Grading sync tables), only when `gradesLastSync_()` is at most `gradeSyncMaxHours` old and not FAILED;
  - approved teacher leave (`lvRows_`, non-student, APPROVED);
  - `cctReadRecords_` (CLASS_CANCELLED);
  - `isAPSSchoolHoliday`.
- **Per class occurrence** (`apsClassDateInWeek_`):
  - SCHOOL_LEAVE / CANCELLED / TEACHER_LEAVE: excluded;
  - teacher present (status PRESENT/PARTIAL, or active minutes): HELD;
  - another non-excluded teacher present: COVERED for the class teacher, COVERING (credited) for the substitute;
  - otherwise NOT_VERIFIED, with a reason (no attendance / no Meet activity / teacher not in the Meet).
  - **Completion** = min(100, active minutes ÷ (scheduled × heldPct)). An override without minutes = 100 with punctuality unknown.
  - **Punctuality** from firstJoin vs schedStart.
  - **Student attendance** = present ÷ non-excused, against attendanceTarget.
- **Classroom (per class):**
  - **Engagement:** ATT / HW / QUZ posted in the week (with a due date = 1, without = 0.5); an exam or project item in the week counts HW and QUZ as done; expected items come from `cfg.expected[Nilai]` or DEFAULT.
  - **Grading:** turned-in work (not ATTENDANCE) from the window [run − gradingDays − 7×lookback, run − gradingDays) graded within gradingDays. Graded before turn-in → counted separately as `gradedBeforeTurnIn`.
  - **Consistency:** weeks with a held class vs weeks with any approved item posted.
  - **Submission rate** of the week's HW and QUZ: a highlight only.
- **`taScoreTeacher_`:**
  - Metrics are averaged weighted by class minutes. Unavailable metrics are dropped and the weights rescaled (coverage %).
  - SUFFICIENT = at least one held class + completion + punctuality + coverage ≥ minCoverage; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_DATA with the reasons (leave / covered / school leave / not verified / stale sync / coverage).
  - Band thresholds come from the config; eligible = sufficient and score ≥ appreciateMin.
  - Highlight codes, at most 4: ALL_CLASSES, ON_TIME, ATTENDANCE, POSTED, GRADING, CONSISTENT, SUBMISSIONS.
- **Storage:**
  - `taUpsert_` upserts by the key column: contiguous blocks with one `setValues` each, new rows appended in one call, plain text with a formula guard.
  - New sheets get their columns inserted before the header is written (more than 26 columns).
  - Tabs:
    - **TEACHER_APPRECIATION_SCORES** (31 columns; key `Week_ID|email`; per-class details as compact JSON ≤ 8000 characters);
    - **TEACHER_APPRECIATION_RUNS**;
    - **TEACHER_APPRECIATION_CONFIG** (Setting / Value JSON / Updated_*; `version` row) and **_AUDIT**.
- **Config:**
  - `taConfig_()` merges the sheet over `TA_DEFAULTS_`; an invalid sheet falls back to the defaults (the run never breaks).
  - `taValidateConfig_` checks: weights are integers adding to 100; Exceptional > Outstanding > Good; punctuality minutes increasing; numeric ranges; 1–10 @avvaiyarpadasalai.org admin emails; expected items limited to ATT / HW / QUZ.
- **Run:**
  - `taRun_(now, trigger, by, opts)`: tryLock(5 s); evaluates and upserts (or, for a continuation run, reads the stored week via `taStoredWeek_`); calls `taDeliver_` when present (r115); logs the run in a finally block.
  - Trigger `apsTeacherAppreciationWeekly`: Wednesday 19:00 America/New_York, created by `taEnsureTrigger_` when an admin opens the tab, or by `createTeacherAppreciationTrigger()`.
  - Week: `taCompletedWeek_` = the dashboard week (`attWeekIdForDateStr_`) of the last finished Sunday.
- **Endpoints:** `taViewer_` = `apsRequireTabForToken_('teacherMgmt.appreciation')` + Admin / Super Admin, or BOD read-only; mutations also go through `requireDashboardMutationPermission_`.
  - `getTeacherAppreciationData` reads saved scores only — viewing never re-scores.
  - `getTeacherAppreciationHistory`
  - `previewTeacherAppreciation`: in memory; optional draft config, validated.
  - `saveTeacherAppreciationConfig`: versioned and audited per setting; tryLock.
  - `runTeacherAppreciationNow`: refuses a week that hasn't finished.
  - `exportTeacherAppreciation`: CSV with a BOM, formula-escaped.
- **Editor tools:** `previewTeacherAppreciationFromEditor`, `runTeacherAppreciationFromEditor`, `removeTeacherAppreciationTrigger`, all via `apsRequireOwnerOrTrigger_`.
- **Access Control:** new rows `teacherMgmt` and `teacherMgmt.appreciation`, cells `AYLLLYL` (Super Admin always; Admin, BOD on). The catalog goes from 41 to 43 rows; `accesscontrol.js`, `special.js` and `ui_access.js` were updated.

**Dashboard.html:**
- New tab `#tabTeacherMgmt` and view `#taView`, with sub-tab `#subTabTaAppreciation` (room for later sub-tabs).
- Visibility: `taOk_` (role + `apsTabOk`) and `taSyncVisibility_`; `switchView`, `acRedirectView_`, `AC_EL_KEYS_` and `AC_VIEW_KEYS_` are wired.
- Six collapsible sections (`details.ta-sec`; open/closed state remembered in localStorage, inside try/catch). Reuses the am-* KPI tiles, tables, cards and chips, and the exam modal for the history and email previews.
- Filters (Nilai / teacher / band / search) re-render on the client with no server call; changing the week reloads that week.
- Settings form with a live weight total, "Preview with these settings", Save and Defaults; BOD sees it read-only.
- Tooltips on every control.

**§31:**
- Script Properties: only `TEACHER_APPRECIATION_EMAILS` (r115) and a short-lived continuation key; config and data live in sheets.
- Growth about 130 score rows a week (~7,000 a year); archive after 2 academic years.
- tryLock only.

**Zoho design:** neutral (keyed by APS email / APSID).

**Tests:**

- **`taDeliver_(ev, now, runId, by, opts, t0)`** is called by `taRun_`.

## Round 117 (2026-11-06) — One weekly-jobs scheduler (fixes "This script has too many triggers")

**Problem (production, after r114–r116):** `Exception: This script has too many triggers. Triggers must be deleted from the script before more can be added.` at `taEnsureTrigger_` ← `createTeacherAppreciationTrigger`. Apps Script allows **20 triggers per user per project**; every weekly feature had its own `weekly()` trigger.

**Decision (user):** "Permanent fix (recommended): r117, one weekly-jobs scheduler."

**Code.gs — module "r117 — ONE WEEKLY-JOBS SCHEDULER" (end of file):**
- One hourly trigger **`apsWeeklyJobs`** (`everyHours(1)`) replaces 7 weekly triggers. `WJ_JOBS_` (America/New_York):

| Job id | Day / hour | Replaces handler | Runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| WEEKLY_MAINTENANCE | Sun 2 | apsWeeklyMaintenance | backup + audit archive (if `apsMaintenanceEnabled_`) |
| MULTIPLE_CLASSROOM_REPORT | Mon 7 | apsWeeklyMultipleClassroomReport | `admcRun_` |
| MISSING_GRADING_REPORT | Tue 8 | apsMissingGradingWeekly | `mhgRun_` |
| STUDENT_ABSENCE | Wed 9 | apsStudentAbsenceWeekly | `saRun_` |
| CLASS_CONSOLIDATION_ANALYSIS | Wed 19 | apsClassConsolidationAnalysis | `ccwRunAnalysis_` |
| TEACHER_APPRECIATION | Wed 19 | apsTeacherAppreciationWeekly | `taRun_` |
| CLASS_CONSOLIDATION_EMAIL | Wed 19, ≥ 25 min after the analysis | apsClassConsolidationEmail | `ccwRunEmail_` |

- **`wjRun_(now, by, {only, force})`:** cache flag `wj_running` (10 min) against overlap. A job is due when this week's slot (`wjSlot_`) has started, is at most 24 h old (`WJ_WINDOW_MIN_`), is not yet done, its dependency is done, and it is not switched off. A new job starts only within the first 60 s of the run (`WJ_START_NEXT_MS_`), so a long job pushes the next one to the next hourly check. Leave guard (`apsLeaveSkip_`) → `SKIPPED_SCHOOL_LEAVE` (not retried). Errors → `ERROR`, retried on the next checks up to `WJ_MAX_ATTEMPTS_` (3); messages masked with `saSafeErr_`. State saved after every job.
- **State:** Script Property `APS_WEEKLY_JOBS_STATE` (one small JSON: per job last slot / result / time / attempts / short error — fixed size, 7 entries) and `APS_WEEKLY_JOBS_OFF` (list of switched-off job ids). Log sheet `APS_WEEKLY_JOBS_LOG` (Run_At, Job, Slot, Result, Seconds, Details), trimmed to 1000 rows.
- **First install:** `wjBaseline_` marks every slot of the current week that has already started as `BASELINE`, so nothing runs by surprise on install day.
- **Teacher Appreciation continuation:** if `TA_CONT_PROP_` is pending and no continuation trigger exists (e.g. no free slot), the next hourly check finishes it with `taRun_(…, {continueRun})`.
- **Migration:** `apsEnsureWeeklyJobsTrigger_()` deletes the 7 old handlers' triggers **first**, then creates `apsWeeklyJobs` if missing (works at 20/20) and sets the baseline; idempotent; other triggers untouched. Called by `rosterEnsureTrigger_` path (`apsEnsureMaintenanceTrigger_`), `taEnsureTrigger_`, `mhgEnsureTrigger_`; `APS_TRIGGER_CHECK_KEY_` → `apsTriggersChecked_v5` so every install re-checks once.
- **Old handlers** (still defined, for triggers that may fire once more): after `apsRequireTriggerCall_`, `wjMovedSkip_` returns `{skipped:'MOVED_TO_WEEKLY_JOBS'}` and deletes their own trigger when the scheduler exists.
- **Editor tools:** `createWeeklyJobsTrigger()`, `weeklyJobsStatus()`, `runWeeklyJobNow(jobId)` (owner/editor only). The old `create…Trigger` / `remove…Trigger` tools for SA, CCW, ADMC, TA and MHG now switch the job on / off (`wjSetOff_`).
- **Status:** `wjStatus_(now)` → installed, triggersUsed, limit 20, handlers, jobs (label, when, last run / result / error, next date, off). Added to `getMaintenanceStatus` as `weeklyJobs`.

**Dashboard.html:** Admin Control → Backup & Archive → `#maintJobs` (`maintRenderJobs_`): "Apps Script triggers used N of 20" (red within 2 of the limit), table of the 7 jobs, collapsible list of installed handlers.

**§31:** two small, fixed-size Script Properties; log in a sheet, trimmed; cache flag + tryLock-style overlap guard only; net trigger count −6.

**Tests:**

The daily check still trims only above 70%.

  - Endpoint `runTempDataCleanup(sessionToken)` — `apsRequireTabForToken_(…, 'adminControl.backup')` + `apsRequireMaintenanceAdmin_` (Admin / Super Admin, server-side); returns before / after, handled names, freedKb, errors and the refreshed status.

## Round 119 (2026-11-06) — Second property store diet (country off, compact storage, weekly prune)

**Trigger:** `apsStorageReport` in production, 11/06: Script Properties 187 KB (37%), second store (deploying account's User Properties) **345 KB (69%)** — `apsUserCountryMap_v1` 138.6 KB, `lastLoginMap` 115 KB, `onboardedStudents` 69.5 KB, `presenceMap` 3.1 KB, many `GOOGLE_REVIEW_PROMPT_*`.

**Decisions (user):** remove the country feature ("Switch off + delete data"); items 1–3 now, moving the lists to a sheet (item 4) later; people who left kept **180 days**.

**1. Country feature switched off** — `apsCountryOn_()` = Script Property `APS_COUNTRY_FEATURE` == 'on' (default **off**). Code kept dormant.
- `getMyCountryPreference` → `{hasDefault:true, disabled:true, …blank}` (the gate's country step is skipped; no flag).
- `recordViewerCountry` / `setMyDefaultCountry` save nothing; `applyUserCountry_` returns blank flags without reading the map.
- Dashboard.html `loadUserCountryFlag` asks `getMyCountryPreference` first; `disabled` → no ipapi.co request, no flag (old body is `loadUserCountryFlagLookup_`).
- `apsCountryDataPurge_()` deletes `apsUserCountryMap_v1` from both stores when off — called by the daily `apsPropHealth_` (always), the r118 clean-up button (listed in its plan as "Delete (country feature switched off)") and the weekly prune.

**2. Compact storage of `lastLoginMap` / `onboardedStudents`** (`APC_KEYS_`):
- Stored as `{"_c":2,"k":"ll"|"ob","e":{key:value}}`; keys ending `@avvaiyarpadasalai.org` stored with a trailing `@`; ISO times (`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.sssZ`) as base-36 epoch ms (exact). Last login value `"gc,gm,db"`; onboarded value one time. Anything that does not round-trip exactly is stored as `[original]`.
- `apsBigSet_` encodes (`apcEncodeRaw_`: whole map verified `decode(encode(x)) == x` by JSON text, and only used if shorter; any error → original text stored). `apsBigGet_` (now over `apsBigGetStored_`) and `apsBigJson_` decode, so every caller gets the original JSON. Plain (r118) data is read unchanged and compacts on its next write.
- Measured on a realistic 1,500-person test list: last login 160.5 → 74.6 KB, onboarded 119.0 → 64.9 KB.
- Editor: `compactPersonData()` (compact now), `expandPersonDataForRollback()` (write plain format — run before rolling back to r118 or older).

**3. Weekly job `PERSON_DATA_PRUNE`** (added to `WJ_JOBS_`, Sunday 3 AM, label "Remove saved data of people who left (180+ days)") → `apsPersonDataPrune_(now, {dryRun, force, by})`:
- Active people = teachers + students with ACTIVE membership in ACTIVE AY26-27 classes (`rosterDataset_`) ∪ people in the courses cache (`apsActivePeople_`).
- Removed only when NOT active AND the newest of last-login gc / gm / db and onboarded is older than `APS_PERSON_DATA_KEEP_DAYS` (default 180, 30–3650). No readable date → kept. `GOOGLE_REVIEW_PROMPT_<email>` keys removed when not active and the month is older than the cutoff.
- Safety: no active classes / people → `SKIPPED_NO_ROSTER`; more than 40% of ≥ 20 people at once → `SAFETY_STOP` (nothing changed) unless `force`; script `tryLock(10000)` (busy → error → retried next hour by the scheduler).
- Returns counts only (no emails). Editor: `previewPersonDataPrune()` (dry run), `runPersonDataPruneNow(force)`.

**Expected production effect:** second store about 345 → ~110–120 KB (country 139 KB deleted, last login ~115 → ~55 KB, onboarded ~70 → ~38 KB), before any pruning.

**§31:** no new Script Property by default (`APS_COUNTRY_FEATURE`, `APS_PERSON_DATA_KEEP_DAYS` are optional settings); growing data shrinks; weekly pruning; tryLock only.

**Tests:**
- New `test/persondata.js` (8): compact size + exact read-back on 1,500 people; odd / legacy entries kept exactly, unsafe keys / bad JSON stored unchanged, other keys untouched; transparent to getDashboardData (Last Login display, Onboarded) with old plain data and after heartbeat / merge writes; country OFF (no step, no flag, nothing saved, list deleted by the button and the daily check); country ON unchanged; prune rules (class members, recent, undated kept; 190-day leaver removed incl. Google Review key; dry run; no emails in the result); safety (no roster, 40% stop, force, keep days 365); job registration Sunday 3 AM, rollback / compact tools, editor-only.
- Updated: `storage.js` (country test sets the switch on), `weeklyjobs.js` (8 jobs; Sunday 3 AM prune), `ui_maint.js` (8 jobs; new UI test: country OFF → no ipapi.co request, no flag, no country step; ON → as before).

**Full regression:** 97 suites; 95 passed (rc=0, 0 fails), including `persondata` 8/8, `storage` 13/13, `weeklyjobs` 13/13, `ui_maint` 6/6, `concurrency`, `editoronly`. Pre-existing date-dependent failures (also on unchanged r113 code): `ui_concurrency`, `ui_tcc77`.

## Round 120 (2026-11-06) — Country flags from the USER_COUNTRY Google Sheet (outside-USA people only)

**User request:** keep country information in a Google Sheet, ignore United States users by default (only outside-USA countries are needed); start the sheet empty and let it fill as people sign in (no migration of the old list).

**Code.gs:**
- `apsCountryOn_()` now defaults **on** (`APS_COUNTRY_FEATURE` = 'off' switches everything off). `apsCountryDataPurge_()` always deletes the old property list `apsUserCountryMap_v1` (daily check, clean-up button — plan action "Delete (old list — countries are now kept in the USER_COUNTRY sheet)", weekly prune).
- New module "r120 — COUNTRY FLAGS FROM A GOOGLE SHEET":
  - Sheet **USER_COUNTRY** (main workbook, created on first write, plain text): Email, APSID, Name, Role, Country_Code, Country_Name, Source (BROWSER / CHOSEN / ADMIN), First_Seen, Updated_At, Updated_By. Values formula-safe (`ucCell_`). Name from the courses cache (`ucNameOf_`, no API call).
  - `ucRows_()`, `ucMap_()` (script cache `aps_user_country_v1`, 6 h, < 90 KB; per-execution memo), `ucInvalidate_()`, `ucLegacyMap_()` (old entry shape: BROWSER → countryCode/Name/updatedAt; CHOSEN/ADMIN → defaultCountry*), so `getUserCountryMap_()` → `resolveCountryFlag_` / `applyUserCountry_` / on-call flags keep working unchanged.
  - `ucSetCountry_(email, code, name, source, by, role, opts)`: script lock; 'US' → the person's rows deleted; BROWSER never overwrites CHOSEN / ADMIN; same country + source → no write; otherwise update or append; CHOSEN / ADMIN changes audited in **USER_COUNTRY_AUDIT** (At, By, Email, Old_Country, New_Country, Source). Cache cleared after every change.
  - `ucRecordBrowser_(session, code, name)` (from `recordViewerCountry`): US with no row → returns at once (no lock, no sheet read); unchanged → no write; busy lock → skipped quietly.
  - `ucPref_(email)` (from `getMyCountryPreference`): `hasDefault:true` always (no country step at sign-in), `sheetMode:true`, the person's row (countryCode, countryName, countryFlag, source) plus the old default*/detected* fields.
  - `setMyDefaultCountry` → `ucSetCountry_(…, 'CHOSEN', …)` and returns the new preference.
  - Admin endpoints (`apsRequireCountryAdmin_`: `apsRequireTabForToken_(…, 'teacherMgmt.userCountry')` + `isAdminRole_`): `getUserCountryAdmin` (rows + counts per country), `setUserCountryByAdmin(email, code, name)` (Source ADMIN; email validated), `exportUserCountry` (CSV with BOM, formula-safe).
  - Weekly prune: `ucPruneRows_(activeSet, cutoffMs, dryRun)` — rows of people not in an active class and with Updated_At older than the keep days; `removed.countrySheet` in the prune result.

**Dashboard.html:**
- `loadUserCountryFlag` → `getMyCountryPreference`; `disabled` → nothing; `sheetMode` → `ucClientFlow_`: shows the saved row's flag; CHOSEN / ADMIN → no lookup; otherwise one ipapi.co lookup — outside USA → flag (+ `recordViewerCountry` only when it differs from the saved row), US → no flag (+ record only when a row exists, so the server removes it).
- Change-Country modal: in sheet mode shows the returned country (United States → flag hidden).
- First sign-in country step never shows (`hasDefault:true`).
- **Location (user request during the build):** sub-tab of 👩‍🏫 Volunteer/Teacher Management, Admin / Super Admin only. New Access Control row `teacherMgmt.userCountry` '🌍 Users outside the USA', cells 'AYLLLLL' (44 rows now). The sub-tab bar `#taSubTabs` moved to the top of `#taView` with a second button `#subTabTaUserCountry`; the Teacher Appreciation content is wrapped in `#taMain`; the card is `#ucView > #ucCard`. `ucOk_()` (Admin / Super Admin + both AC keys), `tmOk_()` = `taOk_() || ucOk_()` (tab visibility, redirect), `tmOpen_(sub)` switches sub-tabs (opens on Teacher Appreciation when allowed); `AC_VIEW_KEYS_.teacherMgmt` = 'teacherMgmt'; `AC_EL_KEYS_` + `subTabTaUserCountry`.
- `#ucCard` "🌍 Users outside the USA": counts per country, search, Export (CSV), Set country (email + country picker, United States removes), table (Country, Name, Email, APSID, Role, Source, Updated). Loaded by `loadUserCountryAdmin_()` when the sub-tab opens. Tooltips on every control.

## Round 121 (2026-11-06) — Performance: realtime poll, request memo, page-load payload

**User request:** improve current APS Dashboard performance — GUI, data read/write and API calls (following the strengthened §6 of the generic prompt: measure before / after, small surgical changes, no behaviour change).

**Measured (mock with production-sized data: 123 classes, 1,500 last-login entries, 300 activity entries, 40 online; `tools/perf_realtime.js`):**

| Call (how often) | Before (r120) | After (r121) |
|---|---|---|
| `getRealtimeStatusSnapshot` — every open tab, every 45–90 s — Admin | 236.9 KB; 6 Script + 2 User Property reads per poll | **13.3 KB**; 5 Script, 0 User Property reads (shared 20-s map) |
| same — teacher / student | 236.9 KB (everyone's last login / online status) | **0.3 KB** (own classes / people only) |
| `getDashboardData` — page load + 5-min refresh — Admin | 392.8 KB; 29 Script Property reads, 19 cache gets | **293.0 KB** (−25%); 26 reads, 15 gets |
| same — teacher / student | 9.5 / 11.4 KB; 12 Script Property reads, 15 / 14 cache gets | **6.7 / 7.8 KB**; 9 reads, 11 gets |

Sheet reads were already one bulk read per sheet with the course memo (r49 / r83 / r96): warm page loads read no sheet; no Classroom / Zoho API call on page load or poll (unchanged).

**Code.gs:**
- `getRealtimeStatusSnapshot`: request memo; `apsViewerScope_(session)` → `apsScopeById_` (live / teacherNotInClass / needsTechSupport / classStatusManual / weeklyAvailability by course id) and `apsScopeByEmail_` (presence / externalActivity / lastLogin by the viewer's people). Admin / Super Admin / HM / BOD = every class (`apsAllViewRole_`, same rule as r68).
- `apsRecentActivity_()` — shared map in the script cache (`aps_rt_recent_v1`, 20 s, < 95 KB): presence seen ≤ 10 min (browser online window 3 min), external activity Meet ≤ 185 / Classroom ≤ 25 min (browser windows 180 / 20), last-login entries changed ≤ 15 min (normalised gc / gm / db), weekly availability answers changed ≤ 15 min. Values unchanged; older values are already on screen and the 5-minute refresh carries everything.
- `apsViewerScope_` — `{ids, idSet, em}` per teacher / student, cached `aps_vsc1_<course-memo gen>_<role>_<email>` (COURSES_MEMO_SECONDS_), replaces the r68 `aps_lbv1_` ids cache in `apsClassLiveBoxesForViewer_` (same invalidation: new generation after every Courses write).
- Request-scoped memo `APS_REQ_MEMO_` / `apsReqMemo_(key, fn)` (active only inside `getDashboardData` / `getRealtimeStatusSnapshot`, cleared in `finally`): `apsCountryOn_`, `getRosterHiddenStaffVisible_`, `acOverrides_` (→ `acOverridesRaw_`), `readDashboardRolePermissions_` (→ `readDashboardRolePermissionsRaw_`). Outside those calls they behave exactly as before.
- `getDashboardData` → `getDashboardDataInner_` (unchanged body) + `apsSlimDashboardPayload_`: removes person fields the browser never reads (`lastLoginBySource`, `lastLoginSource`, `countrySource`, `onboardedAt`) and sends `''` for the default photo (`PLACEHOLDER_PHOTO`). Server code before the return still has every field.

**Dashboard.html:**
- `pollRealtimeOperationalStatus`: the class-status part still runs only when live / TNIC / NTS / class-status maps change; online dots, last login, Meet / Classroom activity and weekly availability are applied on every poll (before r121 they were only applied when a class status changed, so they waited for the 5-minute refresh). DOM updated only for changed cards (`updateRealtimePeopleDom`).
- Avatars: `p.photo || APS_PLACEHOLDER_PHOTO_`.

**§6 checklist:** no sheet read added; no API added; fewer property / cache reads per request; payload smaller; no new library; behaviour unchanged except online dots updating sooner (bug fix). Privacy improvement: teachers / students no longer receive other people's last login / online status.

**Tests:** new `test/perf121.js` (6: Admin recent windows and values; student / teacher scope; shared 20-s map — no User Property reads for 5 more polls, operational maps still read every poll; scope cache + generation; slim payload; request memo cleared, switch seen on next load and after an error) and `test/ui_perf121.js` (2: online dot added by the poll without a class-status change; default photos render; student poll scope). Measurement tools moved to `tools/` (`perf_profile.js`, `perf_realtime.js`), not part of the regression.

**Full regression:** 100 suites; 95 passed first time, including `perf121` 6/6 and `ui_perf121` 2/2. `persondata` and `usercountry` failed only on two assertions that read the removed fields `onboardedAt` / `countrySource` from the browser payload — changed to read the stored value, then 8/8 and 7/7. `concurrency` failed once on the r100 chat-race test (chat code not touched by r121); re-run 3× → 6/6 each time (intermittent). Pre-existing date-dependent failures (also on unchanged r113 code): `ui_concurrency`, `ui_tcc77`.
